text: Hodo wiye, Stanford Đɔkɔtɔnaa Sukuli Kɩtɛzʋʋ taa lɛɣtʋ ñɩnɩyaa susaa se polubi kʋdɔmɩŋ maɣzʋʋ wonuu kɩfalʋʋ ŋgʋ kɩpɩzɩɣ nɛ kɩlɩzɩ kuludasɩ paa nzɩ lɛ nɛ sɩ-hɔɔlʋʋ yɔ : pɩkɛ wonuu ŋgʋ kɩwɛ tayɩ nɛ papɩzɩɣ nɛ palɩzɩ-kʋ menziiniwaa mba palɩzɩɣ takayɩsɩ nɛ tɔlɩm yɔ pɔ-yɔɔ nɛ paa ŋgʋ lɛ kɩfɛyɩ liidiye nɛ pɩcɛzɩ Etaazuunii faɖam kʋɖʋmʋʋ.
text_en: On Monday, scientists from the Stanford University School of Medicine announced the invention of a new diagnostic tool that can sort cells by type: a tiny printable chip that can be manufactured using standard inkjet printers for possibly about one U.S. cent each.

text: Lɛɣtʋ ñɩnɩyaa sɔsaa yɔɔdʋʋ se pɩkaɣ yebu nɛ pana lɔŋ kʋdɔmɩŋ ɛzɩ cancer kʋdɔŋ, kpeziwɩlaɣ, HIV nɛ pɔtʋ kʋdɔŋ kʋñɔndʋtʋ ajɛɛ wena a-taa mba hɩla cancer kʋʋ yɔ pɛcɛzɩ mba kɩkʋʋ ñɩm ajɛɛ taa yɔ tam nabʋlɛ.
text_en: Lead researchers say this may bring early detection of cancer, tuberculosis, HIV and malaria to patients in low-income countries, where the survival rates for illnesses such as breast cancer can be half those of richer countries.

text: Ɛsɔdaa lɔɔɖɩyɛ JAS 39C Gripen tɔlɩ ɛsɔdaa lɔɔɖa kadaɣ taa tanaŋ ñɩɣtʋ 9 nɛ cɛcɛsɩ 30 yɔɔ mbʋ yɔ peeɖe tɛ alɩwaatʋ yɔɔ (ñɩɣtʋ 2 nɛ cɛcɛsɩ 30 yɔɔ UTC) nɛ ɖɩmɩzɩ, piyeba nɛ paɖɩɣ ɛsɔdaa lɔɔɖa kadaɣ se tadɩyɛ ɛsɔdaa ɩtaatasɩ tibu peeɖe.
text_en: The JAS 39C Gripen crashed onto a runway at around 9:30 am local time (0230 UTC) and exploded, closing the airport to commercial flights.

text: Weyi ɛsaɣaɣ ɛsɔdaa lɔɔɖɩyɛ nɖɩ yɔ, ɛnʋ lɛ ɛsɔdaa lɔɔɖa Sɔɔja Sɔsɔ Dilokrit Pattavee.
text_en: The pilot was identified as Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.

text: Tɛtʋ taa tɔm susuu tʋma yɔɔdaa se ɛsɔdaa lɔɔɖɩyɛ kadaɣ taa miŋ ɖeziyaa lɔɔɖɩyɛ kaawɛɛ nɛ ɖitiki nɛ ɖɩkpaɣ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ ɖɩlʋkaɣnɩ miŋ ɛnɩ yɔ.
text_en: Local media reports an airport fire vehicle rolled over while responding.

text: Vidal weyi ɛwɛnɩ pɩnzɩ 28 yɔ, ɛlɩnɩ Seviiyi nɛ ewolo Barɩsaa pɩlakɩ pɩnzɩ naadozo yɔ.
text_en: 28-year-old Vidal had joined Barça three seasons ago, from Sevilla.

text: Kpaɣnɩ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ Vidal wobi Kataalaanɩ mba tɛ tɛtʋ sɔsɔtʋ taa yɔ, ɛmabɩ maacɩwaa 49 pɛ-tɛ pombo ɛgbɛyɛ taa.
text_en: Since moving to the Catalan-capital, Vidal had played 49 games for the club.

text: Abɩɣya ɖɔnɛ paɣzɩ ɛzɩ nɩɣtʋ 11 yɔɔ ɖeyi ɖeyi peeɖe tɛ alɩwaatʋ yɔɔ (UTC+1) Whitehall ŋgʋ kɩwɛ Downing Street nɔnɔɔ ŋga polisinaa ɖaŋɩɣ kɔ-yɔɔ yɔ kɛ-ɛsɩndaa, ɖenɖe Komina ñʋʋdʋ tʋmɩyɛ ɖɩɣa wɛɛ yɔ.
text_en: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.

text: Ñɩɣtʋ 11 wayɩ kpaagbaa lɛ, abɩɣya ɖɔnɛ tɩnaa ɖɩɣ nʋmɔʋ Whitehall se hayo kiŋ kɛɛkɛɛ ɩtaaɖɛɛ.
text_en: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.

text: Pɩmabɩ ñɩɣtʋ 11 nɛ cɛcɛsɩ 20 lɛ, polisi pɔzɩ abɩɣya ɖɔnɛ tɩnaa se petii nɛ pɔɖɔ habɩyɛ kpɛŋa yɔɔ, nɛ pɔyɔɔdɩ se paa pɛwɛnɩ waɖɛ se papɩɣyɩ yɔ pʋpɔzʋʋ se pɔtɔzɩ se lɔɔɖa ɖiɣni ɖɔʋ habɩyɛ yɔɔ
text_en: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.

text: Pɩmabɩ ñɩɣtʋ 11 nɛ cɛcɛsɩ 29 lɛ, abɩɣya ɖɔnɛ tɩnaa ɖɔ nɛ pakpa Whitehall hayo kiŋ, pɛɖɛɛ Trafalgar Square yɔɔ, pɔcɔlɩ Strand, patɩŋnɩ Aldwych nɛ pɛɖɛɛ pakpa Kingsway nɛ powobini Holborn kiŋ ɖenɖe Conservative politiki ɛgbɛyɛ kaawɛ ɖɩlakɩ ɖɩ-tɛ Kpiziɣɖe taa Kediɣzaɣ agɔma ɖɩɣa ŋga payaɣ se Grand Connaught Rooms yɔ ka-taa.
text_en: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.

text: Nadal nɛ Kanada tʋ pakatɩɣ ɖama yɔ, ɛwabɩ 7-2.
text_en: Nadal's head to head record against the Canadian is 7–2.

text: Pitileɖi yɔ, Raonic wabɩ-ɩ Teenisi maacɩ ŋgʋ pamabɩ Brisbane yɔ kɩ-taa.
text_en: He recently lost against Raonic in the Brisbane Open.

text: Nadal kpeɣli kpaɣla 88% maacɩ taa nɛ ɛwa kpaɣla 76 kajalaɣ hɔɔlʋʋ taa.
text_en: Nadal bagged 88% net points in the match winning 76 points in the first serve.

text: Maacɩ tɛma lɛ, King of Claɣ yɔɔdɩ se ʺPɩkɛdɩna-m kpem se manpɩsaa nɛ mɔnkɔɔ alɩwaatʋ kɩcɛyɩtʋ tʋnɛ tɩ-kɛdɛzaɣ hɔɔlʋʋ taa. Mɛwɛ cɩnɛ se mañaɣ pana nɛ mawa maacɩ kʋnɛ.ʺ
text_en: After the match, King of Clay said, "I am just excited about being back in the final rounds of the most important events. I am here to try to win this."

text: ʺPanama Papersʺ kɛ tɔm piye nɖɩ poluba nɛ payaɣnɩ takayɩsɩ ɛzɩ miliiyɔɔwaa hiu mbʋ yɔ nzɩ sɩlɩnɩ Panamaa paɣtʋ tʋmɩyɛ sɔsɔɖɛ Mossack Fonseca nɛ sɩyɛlɩ samaɣ taa kpiziɣɖe taa pɩnaɣ 2016 taa yɔ
text_en: "Panama Papers" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016.

text: Takayɩsɩ nzɩ sɩwɩlaa se liidiye kpoŋ hiu nɛ naanza sɩnɩ ñɩm tɩnaa mba pasɩ liidiye ɩ-taa yɔ nɛ pɛmɛsɩ tɔɔlaarɩwaa miiliyaarɩwaa sakɩyɛ se pɩsa nɛ pataahɛyɩ lambuu nɛ pamaanɩ paɣtʋ lɛɛtʋ yɔɔ.
text_en: The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations.

text: Krandɩ Pretaañɩ tɔm susuu takayaɣ The Guardian yɔɔdaa se liidiye kpou Deutsche Bank kaawɛnɩ ɖoŋ tʋma ɖɩlaɖɛ 1200 wena asɩnaa nɛ pɛmɛsɩ liidiye nɖɩ yɔ a-hɔɔlʋʋ tozo ñɩŋgʋ yɔɔ.
text_en: British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this.

text: Ɛyaa sakɩyɛ kaapɩɣyɩ ɛjaɖɛ kpeekpe yɔɔ, tɔm hʋʋ sakɩyɛ paɣzɩ, nɛ Ayɩsɩlandɩ nɛ Pakisitaanɩ komina ñʋndɩnaa kizi pa-tʋmɩyɛ.
text_en: There were protests worldwide, several criminal prosecutions, and the leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan both resigned.

text: Palʋlɩ Ma Hɔŋkɔŋ, nɛ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ paha-ɩ Amerika takayaɣ ʺgreen cardʺ ŋga kahaɣ-ɩ waɖɛ se ɛcaɣ ɛjaɖɛ taa tam yɔ lɛ, ɛla Harvard Paɣtʋ Sukuli Niyuu Yɔrɩkɩ Sukuli Kɩtɛzʋʋ taa.
text_en: Born in Hong Kong, Ma studied at New York University and Harvard Law School and once held an American permanent resident "green card".

text: Hsieh yeba nɛ ɛyaa maɣzɩ caca tɔʋ alɩwaatʋ taa se Ma pɩzɩɣ nɛ ɛkʋyɩ ɛjaɖɛ nɛ ese kaɖɛ alɩwaatʋ taa.
text_en: Hsieh implied during the election that Ma might flee the country during a time of crisis.

text: Hsieh yɔɔdaa ɖɔɖɔ se ɛzɩma Ma wɛ ɖeu fotonaa taa yɔ pɩlɩnɩ ɛzɩma ɛcanɩɣ ɛ-tɩ yɔ pɩ-cɔlɔ na, ɛlɛ toovenim taa lɛ ɛ-maɣmaɣ ɛfɛyɩ mbʋ.
text_en: Hsieh also argued that the photogenic Ma was more style than substance.

text: Paa palɩ ɛ-wayɩ mbʋ yɔ, Ma wabɩ kɛlɛʋ yem tɔm ɖɩyɔɔdɩyɛ mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ ɛwɩlaa se ɛñɔtɩnɩ Siini ɛjaɖɛ sɔsɔyɛ nɛ pɩkpaɖɩ.
text_en: Despite these accusations, Ma won handily on a platform advocating closer ties with the Chinese mainland.

text: Sɔnɔ Evemiye pombo maɖʋ kɛnɩ Alex Ovechkin weyi ɛlɩnɩ Wasɩŋtɔŋ Tɛtʋ Sɔsɔtʋ taa yɔ.
text_en: Today's Player of the Day is Alex Ovechkin of the Washington Capitals.

text: Ɛɖʋzɩ kpaɣla 2 nɛ ɛ-tɛ ɛsɩna nɛ paɖʋzɩ kpaɣla 2 nɛ Wasɩŋtɔŋ mba wa Atlanta Thrashers 5-3.
text_en: He had 2 goals and 2 assists in Washington's 5-3 win over the Atlanta Thrashers.

text: Kpaɣɖɛ nɖɩ Ovechkin sɩnaa nɛ pacalɩ ɖʋzʋʋ ɖoo ana yɔ, nɖɩ lɛ kpaɣɖɛ nɖɩ Nicklas Backstrom ɖʋzaa nɛ pawa maacɩ yɔ.
text_en: Ovechkin's first assist of the night was on the game-winning goal by rookie Nicklas Backstrom;

text: Kpaɣɖɛ naalɛ ñɩnɖɛ nɖɩ ɛɖʋzaa yɔ, ɖɩɩkɛ kpaɣɖɛ 60 ñɩnɖɛ nɖɩ ɛɖʋzɩ pombo pɩnaɣ ŋga yɔ, nɛ ɛpɩsɩ pombo maɖʋ kajalaɣ ñɩnʋ weyi ɛɖʋzɩ kpaɣla 60 yaa pɩcɛzɩ mbʋ pombo pɩnaɣ kʋɖʋmaɣ taa pɩkpaɣʋnɩ pɩnzɩ 1995-96 taa yɔ, alɩwaatʋ ndʋ Jaromir Jagr nɛ Mario Lemieux paaɖʋzɩ kpaɣla nɛ pɩtalɩ mbʋ yɔ.
text_en: his second goal of the night was his 60th of the season, becoming the first player to score 60 or more goals in a season since 1995-96, when Jaromir Jagr and Mario Lemieux each reached that milestone.

text: Batten kaakɛ ñɩm tʋ 190 tʋ pɩnaɣ 2008 taa ñɩm tɩnaa 400 kajalaɣ ñɩma taa nɛ pamaɣzɩɣ se ɛ-ñɩm kaatalɩ dɔɔlaarɩwaa miliiyaarɩwaa 2,3.
text_en: Batten was ranked 190th on the 2008 400 Richest Americans list with an estimated fortune of $2.3 billion.

text: Ɛɛmʋ Ajana nɛ Lɛɣtʋ Sukuli Sɔsɔʋ takayaɣ Firijinii Sukuli Kɩtɛzʋʋ taa pɩnaɣ 1950 taa nɛ ɛɛkɛ sukuli ŋgʋ kɩ-kʋjɔʋ laɖʋ sɔsɔ.
text_en: He graduated from the College of Arts & Sciences of the University of Virginia in 1950 and was a significant donor to that institution.

text: Pañaɣzɩ Iraakɩ saɖɩka Abu Ghraib miŋ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ saɖɩka tɩnaa kʋyɩ pɔ-yɔɔ cɔnɩyaa yɔɔ yɔ.
text_en: Iraq's Abu Ghraib prison has been set alight during a riot.

text: Salaka ŋgʋ kɩ-hɩɖɛ kaakɔm ɖɩsɛɛ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ pɔkɔm pana se panazaɣ salaka tɩnaa peeɖe alɩwaatʋ ndʋ Etaazuunii sɔɔjanaa cɔŋaɣnɩ salaka yɔɔ yɔ.
text_en: The jail became notorious after prisoner abuse was discovered there after US forces took over.

text: Piquet Jr. lɔɔɖɩyɛ yɔkɩ pɩnaɣ 2008 Siŋgaapuuri Grand Prix yaa lɔɔɖa seya taa alɩwaatʋ ndʋ ɛcalɩ sɩŋʋʋ se ɛɖaŋ Fernando Alonso yɔ, nɛ piyele nɛ lɔɔɖɩyɛ nɖɩ ɖɩcɔŋnɩ seya se kɛgbɛdɩsaɣ nakɛyɛ ɛtaala yɔ ɖɩlɩɩ.
text_en: Piquet Jr. crashed in the 2008 Singapore Grand Prix just after an early pit stop for Fernando Alonso, bringing out the safety car.

text: Alɩwaatʋ ndʋ lɔɔɖa wena aaɖɛ Alonso ɣɔɔ yɔ awobi se aɖʋ sanzɩ lɔɔɖɩyɛ nɖɩ ɖɩcɔŋnɩ seya yɔɔ se kɛgbɛdɩsaɣ ɛtaala yɔ ɖɩ-tɛɛ yɔ, peeɖe ɛkɔm ɛɖɛɛ a-yɔɔ nɛ ɛwa seya ana.
text_en: As the cars ahead of Alonso went in for fuel under the safety car, he moved up the pack to take victory.

text: Pese Hɔŋgiri tɛ Grand Prix pɩnaɣ 2009 nɛ pɩtɛ lɛ, pɔɖɔɔnɩ Piquet Jr.
text_en: Piquet Jr. was sacked after the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.

text: Pɩmabɩ ñɩɣtʋ 8 nɛ cɛcɛsɩ 46 ɖeyi ɖeyi lɛ, pisu ɖiɣ diɣ tɛtʋ kpeekpe taa, pɩɩkɛ alɩwaatʋe ndʋ tɩ-yɔɔ ɖeyi ɖeyi kajalaɣ ɛsɔdaa lɔɔɖɩyɛ  wobi nɛ ɖɩyɔkɩ mbʋ ɖɩɩɖʋwa se ɖɩyɔkʋʋ yɔ.
text_en: At exactly 8:46 a.m. a hush fell across the city, marking the exact moment the first jet struck its target.

text: Pakpazɩ mintʋsɩŋ nɩɩyɩ naalɛ nɛ ɛsɔdaa kiŋ ɖooo ana.
text_en: Two beams of light have been rigged up to point skywards overnight.

text: Peɖiɣni maʋ ɛsɔdaa kuduyiŋ sɔsɔŋ kagbanzɩ peeɖe, pɩtasɩnɩ nʋmɔʋ wobu tʋmɩyɛ ɖɩlaɖɛ nɛ tɔzʋʋ kaɖaɣ hɛkʋ taa.
text_en: Construction is ongoing for five new skyscrapers at the site, with a transportation center and memorial park in the middle.

text: PBS filim kaamʋ Emmy samtʋ nimee pɩcɛzɩ nɛɛlɛ nɛ naanza yɔɔ. Pɛ-tɛ filimwaa tɩɖaɣlɩ nɛ pɩtalɩ Sesame Street nɛ Mister Rogers’ Neighborhood.
text_en: The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.

text: Paa filim hɔɔlʋʋ ŋgʋ lɛ kɩkaɣ ñɩɣʋ niye takayaɣ nakɛyɛ taa tɔm ñʋʋ nakʋyʋ yɔɔ nɛ pʋwayɩ lɛ kɩtazɩ ñʋʋ ŋgʋ kɩ-taa pɩtɩŋnɩ kɛdɛsɩ ndɩ ndɩ yɔɔ
text_en: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.

text: Paa filim ŋgʋ lɛ, kɩkaɣ tasʋʋ lɔŋ pɩlɩɩnɩ takayɩsɩ nzɩ pɩwɛɛ se piya ɩñɩnɩ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ siwoki takayɩsɩ ɖɩzɩyɛ yɔ.
text_en: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.

text: John Grant weyi ɛlɩnɩ WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow ɖɩlɩyɛ) yɔ ɛyɔɔdaa : « Reading Rainbow kpɛlɩkɩɣ piya tɔm kalʋʋ,…se sɩsɔɔlɩ tɔm kalʋʋ-- piseɣtiɣ piya se sɩkpaɣ takayaɣ nɛ sɩkalɩ-kɛ.»
text_en: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: Nabɛyɛ maɣzɩɣ halɩ pɩkpɛndɩnɩ John Grant se ɛzɩma liidiye tɔsʋʋ ɖʋ lɩm nɛ ɛzɩma pɛlɛɣzɩ teelee yɔɔ wɩlɩtʋ yɔ pɩsɩnaa nɛ teelee yɔɔ seeriiwaa sɩɩ tɩnaɣ
text_en: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: Ɛsɔdaa wɛtʋ cɔŋɩyaa yɔɔdaa se helim tɛʋ sɔsɔʋ kaaposini Kapɩ Vɛɛrɩ lɩm hɛkʋ taa tɛtʋ wɩsɩ ɖɩɖʋyɛ hɔɔlʋʋ ɛzɩ kilomɛtanaa 1040 mbʋ yɔ, nɛ pɩtʋʋ fɛyɩ se kɩkaɣ fɛʋ pʋcɔ nɛ kɩtalɩ kedeŋa hɔɔlʋʋ taa.
text_en: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text: Lɛɛlɛɛyɔ Fred helim seɣ nɛ pɩtalɩ miles waa 105 paa ñɩɣyʋʋ ŋgʋ (165 km/h) nɛ piwokini hayo wɩsɩ ɖɩɖʋyɛ hɔɔlʋʋ taa kiŋ.
text_en: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

text: Fred kɛnɩ tɛʋ helim sɔsɔm mbʋ pɩwɛ ɖoŋ nɛ pɩkpaɖɩ yɔ Atɩlantiiki  hadɛ kiŋ nɛ wɩsɩ ɖɩlɩyɛ taa kiŋ ɖooo pɩkpaɣʋnɩ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ sateeliitinaa paɣzɩ cɛbʋ fotonaa nɛ ɛsɔdaa yɔ, nɛ pɩkɛnɩ tɛʋ helim sɔsɔm tozo ñɩmbʋ mbʋ pana 35°W. wɩsɩ ɖɩlɩyɛ taa yɔ.
text_en: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

text: Salaŋ fenaɣ 1759 taa Arthur Guinness ñɩɣ nesi takayaɣ taa se ɛlakɩ haya pɩnzɩ 9000 St James’Gate sʋlʋm ɖibuye nɖɩ ɖɩwɛ Tubɩlɛɛ, Irilandɩ Ɛjaɖɛ taa yɔ.
text_en: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.

text: Pɩlabɩ pɩnzɩ 250 pʋwayɩ lɛ, Guinness pɩsɩ ɛjaɖɛ kpeekpe yɔɔ tadɩyɛ nɖɩ ɖɩlakɩnɩ tʋmɩyɛ Erɔɔpɩ liidiye pɩcɛzɩ miiliyaarɩwaa 10 (US$14,7 miiliyaarɩwaa) paa pɩnaɣ ŋga.
text_en: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text: Jonny Reid weyi ɛkɛ lɔɔɖɩyɛ sayʋ naalɛ tʋ A1GP Niyuu Seelandɩ ɛgbɛyɛ taa yɔ, sɔnɔ ɛ-hɩɖɛ sɛwa mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ ɛsa lɔɔɖɩyɛ lɛɛ lɛɛ nɛ pɩkpaɖɩ Auckland Harbour kondoloko Niyuu Seelandɩ, ŋgʋ kɩwɛnɩ pɩnzɩ 48 yɔ kɩ-yɔɔ.
text_en: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Đajaa Reid ñaɣ pana nɛ ɛsaa Niyuu Seelandɩ lɔɔɖɩyɛ A1GP, Black Beauty nɛ e-seya cɛzɩ kilomɛtanaa 160 paa ñɩɣyʋʋ ŋgʋ tam lʋbɛ kondoloko yɔɔ.
text_en: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: Pɩɩlabɩ Niyuu Seelandɩ polisi kaɖɛ se palabɩnɩ pɛ-tɛ menziini ŋgʋ kɩnaɣ seya yɔ nɛ pana ɛzɩma Đajaa Reid kaawɛ eseɣ yɔ mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ  Black Beauty kaatibi tataa, nɛ tam kʋyʋma mbʋ polisi pɩzaa nɛ kɩna ɛzɩma eseɣ yɔ lɛ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ ɛpasɩ e-seya nɛ pɩmaɣnɩ kilomɛtanaa 160 paa ñɩɣyʋʋ ŋgʋ yɔ.
text_en: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: Fenasɩ naadozo nzɩ sɩɖɛwa yɔ sɩ-taa, peyebi ɛyaa mba paakpawa nɛ pɩcɛzɩ 80 nɛ pɛwɛɛ Central Booking taa ɛlɛ patiheyi-wɛ ndʋ pɛwɛɛka yɔ.
text_en: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: Đomaɣ fenaɣ taa pɩnaɣ kanɛ, Tɔm Hʋyʋ Glynn lɩzɩ paɣtʋ nɛ pitukuuni salaka cikpeluu ŋgʋ se ɛyaa mba pakpa-wɛ nɛ pasɩɩ peeɖe nɛ pɩcɛzɩ ñɩɣtʋ 24 nɛ patɩpɩzɩ pana polisi ñʋʋdʋ se ewelisini-wɛ yɔ pʋpɔzʋʋ se peyebi-wɛ.
text_en: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: Ye paha nʋmɔʋ yɔ, polisi ñʋʋdʋ lakɩ takayaɣ nɛ pɛhɛyɩ liidiye nɖɩ pʋpɔzʋʋ pʋcɔ nɛ peyele nɔɔyʋ yɔ, nɛ ɛñɩɣ nesi tɔm ndʋ polisi weyi ɛkpa pʋdʋ yɔ ɛmawa yɔ tɩ-yɔɔ. Pʋwayɩ lɛ, paɖʋ tɔm ndʋ pama pʋdʋ yɔɔ yɔ ɛjaɖɛ tɛ ordinaatɛɛrɩ yɔɔ ɖenɖe pɔcɔŋnɩ tɔm ndʋ tɩ-yɔɔ yɔ.
text_en: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: Kɩyakʋ ŋgʋ pewelisiɣ tɔm hʋʋ yɔ puwiye kɛnɩ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ papaɣzɩɣ hʋʋ weyi powoni-i tɔm ɖɩhʋyɛ yɔ ɛ-tɔm lɛɛ lɛɛ.
text_en: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text: Peter Costello weyi ɛkɛ Ositralii ñɩm tɔsʋʋ yɔɔ cɔnɩyʋ nɛ weyi ɛkaɣ lɛɣzʋʋ Minisi Kajalaɣ Ñɩnʋ John Howard nɛ ɛpɩsɩ Liberal politiki ɛgbɛyɛ ñʋʋdʋ yɔ, ɛwɩlaa se ɛɖʋʋ nesi niikileyɛɛrɩ ɖoŋ tʋmɩyɛ naɖɩyɛ Ositralii.
text_en: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Đajaa Costello yɔɔdaa se alɩwaatʋ ndʋ niikileyɛɛzɩ ɖoŋ kaɣ wazʋʋ tɔsʋʋ yɔ, Ositralii kaɣ wobu pɩ-yɔɔ nɛ ɖɩlakɩnɩ-ɩ tʋmɩyɛ.
text_en: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: Đajaa Costello yɔɔdaa se : ʺYe papɩzɩɣ nɛ pɛpɛdɩ niikileyɛɛrɩ ɖoŋ,kɔyɔ, ɖɩnɛ ɛlɛ pʋpɔzʋʋ se ɖɩwɛɛnɩ-ɩ. Nɛ ɖiikiziɣ niikileyɛɛrɩ ɖoŋ yem se pɔtɔma se pekizi-i.ʺ
text_en: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text: Ansa yɔɔdaa se : ʺPolisi kaawɛ kiseɣ sɔɔndʋ mbʋ pʋyɔɔ ɛzɩma kɩkʋ pa-ñʋndɩnaa sɔsaa nabɛyɛ pazɩ yɔ pɩpɩzɩɣ nɛ piyele nɛ pɩkɔnɩ you sɔsɔʋ se palɩzɩ ñʋndɩnaa kɩfama.
text_en: According to Ansa, "police were concerned by a couple of top-level hits they feared might spark a full-blown war of succession.

text: Polisi yɔɔdaa se Lo Piccolo kaaɖɛnɩ nɔɔ mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ ɛnʋ kaakɛnɩ Provenzano taabalʋ sɔsɔ Palɛrɩmo peeɖe nɛ ɛzɩma ɛkpɛlɩkɩ lɔŋ pɩɖɔɔ yɔ pʋyɔɔ lɛ, kɩbaɣlaa kɩbɩma ñaŋaɣ-ɩ, kɩbaɣlaa mba paawɛ pɔɖɔŋ Provenzano nɩŋgbanzɩ taa nɛ poluzuu pa-tɩ sakɩyɛ nɛ pakpazɩɣ ɖoŋ ɛgbɛyɛ.
text_en: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.

text: Provenzano kaawɛnɩ ɖoŋ kɩbaɣlaa mba pɔ-yɔɔ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ ɛsɩnzɩ you ŋgʋ Riina kaawɛ ɛlakɩnɩ ɛjaɖɛ yɔ, nɛ you ŋgʋ kiiyeba Mafiya taa yoyaa Giovanni Falcone nɛ Paolo Borsellini pelesi pe-weziŋ pɩnaɣ 1992 taa.ʺ
text_en: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

text: Apple Tʋmɩyɛ Ñʋʋdʋ Steve Jobs lɩzɩ wonuu ŋgʋ nɛ ɛwɩlɩ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ ɛlɩwaɣ samaɣ ɛsɩndaa nɛ ɛlɛkɩ ɛ-pantalaʋ jeans kabʋa taa nɛ ɛlɩzɩ iPhone yɔ.
text_en: Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device by walking onto the stage and taking the iPhone out of his jeans pocket.

text: Ñɩɣtʋ 2 tɔm ndʋ ɛyɔɔdaa yɔ tɩ-taa, ɛtɔm se : ʺSɔnɔ Apple ɖaɣnɩɣ lɩzʋʋ kaŋgalaafu kɩfalʋʋ, ɖɩlizɩɣ pʋyʋ kɩfalʋ weyi ɛyaa tɩna wiɖiyi pe-wezuu caɣʋ taa yɔ sɔnɔ.ʺ
text_en: During his 2 hour speech he stated that "Today Apple is going to reinvent the phone, We are going to make history today".

text: Preeziili kɛnɩ Roma Katoliki mba ɛjaɖɛ sɔsɔyɛ Tɛtʋ yɔɔ, nɛ Roma Katoliki Cooci kizi kpem se paɣtʋ ɛtaaha nʋmɔʋ ɛyaa mba paka kʋzʋʋ pilinzi yɔ se pɔɖɔkɩ nesi ɛjaɖɛ nɖɩ ɖɩ-taa.
text_en: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text: Preeziili Paɣtʋ Lɩzɩyaa hɔm tɔm se paɣtʋ ɛha nʋmɔʋ pɩnzɩ 10 nɛ mba paka kʋzʋʋ pilinzi yɔ pɔɖɔkɩ nesi, nɛ Rio Grande do Sul ɖeke palakɩ nesi ɖɔkʋʋ mbʋ komina lone taa caɣyaa ɛsɩndaa.
text_en: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.

text: Sao Paulo maalika yɔɔ cɔnɩyʋ kɩbɩnʋ Marta Suplicy manɩ paɣtʋ takayaɣ kajalaɣ ñɩŋga. Pɔñɔɔzɩ paɣtʋ takayaɣ ŋga nɛ pɩtɛ lɛ, lɛɛlɛɛyɔ lɛ kɛwɛ Roberto Jefferson nesi tɛɛ.
text_en: The original bill was drafted by former mayor of São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. The proposed legislation, after being amended, is now in the hands of Roberto Jefferson.

text: Mba pakʋyɩ tɔm yɔɔ yɔ pataɣ liu se pakaɣ hiɣu ɛyaa miiliyɔɔwaa 1,2 mba pañɩɣ nesi se patɩnɩɣ pɔ-tɔm yɔɔ yɔ nɛ paɖʋ Paɣtʋ Lɩzɩyaa ɛsɩndaa Kamɩŋ fenaɣ taa.
text_en: Protesters hope to collect a petition of 1.2 million signatures to present to the National Congress in November.

text: Pɩkɔm nɛ pɩna se hɔŋ sakɩyɛ kaawɛɛ nɛ ɩñɩnɩɣ se pasɩnɩ-ɩ nɛ ɩlʋbɩnɩ ɛzɩma palɩzɩɣ-ɩ ɖɩsɩ lɛ, pala kediɣzaɣ nakɛyɛ Lakɩŋ fenaɣ kɩyakʋ 20 wiye East Bay Community Law Center taa se pasɩnɩ mbʋ pomuluu-wɛ ɖɩzʋyɛ ñɩnʋʋ nʋmɔʋ taa yɔ.
text_en: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.

text: Alɩwaatʋ ndʋ haya tɩnaa paɣzɩ kɛdʋʋ mbʋ pɩtalɩ-wɛ yɔ, peeɖe hɔŋ sakɩyɛ weyi ɩɩwɛ wɛtʋ ndʋ tɩ-taa yɔ iɖiɣzina se Carolyn Wilson mɩlɩ liidiye nɖɩ paasɩ ɛ-cɔlɔ se pɩkandɩyɩ pa-haya yɔɔ yɔ nɛ ɛkʋyɩ tɛtʋ taa nɛ ese.
text_en: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text: Haya tɩnaa mba pɛwɛ Lockwood Garden yɔ, pamaɣzɩɣ se pʋtɔma pakaɣ ɖɔɔnʋʋ hɔŋ 40 lɛɛŋ yaa pɩcɛzɩ mbʋ pa-ɖamɩŋ taa, mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ panɩwa se OHA polisi ɖiɣni ñɩnʋʋ tɔm komina kuduyiŋ weyi ɩwɛ Oakland yɔ ɩ-yɔɔ nɛ pʋtɔma ɩwɛ ɖɔɖɔ ɖɩzʋyɛ mulum tɔm ndʋ tɩ-taa.
text_en: Tenants at Lockwood Gardens believe that there may be another 40 families or more to face eviction, since they learned that OHA police are also investigating other public housing properties in Oakland that may be caught up in the housing scam.

text: Aleɣya ɛgbɛyɛ tɩtasɩ labʋ aleɣya wena paaɖʋwa se palakɩ Maui’s War Memorial Stadium yɔ, paaɖʋwa se ɛyaa 9000 kaɣ kɔm nɛ pɔcɔnɩ aleɣya ana, pʋyɔɔ ɛgbɛyɛ tendi mba pɔkɔŋaɣ cɔnʋʋ yɔ.
text_en: The band canceled the show at Maui's War Memorial Stadium, which was set to be attended by 9,000 people, and apologized to fans.

text: Tʋmɩyɛ nɖɩ ɖɩcɔŋnɩ aleɣya ɛgbɛyɛ nɖɩ ɖɩ-yɔɔ nɛ payaɣ-ɖɩ se HK management Inc. yɔ, kiɖe tɛɛ lɛ ɖɩtɩyɔɔdɩ mbʋ pʋyɔɔ patɩla aleɣya Salaŋ fenaɣ kɩyakʋ 20 wiye yɔ, ɛlɛ tɛʋ fema lɛ pɔyɔɔdɩ se pɩlɩnɩ menziiniwaa cɔlɔ.
text_en: The band's management company, HK Management Inc., gave no initial reason when they canceled on September 20, but blamed logistical reasons by the next day.

text: Paɖɩɣ Grɛɛkɩ lɔyaawaa Saki Kechagioglou nɛ George Nikolakopoulos, mba pa-hɩɖɛ sɛwa yɔ Atɛɛnɩ salaka Korydallus taa mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ pamɩlaa nɛ pomuli.
text_en: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

text: Mbʋ pɩlɩ pɩ-taa yɔ lɛ se pɩkɔnɩ kigiluu tɔm Grɛɛkɩ paɣtʋ yɔɔ cɔnɩyaa samaɣ yɔɔ pɩlɩɩnɩ lakasɩ kɩdɛkɛdasɩ nzɩ tɔm hʋyaa, lɔyaawaa, lɔyaawaa sɩnɩyaa nɛ komina lɔyaawaa labɩ pɩnzɩ nzɩ sɩɖɛwa yɔ sɩ-taa.
text_en: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text: Tɔm susuyu Makis Triantafylopoulos yɔɔdɩ tɔm ndʋ ɛ-tɛ teelee yɔɔ ɖʋtʋ ʺZounglaʺ ndʋ ɛyaa sakɩyɛ sɔɔlɩ cɔnʋʋ Alpha TV yɔɔ yɔ nɛ pɩla kpɩtaŋ pazɩ lɛ, paɣtʋ lɩzɩyʋ nɛ tɔm hʋyʋ Petros Mantouvalos kizi ɛ-tʋmɩyɛ mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ ɛ-tʋmɩyɛ taa mba  kaawɛ mba pamɩlaa nɛ pomuli yɔ pa-taa.
text_en: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

text: Pɩtasɩ lɛ, paɖɩɣ tɔm hʋyʋ sɔsɔ Evangelos Kalousi salaka mbʋ pʋyɔɔ ɛnʋ ɖɔɖɔ emulaa nɛ ɛla tɛtɛ lakasɩ.
text_en: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text: Roberts kizi kpem se ɛyɔɔdʋʋ ɛzɩmtaa wezuu paɣzɩɣ yɔ, pɩkɛ tɔm kɩcɛyɩtʋ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ paayɔɔdʋʋ mbʋ pɩwɛ ɖeu nɛ mbʋ pɩfɛyɩ ɖeu hosi lɩzʋʋ nʋmɔʋ taa yɔ, nɛ ɛtɔŋ se pɩɩwɛɣ ɖeu se ɛyɔɔdɩ tɔm tete paa wɛtʋ ndʋ lɛ tɩ-yɔɔ.
text_en: Roberts flatly refused to say about when he believes life begins, an important question when considering the ethics of abortion, saying that it would be unethical to comment on the specifics of likely cases.

text: Paa mbʋ yɔ, ɛtasɩ yɔɔdʋʋ ɛ-kajalaɣ tɔm se pasɩ Roe v. Wade se ɛkɛ ʺɛjaɖɛ taa paɣtʋʺ nɛ ɛñɩɣ niye se pɩcɛyaa se Tɔm Đɩhʋyɛ Sɔsɔyɛ kpakɩɣ lɩmaɣza wena yɔ nɔɔ kʋɖʋmaɣ ɛwɛɛ a-hɛkʋ taa.
text_en: He did, however, reiterate his earlier statement that Roe v. Wade was the "settled law of the land", emphasizing the importance of consistent Supreme Court rulings.

text: Ɛtasɩ ñɩɣʋ niye ɖɔɖɔ se etisiɣ ɛyʋ mɛɛsaɣ tɛ wezuu kandɩyʋʋ waɖɛ yɔɔ nɖɩ ɖɩ-taa palɩzɩnɩ Roe tɔm hʋʋ lɩmaɣza yɔ.
text_en: He also confirmed that he believed in the implied right to privacy which the Roe decision depended upon.

text: Maroochydore kaaɖɛnɩ nɔɔ, nɛ ɛɛcɛzɩ Noosa weyi ɛkɛ naalɛ tʋ yɔ nɛ kɩyala loɖo.
text_en: Maroochydore had finished on top of the ladder, six points clear of Noosa in second.

text: Pa-naalɛ paataa pʋcɔ nɛ pama Kɛdɛzaɣ maacɩ nɛ peeɖe Noosa wabɩ nɛ kɩyalaa 11.
text_en: The two sides would meet in the major semi final where Noosa ran out winners by 11 points.

text: Maroochydore wa Caboolture pʋwayɩ Kɛdɛzaɣ maacɩ taa.
text_en: Maroochydore then defeated Caboolture in the Preliminary Final.

text: Hesperonychus elizabethae kɛ Dromaeosauridae hɔʋ taa kpɩnɛ naɖɩyɛ nɛ ɖɩñɔtɩnɩ Velociraptor.
text_en: Hesperonychus elizabethae is a species of the family Dromaeosauridae and is a cousin of Velociraptor .

text: Pɩkɛ sumaɣ ŋga kakpaɣ nandʋ yɔ nɛ kɛwɛnɩ keŋ nɛ ka-calɩm saa miŋ, pamaɣzɩɣ se kasɩŋaɣ ka-nɩŋgbanzɩ yɔɔ nɛ kɔɖɔŋ nɛ kaawɛnɩ cɩkpaŋ ɛzɩ Velociraptor yɔ.
text_en: This fully feathered, warm blooded bird of prey was believed to have walked upright on two legs with claws like the Velociraptor.

text: Ɛ-cɩkpalʋʋ naalɛ ñɩŋgʋ kaakɩlɩnɩ paɣlʋʋ, pʋyɔɔ pakʋm-kɛ hɩɖɛ se Hesperonychus, pʋ-tɔbʋʋ lɛ se ʺwɩsɩ ɖɩɖʋyɛ taa cɩkpalʋʋ.ʺ
text_en: Its second claw was larger, giving rise to the name Hesperonychus which means "western claw."

text: Pɩtasɩnɩ ɖɔmbɛɛ wena aayɔkaa nɛ akaa yɔ lɛ, ɛzɩma ɛjaɖɛ yɔɔ wɛtʋ kaawɛɛkɩ siŋŋ yɔ, piyeba nɛ pɩla sɩnʋʋ tʋmɩyɛ kaɖɛ.
text_en: In addition to the crushing ice, extreme weather conditions have been hampering rescue efforts.

text: Pittman yɔɔdaa se pʋtɔma yɔ ɛjaɖɛ yɔɔ wɛtʋ ɛɛkaɣ ñɔɔzʋʋ pɩkɔɔ pɩtalɩ kpɩtaʋ ŋgʋ kɩkɔŋ yɔ.
text_en: Pittman suggested that conditions wouldn't improve until sometime next week.

text: Ɛzɩ Pittman yɔɔdʋʋ yɔ, ɛzɩma ɖɔmbɛɛ wena atɔlaa yɔ aɖɔwa nɛ akpɩndɩyɩ tataa yɔ, pɩcɛzɩ mbʋ payɩ ɖɔmbɛɛ yɔɔ ñaɖɛ agbamaa kaanawa pɩnzɩ 15 nzɩ sɩɖɛwa yɔ sɩ-taa.
text_en: The amount and thickness of the pack ice, according to Pittman, is the worst it has been for sealers in the past 15 years.

text: Tɔm yɛlɩ Rɛdɩ Lakɩ egeetiye taa sɔnɔ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ pepiŋaɣ Jeff Weise nɛ ɛyaa nakʋ mba pakʋwa yɔ pa-taa naadozo yɔ se patasɩ kpaʋ sukulibɩɣa nakɛyɛ malɩfanaa mba pɔtɔ sukuli taa Lakɩŋ fenaɣ kɩyakʋ 21 wiye yɔ kɩ-nʋmɔʋ taa.
text_en: News spread in the Red Lake community today as funerals for Jeff Weise and three of the nine victims were held that another student was arrested in connection with the school shootings of March 21.

text: Ɛjaɖɛ ñʋndɩnaa tɩyɔɔdɩ tɔm caaa pɩtasɩna se pañɩɣ niye se pakpa ɛyʋ sɔnɔ.
text_en: Authorities said little officially beyond confirming today's arrest.

text: Paa mbʋ yɔ, nɔɔyʋ ñɔtɩnɩ tɔm ñɩnɩyaa yɔ nɛ eheyi Minneapolis Star-Tribune se payaɣ abalɩbɩɣa ŋga se Louis Jourdain nɛ kɛwɛnɩ pɩnzɩ 16 nɛ kɛkɛ Rɛdɩ Lakɩ cejewiye taa nɔɔ ɖɛyʋ Floyd Jourdain pɩyalʋ.
text_en: However, a source with knowledge of the investigation told the Minneapolis Star-Tribune that it was Louis Jourdain, 16-year old son of Red Lake Tribal Chairman Floyd Jourdain.

text: Alɩwaatʋ tʋnɛ patɩnata se tɔm ndʋ pakaɣ-ɩ hʋnʋʋ yaa ɛbɛ yeba nɛ ɛjaɖɛ ñʋndɩnaa kpa abalɩbɩɣa ŋga ɛlɛ papaɣzɩ ñɔɔzʋʋ ndʋ pahʋʋnɩ piya yɔ tɔm hʋʋ kʋjɔŋ sɔsɔʋ tɛɛ.
text_en: It is not known at this time what charges will be laid or what led authorities to the boy but juvenile proceedings have begun in federal court.

text: Lodin yɔɔdaa ɖɔɖɔ se ñʋndɩnaa kpaɣ lɩmaɣza se paatasɩɣ labʋ caca hɔɔlʋʋ naalɛ ñɩŋgʋ se pɩsa nɛ Afiganistaanɩ mba ɛtaawɛɛkɩ liidiye nɛ pɩtasɩ-wɛ kɔnʋʋ kaɖɛ pɛɛyɛ nʋmɔʋ taa.
text_en: Lodin also said officials decided to cancel the runoff in order to save Afghans the expense and security risk of another election.

text: Ajɛɛ lone taa caɣyaa yɔɔdaa se pana tɔm sakɩyɛ ndʋ tɩ-taa wɛ cɩkpɛndʋʋ yɔ Afiganistaanɩ mba paɣtʋ sɔsɔtʋ taa, nɛ pɩwɩlɩɣ se pɩtɩcɛyɩ se pala caca hɔɔlʋʋ naalɛ ñɩŋgʋ.
text_en: Diplomats said that they had found enough ambiguity in the Afghan constitution to determine the runoff as unnecessary.

text: Pɩkaɖɩɣnɩ tɔm lɛɛtʋ ndʋ paayɔɔdaa nɛ pɩɖɛɛ yɔ se ye patɩtɔ caca hɔɔlʋʋ naalɛ ñɩŋgʋ yɔ pɩmaɣnɩ paɣtʋ sɔsɔtʋ yɔɔ yɔ.
text_en: This contradicts earlier reports, which said that cancelling the runoff would have been against the constitution.

text: Ɛsɔdaa lɔɔɖɩyɛ kaawɛɛ ɖɩɖɛɣnɩ Irkutsk kiŋ nɛ sɔɔjanaa mba paawɛ ɛjaɖɛ taa mba lakaɣnɩ-kʋ tʋmɩyɛ.
text_en: The aircraft had been headed to Irkutsk and was being operated by interior troops.

text: Paɖʋ ɛyaa se patazɩ mbʋ pɩlaba yɔ pɩ-taa.
text_en: An inquiry was established to investigate.

text: Il-76 kɛ Rusii nɛ Soviyetiki sɔɔjanaa wonuu sɔsɔʋ nakʋyʋ kpaɣnɩ pɩnzɩ 1970 waa taa, nɛ kɩɩtɛm hiɣu kɛgbɛdɩsaɣ sɔsɔɔ nakɛyɛ Rusii ɛjaɖɛ taa fenaɣ ŋga kɛɖɛwa yɔ, ka-taa.
text_en: The Il-76 has been a major component of both the Russian and Soviet military since the 1970s, and had already seen a serious accident in Russia last month.

text: Aloma fenaɣ kɩyakʋ 7 ŋgʋ wiye aŋjin nakʋyʋ pɛlaa alɩwaatʋ ndʋ ɛsɔdaa lɔɔɖɩyɛ kʋyaɣ yɔ, ɛlɛ pɩtɩkʋ nɔɔyʋ. Rusii kizi alɩwaatʋ pazɩ se Il-76 waa ɩtaatasɩ kʋyʋʋ kɛgbɛdɩsaɣ ŋga ka-wayɩ.
text_en: On October 7 an engine separated on takeoff, without injuries. Russia briefly grounded Il-76s after that accident.

text: Sanzɩ baril waa kudokiŋ sakɩyɛ kpɛdɩ Fairbanks hadɛ kiŋ, Alaska taa nɛ pɩtɛ lɛ, paɖɩɣ Trans-Alaska tɛtɛɛ nʋmɔʋ ŋgʋ kɩ-taa sanzɩ tɩŋʋʋ yɔ miles waa 800.
text_en: 800 miles of the Trans-Alaska Pipeline System were closed down following a spill of thousands of barrels of crude oil south of Fairbanks, Alaska.

text: Pamaɣzaɣ ɛzɩma popuzuu miŋ ɛzɩ patɩɩlakʋʋ yɔ lɛ, latriki wɛɛkɩ nɛ pɩtʋlɩ sanzɩ ɖɩzɩyɛ nɔnɔsɩ nasɩyɩ nɛ sanzɩ wadɩ nɛ pɩkpɛdɩ Fort Greely ɖenɖe pɔhɔŋ sanzɩ 9 ñɩŋgʊ yɔ pɩ-cɔlɔ.
text_en: A power failure following a routine fire-command system test caused relief valves to open and crude oil overflowed near the Fort Greely pump station 9.

text: Nɔnɔsɩ tʋlaa nɛ hohou ɖoŋ lɩɩ nɛ sanzɩ kpe tampɔŋ nakʋyʋ yɔɔ nɛ pitii ŋgbɔʋ sɔsɔʋ ŋgʋ kɩpɩzɩɣ nɛ kɩmʋ baril waa 55 000 yɔ kɩ-taa (gallon waa miiliyɔɔwaa 2,3)
text_en: The valves opening allowed a pressure release for the system and oil flowed on a pad to a tank that can hold 55,000 barrels (2.3 million gallons).

text: Cɩla wɩsɩ wɛlʋʋ, sanzɩ kaawɛɛ pɩkpɛdɩɣnɩ ŋgbɔʋ sɔsɔʋ ŋgʋ kɩ-nɔɔ yɔɔ mbʋ, pʋtɔma yɔ pɩlɩnɩ ɛzɩma sanzɩ kaasa miŋ nɛ pihuu ŋgbɔʋ taa yɔ pɩ-cɔlɔ.
text_en: As of Wednesday afternoon, the tank vents were still leaking probably from thermal expansion inside the tank.

text: Ŋgbɔʋ lɛɛkʋ kaawɛ kajalaɣ ŋgbɔʋ sɔsɔʋ tɛɛ nɛ kɩpɩzɩɣ kɩmʋ baril waa 104 500, nɛ kitaasuti yɛlɩ.
text_en: Another secondary containment area below the tanks capable of holding 104,500 barrels was not yet filled to capacity.

text: Tɔm ndʋ pɔyɔɔdɩ teelee yɔ ɛyaa ɛsɩndaa ndʋ kaakɛnɩ kajalaɣ ɖeɖe Iraanɩ ɛjaɖɛ taa ɛyʋ sɔsɔ nɔɔyʋ tisiɣ se ɛzɩma pohɔŋ pa-nɩŋgbaŋʋʋ yɔ pɩwɛ pɩcakɩ pɔ-yɔɔ.
text_en: The comments, live on television, were the first time that senior Iranian sources have admitted that the sanctions are having any effect.

text: Nɩŋgbaŋʋʋ hɔm mbʋ pɩ-taa nabʋyʋ kɛlɛ liidiye nʋmɔŋ ɖɩɣʋ nɛ ɛzɩma Erɔɔpɩ Ajɛɛ Đama Nɩnʋʋ kizaa se aatasɩɣ yabʋ sanzɩ ŋgʋ patɩcatɩta yɔ, ŋgʋ sanzɩ pɛdʋʋ yekina nɛ Iraanɩ tɔsʋʋ hikiɣ ñɩm mbʋ pɩlɩɣnɩ agbaɣdaa yɔ 80%.
text_en: They include financial restrictions and a ban by the European Union on the export of crude oil, from which the Iranian economy receives 80% of its foreign income.

text: OPEC yɔɔdɩ kɛdɛzaɣ fenaɣ takayaɣ ŋga palɩzaa yɔ ka-taa se sanzɩ tadɩyɛ tibi kpem nɛ pɩtali ɛzɩ baril waa miiliyɔɔ waa 2,8 paa evemiye nɖɩ; nɛ patɩna mbʋ nɛ pana pɩnzɩ nɛɛlɛ nzɩ sɩɖɛwa yɔ sɩ-taa.
text_en: In its most recent monthly report, OPEC said exports of crude had fallen to their lowest level for two decades at 2.8 million barrels per day.

text: Ɛjaɖɛ ɖiyiyu sɔsɔ Ayatollah Ali Khamenei yɔɔdaa se ɛzɩma pakɩlɩɣ taʋ liu sanzɩ pɛdʋʋ yɔ pɩkɛ ʺkpacaʺ ŋgʋ pɔtɔlɩ kɩ-taa kpaɣnɩ Malɩŋ tɛ Iraanɩ lɛɣzɩtʋ pɩnaɣ 1979 taa nɛ pʋpɔzʋʋ se ɛjaɖɛ eholi ɖɩ-tɩ yomiye nɖɩ ɖɩ-taa.
text_en: The country's supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, has described the dependency on oil as "a trap" dating from before Iran's Islamic revolution in 1979 and from which the country should free itself.

text: Alɩwaatʋ ndʋ tɩɩnzɩ taa wobu lɔɔɖɩyɛ sʋʋ helim mbʋ pɩcɔ tɛtʋ nɛ pɩta yɔ pɩ-taa yɔ, ñɩɣtʋ 5 tanaŋ tɛɛ (wɩsɩ ɖɩlɩyɛ taa alɩwaatʋ) yɔ, paɖaŋaa se ɖɩla nɛ miŋ nɩɩyɩ mɩzɩ ɛsɔdaa nɛ ɛyaa mba pɛwɛ Hayo Kiŋ Kalifɔrnɩ, Oregon, Nevada nɛ Utah yɔ pana-ɩ.
text_en: When the capsule gets to Earth and enters the atmosphere, at about 5am (eastern time), it is expected to put on quite a light show for folks in Northern California, Oregon, Nevada, and Utah.

text: Tɩɩnzɩ taa wobu lɔɔɖɩyɛ nɖɩ ɖɩkaɣ wɛʋ ɛzɩ tɩɩŋa ŋga kɛkpɛzaa nɛ keseɣ ɛsɔdaa yɔ.
text_en: The capsule will look much like a shooting star going across the sky.

text: Tɩɩnzɩ taa wobu lɔɔɖɩyɛ nɖɩ ɖɩkaɣ seu nɛ pɩtalɩ km 12,8 yaa miles waa 8 paa kɛlɛm ŋgʋ, nɛ ɛzɩma ɖiseɣ lɛɛ lɛɛ kpem yɔ ɖɩkaɣ kpaɣʋ cɛcɛyaɣ kʋɖʋmaɣ nɛ kɔɖɔmnɩ San Francisco nɛ katalɩ Los Angeles.
text_en: The capsule will be traveling at about 12.8 km or 8 miles per second, fast enough to go from San Francisco to Los Angeles in one minute.

text: Stardust kaɣ kɛʋ tɩɩnzɩ taa wobu lɔɔɖɩyɛ nɖɩ ɖɩkɩlɩɣ seu ɛyaa wezuu caɣʋ taa nɛ ɖɩlɩnɩ ɛsɔdaa nɛ ɖɩpɩsɩ Tɛtʋ yɔɔ, nɛ ɖi-seya cɛzɩ mbʋ pɩlabɩ Agoza fenaɣ 1969 taa alɩwaatʋ ndʋ Apollo X tɩɩnzɩ taa lɔɔɖɩyɛ pɩsaɣ yɔ.
text_en: Stardust will set a new all-time record for being the fastest spacecraft to return to Earth, breaking the previous record set in May of 1969 during the return of the Apollo X command module.

text: Tom Duxbury weyi ɛkɛ Stardust lɔɔɖɩyɛ cɔnɩyʋ yɔ ɛyɔɔdaa se : ʺĐɩkaɣ ɖɔm Kakʋlifɔrnɩ Hayo Kiŋ tɛ wɩsɩ ɖɩlɩyɛ taa teŋgʋ kidiiliŋ ñʋʋ yɔɔ nɛ ɖɩkaɣ ñandʋʋ ɛsɔdaa kpaɣnɩ Kalifɔrnɩ nɛ piwolo Oregon hɛkʋ taa nɛ Nevada nɛ Idaho nɛ Utah.ʺ
text_en: “It will move over the west coast of northern California and will light the sky from California through central Oregon and on through Nevada and Idaho and into Utah,” Tom Duxbury, Stardust's project manager said.

text: Mr Rudd kpaɣ lɩmaɣzɩyɛ nɖɩ se ɛñɩkɩɣ nesi Kyoto ɖama nɩnʋʋ ɛjaɖɛ wɛtʋ yɔɔ takayaɣ taa yɔ, ɖiyeba nɛ pɩkazɩ Etaazuunii ɖeke, lɛɛlɛɛyɔ nɖɩ kɛnɩ ñɩm ɛjaɖɛ nɖɩ ɖɩkazaa se ɖɩtɩñɩɣ nesi takayaɣ ŋga ka-taa.
text_en: Mr. Rudd's decision to sign the Kyoto climate accord isolates the United States, which will now be the only developed nation not to ratify the agreement.

text: Ositraalii tɛ kɔnsɛɛrɩvatɛɛrɩwaa komina kɩbɩnʋʋ kaakizaa se kɩɩñɩkɩɣ nesi Kyoto takayaɣ taa nɛ kɩyɔɔdɩ se pɩkaɣ wɛɛkʋʋ tɔsʋʋ mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ aka pakɩlɩɣ pɛdʋʋ, ŋgʋ ajɛɛ ɛzɩ Ɛndɩ nɛ Siinii ñaaɖɔŋ ñɔsɩ kɩdɛkɛdɩsɩ tɔʋ paɣtʋ natʋyʋ yɔɔ.
text_en: Australia's former conservative government refused to ratify Kyoto, saying it would damage the economy with its heavy reliance on coal exports, while countries like India and China were not bound by emissions targets.

text: eBay yabɩ mbʋ payɩ ɖi-wezuu caɣʋ taa yɔ, pʋnɛ pɩkɩlɩna.
text_en: It is the biggest acquisition in eBay's history.

text: Tʋmɩyɛ sɔsɔyɛ nɖɩ ɖɩwɛnɩ lidaʋ se ɖɩpɛdɩɣ wondu ndɩ ndɩ nɛ ɛyaa sakɩyɛ tɩlɩ-ɖɩ hɔɔlɩŋ weyi ɩ-taa Skype wɛnɩ ɖoŋ pɩdɩɩfɛyɩ ɛzɩ Siinii, Wɩsɩ Đɩlɩyɛ Erɔɔpɩ, nɛ Preeziili.
text_en: The company hopes to diversify its profit sources and gain popularity in areas where Skype holds a strong position, such as China, Eastern Europe, and Brazil.

text: Lɛɣtʋ ñɩnɩyaa kaamaɣzaɣ se Enceladus tɛtʋ ciɣduu nɛ pʋtɔma ɖɩ-cɔlɔ Saturnes kokoo niŋkaɣ ñɩna wena awɛ ɛzɩ E yɔ alɩnaa.
text_en: Scientists have suspected Enceladus as geologically active and a possible source of Saturn's icy E ring.

text: Enceladus kɛnɩ wonuu ŋgʋ kɩkɩlɩɣ ñɩlɩsʋʋ wɩsɩ egeetiye taa, nɛ kɩñɩlɩsɩɣ wɩsɩ ɖoŋ weyi ɩtalɩɣ-kʋ yɔ ɩ-tɛ 90 mɩnʊʊ yɔɔ yɔ.
text_en: Enceladus is the most reflective object in the solar system, reflecting about 90 percent of the sunlight that hits it.

text: Aleɣya lubiyu Konami yɔɔdɩ sɔnɔ Japɔŋ tɔm susuu takayaɣ nakɛyɛ taa se paakaɣ lɩzʋʋ aleɣya Six Days in Fallujah (Kɩyakɩŋ Loɖo Fallujah tɛtʋ taa).
text_en: The game publisher Konami stated today in a Japanese newspaper that they will not be releasing the game Six Days in Fallujah.

text: Aleɣya ana polubi-yɛ pɩlɩɩnɩ Fallujah You Naalɛ Ñɩŋgʋ yɔɔ, you kɩdɛkɛdʋʋ ŋgʋ kɩɩlabɩ Amerika sɔɔjanaa nɛ Iraakɩ sɔɔjanaa hɛkʋ taa yɔ.
text_en: The game is based on the Second Battle of Fallujah, a vicious battle between American and Iraqi forces.

text: ACMA pɩzaa nɛ kɩna ɖɔɖɔ se paa paawɩlɩ video ŋgʋ ɛntɛrnɛɛtɩ yɔɔ kɔyɔ, Big Brother tɩmaanɩ paɣtʋ ndʋ paɖʋ ɛntɛrnɛɛtɩ yɔɔ wondu yɔɔ yɔ, mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ patɩɖʋ video ŋgʋ Big Brother tɛ ɛntɛrnɛɛtɩ lone yɔɔ.
text_en: The ACMA also found that despite the video being streamed on the Internet, Big Brother had not breached online content censorship laws as the media had not been stored on Big Brother's website.

text: Tɔm Susuu Nʋmɔŋ Yɔɔ Cɔnʋʋ Paɣtʋ yɔɔdɩ ɛzɩma pakandɩyɩ ɛntɛrnɛɛtɩ yɔɔ wondu yɔɔ yɔ, ɛlɛ pʋcɔ nɛ pɔtɔ se nabʋyʋ kɛ ɛntɛrnɛɛtɩ yɔɔ wonuu lɛ, pʋpɔzʋʋ se paɖʋ-kʋ tataɣ sɔsɔɔ yaa serveur yɔɔ.
text_en: The Broadcasting Services Act provides for the regulation of Internet content, however to be considered Internet content, it must physically reside on a server.

text: Etaazuunii ɛjaɖɛ lone taa caɣyʋ tʋmɩyɛ ɖɩlaɖɛ nɖɩ ɖɩwɛ Nayiroobi, Keniya yɔ, ɖisusi tɔm nɛ ɖɩpaɣ ɛyaa se ʺɛtɛlɛmwaa kɩdɛkɛdaa mba palɩnɩ Somalii yɔʺ pañɩnɩɣ se petiyini ɛyaa mba pakʋʋ pa-tɩ nɛ bɔmbɩwaa se pɛkpɛndɩnɩ lalaa yɔ Keniya nɛ Etiyoopii taa.
text_en: The United States embassy located in Nairobi, Kenya has issued a warning that "extremists from Somalia" are planning to launch suicide bomb attacks in Kenya and Ethiopia.

text: Etaazuunii mba yɔɔdaa se panɩ tɔm ndʋ weyi ɛ-cɔlɔ yɔ, paapɩzɩɣ pokuli ɛ-yɔɔ, ɛlɛ pʋdʋ tɔma se pakaɣ tiyuu ɛyaa mba pakʋʋ pa-tɩ nɛ bɔmbɩwaa se pɛkpɛndɩnɩ ɛyaa lalaa yɔ se pɔyɔkɩ ʺlona sɔsɔnaʺ Etiyoopii nɛ Keniya taa.
text_en: The U.S. says it has received information from an undisclosed source that specifically mentions the use of suicide bombers to will blow up "prominent landmarks" in Ethiopia and Kenya.

text: Alɩwaatʋ sakɩyɛ pʋcɔ nɛ palɩzɩɣ The Daily Show nɛ The Colbert Report lɛ, Heck nɛ Johnson paamaɣza se palɩzɩɣ tɔm susuu takayaɣ nakɛyɛ ŋga kakaɣ labʋ tɔm susuu wɛɛ hoŋa-tɔm susuu ndʋ peɖiɣni wɩlʋʋ yɔ- alɩwaatʋ ndʋ paakɛ sukulibiya UW taa pɩnaɣ 1988 taa.
text_en: Long before The Daily Show and The Colbert Report, Heck and Johnson envisioned a publication that would parody the news—and news reporting—when they were students at UW in 1988.

text: Kpaɣnɩ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ papaɣzɩ tɔm susuu tʋmɩyɛ Onion yɔ, ɖɩpɩsɩ hoŋa tɔm susuu tʋmɩyɛ sɔsɔyɛ siŋŋ, ɖɩwɛnɩ tɔm susuu takayaɣ hatʋ ñɩŋga, ɛntɛrnɛɛtɩ lone nɖɩ ɖɩhɔm ŋgee ɛyaa 5 000 000 Aloma fenaɣ taa, kɩ-tɛ adɖɛɛsɩ, tɔm susuu tʋmɩyɛ ɖʋtʋ ñɩɣtʋ 24 evemiye taa, podcast waa, nɛ pitileɖi yɔ, palɩzɩ ɛjaɖɛ aŋjaʋ atlas ŋgʋ payaɣ se Our Dumb World.
text_en: Since its inception, The Onion has become a veritable news parody empire, with a print edition, a website that drew 5,000,000 unique visitors in the month of October, personal ads, a 24 hour news network, podcasts, and a recently launched world atlas called Our Dumb World.

text: Pamaɣ Al Gore nɛ Sodou Tommy Franks yɔɔ tɔm kajalaɣ ɖeɖe tɔm susuu takayɩsɩ taa (Pɔyɔɔdɩ Gore ñɩndʋ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ The Onion kɛdaa se ɛ nɛ Tipper pasʋnɩ ɖama camɩyɛ kpem kɩyakʋ ŋgʋ ɛtɔlɩ pɩnaɣ 2000 caca tɔʋ ŋgʋ Caca Tɔyaa Ɛgbɛyɛ ñɔɔzaa yɔ kɩ-taa.
text_en: Al Gore and General Tommy Franks casually rattle off their favorite headlines (Gore's was when The Onion reported he and Tipper were having the best sex of their lives after his 2000 Electoral College defeat).

text: Pa-takayɩsɩ mayaa sakɩyɛ kaawɛnɩ ɖoŋ siŋŋ teelee yɔɔ hoŋa ɖʋtʋ ndʋ Jon Stewart nɛ Stephen Colbert’s palakaɣ yɔ.
text_en: Many of their writers have gone on to wield great influence on Jon Stewart and Stephen Colbert's news parody shows.

text: Ajana aleɣya ɖʋtʋ ndʋ tɩɩkɛ ɖɔɖɔ pana wena Pukarɛɛsɩ Maalika ñakaɣ se pɩsa patasɩ naʋ Rumaanii tɛtʋ sɔsɔtʋ ndʋ ɛzɩ tɛtʋ sɔsɔtʋ ndʋ tɩwɛ kajʋka nɛ tiluki wondu kɩfatʋ yɔ.
text_en: The artistic event is also part of a campaign by the Bucharest City Hall that seeks to relaunch the image of the Romanian capital as a creative and colourful metropolis.

text: Tɛtʋ ndʋ tɩkaɣ kɛʋ Erɔɔpɩ hadɛ kiŋ nɛ wɩsɩ ɖɩlɩyɛ taa kajalaɣ tɛtʋ ndʋ tɩkaɣ mʋʋ CowParade Mɩsɩgʋm fenaɣ nɛ Kɩyɛɛna fenaɣ pɛ-hɛkʋ taa yɔ, pɩkɛ ɛjaɖɛ kpeekpe yɔɔ ajana aleɣya ɖʋtʋ ndʋ tɩkɩlɩɣ hɔm ɛyaa samaɣ sɔsɔɔ yɔ.
text_en: The city will be the first in southeastern Europe to host CowParade, the world's largest public art event, between June and August this year.

text: Tɔm ndʋ posusi sɔnɔ yɔ tɩtasɩ tuzuu tamaɣ ŋga komina labɩ Lakɩŋ fenaɣ taa pɩnaɣ kanɛ se kɩhaɣ liidiye nɛ paya lɔɔɖa nɛ pɔsɔzɩ yɔ.
text_en: Today's announcement also extended the government's commitment made in March of this year to fund extra carriages.

text: Pɔsɔzɩ lɔɔɖa 300 lɔɔɖa wena pɩwɛɛ se paya yɔ a-yɔɔ kɔyɔ, pɩtɩŋa pɩkpɛndɩɣ lɔɔɖa 1300 nɛ piyeki se ɛyaa ɛtaakɩlɩ ɖɔʋ lɔɔɖa taa.
text_en: An additional 300 brings the total to 1,300 carriages to be acquired to relieve overcrowding.

text: Christopher Garcia weyi ɛkɛ Los Angeles Polisi nɔɔ ɖɛyʋ yɔ, ɛyɔɔdaa se weyi pamaɣzɩɣ se ɛkɛ kpanzɩyʋ yɔ peɖiɣni ñɩnʋʋ se pana se ɛyɔkaa nɛ ɛsʋʋ ɛyaa yɔɔ, ɛlɛ pɩtɩkɛ se ɛwɛɛkɩ nɔɔyʋ ñɩm.
text_en: Christopher Garcia, a spokesperson of the Los Angeles Police Department, said the suspected male offender is being investigated for trespassing rather than vandalism.

text: Patɩwɛɛkɩ mayaɣ maɣmaɣ ; palabɩ lɛɣzɩtʋ pɩtɩŋnɩ tampoolinaa kɩkpɛɛdaa nabɛyɛ yɔɔ, mba pacanɩ-wɛ nɛ laŋhɛzɩyɛ nɛ laŋɩyɛ kɩlɛmɩŋ yɔ se pɩsa nɛ ʺOʺ lɛɣzɩ nɛ kɩpɩsɩ mayaɣ cikpelaɣ ʺeʺ.
text_en: The sign was not physically damaged; the modification was done using black tarpaulins decorated with signs of peace and heart to alter the "O" to read lowercase "e".

text: Teŋgu taa lɩm kɩsɛɛmɩm huu lɩnɩ ɛzɩma teŋgu taa ñɩɣyʋʋ ŋgʋ kɩwɛnɩ kuludaɣ kʋɖʋmaɣ nɛ payaɣ-kɛ se Karenia brevis yɔ, kɔɖɔ lɩm taa nɛ pɩkpaɖɩ ɛzɩma pʋpɔzʋʋ yɔ, pɩ-cɔlɔ.
text_en: Red tide is caused by a higher than normal concentration of Karenia brevis, a naturally-occurring single-celled marine organism.

text: Teŋgu taa wɛtʋ maɣmaɣ pɩzɩɣ nɛ pɩkpɛndɩ ɖama nɛ pɩla wɛtʋ kɩbandʋ, nɛ piyele nɛ ñɩyʋʋ ŋgʋ kɩɖɔɔ lɩm taa nɔɔ kʋyʋmaɣ
text_en: Natural factors can intersect to produce ideal conditions, allowing this algae to increase in number dramatically.

text: Aɖɔnɖɔlɛɛ kɛɛ ñɩtʋ ndʋ tɩlʋlʋʋ sɔtʋ ndʋ pɛyaɣ se neurotoxine ŋgʋ kɩwɛɛkʋ ɛyaa nɛ kpakpasɩ po-holaa yɔ
text_en: The algae produces a neurotoxin that can disable nerves in both humans and fish.

text: Đoŋ ɖoŋ lɛ kpakpasɩ sɩkɩ mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ sɔtʋ ndʋ tɩɖɔ lɩm taa.
text_en: Fish often die because of the high concentrations of the toxin in the waters.

text: Pɩpɩzɩɣ pɩwɛɛnɩ ɖoŋ ɛyaa yɔɔ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ pefeziɣ lɩm mbʋ helim nɛ lɩm hola pamɩzɩ-pʋ helim taa yɔ.
text_en: Humans can be affected by breathing affected water taken into the air by wind and waves.

text: Kakpaɣ ɖoŋ lɛ, Kancʋʋlaɣ Sɔsɔɔ ŋga payaɣ se Gonu yɔ, Malidiivi mba kʋnʋŋ taa lɛ hɩɖɛ nɖɩ ɖɩ-tɔbʋʋ lɛ se paadɛtʋ huyuu, ke-helim seɣ nɛ pɩtalɩ kilomɛtanaa 240 paa ñɩɣyʋʋ ŋgʋ (miles waa 149 paa ñɩɣyʋʋ ŋgʋ).
text_en: At its peak, Tropical Cyclone Gonu, named for a bag of palm leaves in the language of the Maldives, reached sustained winds of 240 kilometers an hour (149 miles per hour) .

text: Papɩsɩ liidiye kpou Northern Rock komina pʋyʋ pɩnaɣ 2008 taa alɩwaatʋ ndʋ pokulaa nɛ pawɩlɩ se tʋmɩyɛ nɖɩ ɖɩɩmʋʋ sɩnʋʋ kpɛdɛyɛ UK Komina cɔlɔ yɔ.
text_en: The Northern Rock bank had been nationalised in 2008 following the revelation that the company had received emergency support from the UK Government.

text: Pɩɩpɔzaa se pasɩnɩ Northern Rock mbʋ pʋyɔɔ kɩɩkatɩ kaɖɛ pɩnaɣ 2007 taa asɛyʋʋ ŋgʋ kɩlɩnɩ tɛtɛ liidiye kɩndʋʋ taa yɔ.
text_en: Northern Rock had required support due to its exposure during the subprime mortgage crisis in 2007.

text: Sir Richard Branson tɛ Virgin Ɛgbɛyɛ na ɛzɩma pekizi nɔɔyʋ haɖɛ se ɛmʋʋ liidiye kpou pʋcɔ nɛ komina pɩsɩɣ liidiye kpou ŋgʋ kɩ-pʋyʋ.
text_en: Sir Richard Branson's Virgin Group had a bid for the bank rejected prior to the bank’s nationalisation.

text: Pɩnaɣ 2010 taa, alɩwaatʋ ndʋ kɩɩkɛ komina pʋyʋ yɔ, patayɩ liidiye kpou kɩfalʋʋ Northern Rock plc nɛ ‘liidiye kpou kɩdɛkɛdʋʋ’, Northern Rock (Asset Management) pɛ-hɛkʋ taa.
text_en: In 2010, while nationalised, the current high street bank Northern Rock plc was split from the ‘bad bank’, Northern Rock (Asset Management).

text: Virgin yabɩ Northern Rock tɛ ‘liidiye kpou kɩbaŋʋ’ yeke na, pɩtɩkɛ tʋmɩyɛ nɖɩ ɖɩcɔŋnɩ kɩ-yɔɔ yɔ.
text_en: Virgin have only purchased the ‘good bank’ of Northern Rock, not the asset management company.

text: Pamaɣzɩɣ se kagbanzɩ ɖeɖe lɛ ɛyaa naʋ mbʋ pewilaa nɛ pana se pɩkɛ Marɩsɩ wonuu nakʋyʋ ŋgʋ kɩlɩnɩ ɛsɔdaa nɛ kɩtɔlɩ Tɛtʋ yɔɔ yɔ.
text_en: This is believed to be the fifth time in history that people have observed what turned out to be chemically confirmed martian material falling to Earth.

text: Ɛsɔdaa pɛɛ ɛzɩ 24 000 wena pasɩma se alɩnɩ ɛsɔdaa nɛ atɔlɩ tɛtʋ yɔɔ yɔ a-taa lɛ, 34 mbʋ yɔ ɖeke pamaɣzaa nɛ pana se alɩnɩ Marɩsɩ yɔɔ.
text_en: Out of the approximately 24,000 known meteorites to have fallen to Earth, only about 34 have been verified to be martian in origin.

text: Pamaɣzɩɣ se ɛsɔdaa pɩyɛ naɖɩyɛ mɩzɩnɩ Hasɩɖɩyaɖɛ fenaɣ taa nɛ pɩha kaaŋ ɛnɩ ɩ-taa hiu nɛ kagbanzɩ.
text_en: Fifteen of these rocks are attributed to the meteorite shower last July.

text: Kaaŋ ɛnɩ ɩ-taa nɩɩyɩ wɛ kɛdɛɖaɣ pɩdɩɩfɛyɩ Tɛtʋ yɔɔ, nɛ pɛpɛdɩɣ 28 g kpaɣnɩ US$11 000 nɛ piwolo $22 500, pɩwɩlɩɣ se pɩcɛzɩ sika liidiye tam hiu mbʋ yɔ.
text_en: Some of the rocks, which are very rare on Earth, are being sold from US$11,000 to $22,500 per ounce, which is about ten times more than the cost of gold.

text: Palabɩ seya nɛ pɩtɛ, Keselowski kaakɛnɩ lɔɔɖa sayaa maacɩnaa taa kajalaɣ mbʋ, nɛ ɛɛwɛnɩ kpaɣla 2250.
text_en: Following the race, Keselowski remains the Drivers' Championship leader with 2,250 points.

text: Johnson kaakɛnɩ naalɛ tʋ nɛ kpaɣla 2243, kajalaɣ tʋ kaaɖɛ ɛ-yɔɔ nɛ kpaɣla lʋbɛ.
text_en: Seven points behind, Johnson is second with 2,243.

text: Tozo tʋ lɛ Hamlin, paaɖɛ ɛ-yɔɔ nɛ kpaɣla nɛɛlɛ, ɛlɛ ɛɛɖɛ Bowyer yɔɔ nɛ kpaɣla kagbanzɩ. Kahne nɛ Truex, Jr paakɛ kagbanzɩ tʋ nɛ loɖo tʋ nɛ paatɩŋ ɖama wayɩ nɛ kpaɣla 2220 nɛ 2207.
text_en: In third, Hamlin is twenty points behind, but five ahead of Bowyer. Kahne and Truex, Jr. are fifth and sixth respectively with 2,220 and 2,207 points.

text_en: Stewart, Gordon, Kenseth, and Harvick round out the top-ten positions for the Drivers' Championship with four races remaining in the season.

text_en: The US Navy also said they were investigating the incident.

text_en: They also said in a statement, "The crew is currently working to determine the best method of safely extracting the ship".

text_en: An Avenger class mine countermeasures ship, the ship was on its way to Puerto Princesa in Palawan.

text: Mba pɔkɔm nɛ pakʋ ɛyaa Mumbayii yɔ, patalɩnɩ mɛlɛ Kamɩŋ fenaɣ kɩyakʋ 26 wiye pɩnaɣ 2008 taa, paaɖɔkɩ nesi tɛɛ bɔmbɩnaa, malɩfanaa mba pɔtɔʋ pɛɛ lɛɛ lɛɛ yɔ nɛ pɔtɔ ɛyaa yɔɔ lona sakɩyɛ taa pɩkpɛndɩnɩ suluku ɖɩzɩŋɩyɛ Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus ɖenɖe ɛyaa sakɩyɛ wɛɣ yɔ nɛ Agɔma Đɩɣa Taj Mahal ŋga ka-hɩɖɛ kaasɛwa yɔ.

text: Tɔm ndʋ David Headley kaañɩnaa nɛ ekpeɣli yɔ tɩsɩnɩ abalaa malɩfa tɔyaa 10 mba pɛwɛ Pakistaanɩ ɛtɛlɛmwaa ɛgbɛyɛ Laskhar-e-Taiba nɛ pala pa-tʋmɩyɛ.

text_en: The attack put a huge strain on relations between India and Pakistan.

text: Ɛjaɖɛ taa sɔsaa mba paawɛ ɛ-cɔlɔ lɛ, ɛhɛzɩ Texas mba se peɖiɣni kpɛzʋʋ nɩŋgbanzɩ nzɩ pʋpɔzʋʋ yɔ se pakandɩyɩ samaɣ tɛ ɖiɣ ɖiɣ caɣʋ yɔɔ.
text_en: Accompanied by those officials, he assured Texas citizens that steps were being taken to protect the public's safety.

text_en: The governor also stated, "Today, we learned that some school aged children have been identified as having had contact with the patient."

text_en: He went on to say, "This case is serious. Rest assured that our system is working as well as it should."

text_en: One of the world's richest people, Allen has reportedly invested much of his wealth in marine exploration and began his quest to find the Musashi out of a lifelong interest in the war.

text_en: "It is now important from both a public health and criminal justice perspective that the legislation be enacted as soon as possible", said a government spokesperson.

text_en: Jarque was practicing during pre-season training at Coverciano in Italy earlier in the day. He was staying in the team hotel ahead of a match planned for Sunday against Bolonia.

text: Ɛsʋwaɣ ɛgbɛyɛ tɛ agɔma ɖɩɣa taa se pʋcɔ nɛ pɩtalɩ maacɩ ŋgʋ paɖʋwa se pamakɩnɩ Bolonia, Kujuka wiye yɔ.
text_en: He was staying in the team hotel ahead of a match planned for Sunday against Bolonia.

text: Lɔɔɖɩyɛ kaawɛ ɖiwokini Six Flags St. Louis, Missouri taa se pɩsa nɛ maacɩ maɖaa ma maacɩ ɛlɛ paapɛdɩɣ tikee nakʋyʋ puwiye.
text_en: The bus was headed to Six Flags St. Louis in Missouri for the band to play to a sold-out crowd.

text: Aseɣɖe tɩnaa nabɛyɛ yɔɔdaa se pɩmabɩ 1 :15 Mazaɣ tanaŋ tɛɛ nɛ lɔɔɖɩyɛ kaawɛ ɖɩɖɛɣ tɩŋ hatʋ tɔlɩm miŋ nɩɩyɩ yɔɔ lɛ, lɔɔɖɩyɛ cikpeɖe kɔɔ nɛ ɖɩcɛ ɖɩ-ɛsɩndaa.
text_en: At 1:15 a.m. Saturday, according to witnesses, the bus was going through a green light when the car made a turn in front of it.

text: Kɩyɛɛna fenaɣ kɩyakʋ 9 wiye, Morakot ɛsɩyɛ kaaposini Siinii egeetiye Fujian ɛzɩ kilomɛtanaa nɩɩnʋwa nɛ nɛɛlɛ mbʋ yɔ.
text_en: As of the night of August 9, the eye of Morakot was about seventy kilometres away from the Chinese province of Fujian.

text: Pɛkɛdaa nɛ pana se helim sɔsɔm mbʋ pɩwɛɛ nɛ piseɣ kilomɛtanaa hiu nɛ kʋɖʋm paa ñɩɣyʋʋ ŋgʋ nɛ piwokini Siinii yɔɔ kiŋ.
text_en: The typhoon is estimated to be moving toward China at eleven kph.

text: Paha mba pasʋwaɣ lɔɔɖɩyɛ yɔ lɩm alɩwaatʋ ndʋ paaɖaŋ soŋaɣ ŋga katalɩ hohou 90 (F) yɔ.
text_en: Passengers were given water as they waited in 90(F)-degree heat.

text: Miŋ ɖeziyaa tɛ kapɩtaŋ Scott Kouns yɔɔdaa se : ʺPɩɩkɛ soŋaɣ evemiye Santa Clara taa nɛ hohou kaakpa ɛzɩ 90 waa taa yɔ.
text_en: Fire captain Scott Kouns said, "It was a hot day in the Santa Clara with temperatures in the 90s.

text: Paa alɩwaatʋ ɛzɩma ɛyʋ ɛlabɩ taŋayɩ weyi ɛcɔʋ yɔ ɛ-taa kɔyɔ pɩɩlakɩ-ɩ camɩyɛ, nɛ pɩkpaɣ ɛzɩ ñɩɣyʋʋ kʋɖʋmʋʋ mbʋ pʋcɔ nɛ palɩzɩ ɛyʋ kajalaɣ ñɩnʋ pɩ-taa.ʺ
text_en: Any length of time trapped on a roller coaster would be uncomfortable, to say the least, and it took at least an hour to get the first person off the ride."

text: Schumacher weyi ɛwabɩ lɔɔɖa seya Formule 1 tam lʋbɛ nɛ pɩtɛ lɛ, ɛmʋ hɛzʋʋ pɩnaɣ 2006 taa yɔ, pɩɩwɛɛ se ɛlɛɣzɩ Felipe Massa weyi pɩkʋ-ɩ yɔ.
text_en: Schumacher who retired in 2006 after winning the Formula 1 championship seven times, was due to replace the injured Felipe Massa.

text: Preziili tʋ ɛnʋ pɩkʋ ɛ-ñʋʋ siŋŋ alɩwaatu ndʋ ɛtɔlɩnɩ lɔɔɖɩyɛ pɩnaɣ 2009 Hɔŋgrii tɛ Grand Prix taa yɔ.
text_en: The Brazilian suffered a serious head injury after a crash during the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.

text: Massa ɛɛkaɣ tasʋʋ seya labʋ pɩkɩlaa yɔ pɩnaɣ 2009 alɩwaatʋ  ndʋ tɩkazaa yɔ tɩ-taa.
text_en: Massa is due to be out for at least the rest of the 2009 season.

text: Minisi Ɛjaɖɛ Ñʋʋdʋ Rodrigo Arias yɔɔdaa se pamaɣzɩ Arias nɛ pana kʋdɔŋ sɔtʋ ndʋ tɩfɛyɩ ɖoŋ yɔ ɛ-yɔɔ.
text_en: Arias tested positive for a mild case of the virus, Presidential Minister Rodrigo Arias said.

text: Ɛjaɖɛ ñʋʋdʋ tɛ alaafɩya fɛyɩ kaɖɛ taa, paa mbʋ yɔ pakaɣ-ɩ kɛzʋʋ hɔɔlʋʋ ɛ-ɖɩɣa taa kɩyakɩŋ cabɩ.
text_en: The president's condition is stable, though he will be isolated at home for several days.

text: Miŋ saʋ nɛ liu tɛɛ wɩʋ pi-ɖeke pɩcɛyɩɣnɩ-m, ɛlɛ mɔn-tɔnʋʋ wɛ alaafɩya nɛ mɛwɛnɩ kpeetaɣ camɩyɛ se mala man-tʋmɩyɛ pɩtɩŋnɩ ɛntɛrnɛɛtɩ yɔɔ.
text_en: "Apart from the fever and a sore throat, I feel well and in good shape to carry out my work by telecommuting.

text: Arias yɔɔdɩ tɔm kususutu natʋyʋ taa se : ʺMantaɣ liu se manpɩsʋʋ man-tʋma kpeekpe taa Hodo wiye.ʺ
text_en: I expect to return to all my duties on Monday," Arias said in a statement.

text: Felicia kaakɛ tɛʋ sɔsɔʋ ŋgʋ kɩwɛ Tindimiye 4 taa Saffir-Simpson Helim Tɛŋ Sɔsɔŋ Kɩgalʋʋ taa, nɛ pʋwayɩ lɛ kɩhɛɛ nɛ kɩpɩsɩ tropiki tɛʋ cikpeluu nɛ Piya wiye lɛ, kɩfɛɛ.
text_en: Felicia, once a Category 4 storm on the Saffir-Simpson Hurricane Scale, weakened to a tropical depression before dissipating Tuesday.

text: Mbʋ pɩkazɩ-kʋ pɩlabɩ tɛŋ lɩm hɛkʋ taa tɛtʋ sakɩyɛ yɔɔ, paa patɩyɔɔdɩtɩ asɛyʋʋ yaa lɩm nabʋyʋ tɔm kɔyɔ.
text_en: Its remnants produced showers across most of the islands, though as of yet, no damage or flooding has been reported.

text: Tɛʋ lɩm talɩ ɛzɩ niwee inches waa 6,34 kɩmaɣzʋʋ ŋgʋ kɩwɛ Oahu yɔ kɩ-yɔɔ, nɛ pɔyɔɔdɩ se pɩwɛ ʺwazaɣ.ʺ
text_en: The precipitation, reaching 6.34 inches at a gauge on Oahu, was described as "beneficial".

text: Tɛŋ ɛnɩ ɩ-taa nɩɩyɩ kaakɔmnɩ tɛʋ nazʋʋ nɛ añɩlɩza ɖoŋ ɖoŋ.
text_en: Some of the rainfall was accompanied by thunderstorms and frequent lightning.

text: Twin Otter ñɩnaɣ se kitii Kokoda ɛzɩ Airlines PGN tɛ ɛsɔdaa lɔɔɖɩyɛ CG4684 yɔ, ɛlɛ kɩɩtɛm ñaɣʋ pana nɛ kɩtɩpɩzɩ.
text_en: The Twin Otter had been trying to land at Kokoda yesterday as Airlines PNG Flight CG4684, but had aborted once already.

text: Pɩlabɩ ɛzɩ cɛcɛsɩ hiu mbʋ yɔ pɔcɔ nɛ pɩwɛɛ se kɩñaɣ pana nɛ kitii nabʋlɛ ɖeɖe, kɩmʋʋ.
text_en: About ten minutes before it was due to land from its second approach it disapeared.

text: Pana ɖenɖe ɛsɔdaa lɔɔɖɩyɛ tɔlaa yɔ sɔnɔ, ɛlɛ peeɖe wobu kaawɛ kaɖɛ kpem nɛ pʋyɔɔ lɛ, petisi polisinaa naalɛ laʋ taa se pɩsa nɛ powolo ɖenɖe kɩtɔlaa yɔ nɛ pañɩnɩ mba patɩsɩ yɔ.
text_en: The crash site was located today and is so inaccessable that two policemen were dropped into the jungle in order to hike to the scene and seek survivors.

text: Ñɩnɩyaa tɩpɩzɩ nɛ pala pa-tʋmɩyɛ mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ ɛjaɖɛ yɔɔ wɛtʋ wɛɛkaa nɛ mbʋ yebina ɖɔɖɔ ɛsɔdaa lɔɔɖɩyɛ tɩpɩzɩ nɛ ɖitii ɛzɩ pʋpɔzʋʋ yɔ.
text_en: The search had been hampered by the same bad weather that had caused the aborted landing.

text: Tɔm kususutu yɔɔdaa se ɖaŋ nakʋyʋ ŋgʋ kɩwɛ Macbeth Habɩyɛ nɔɔ yɔ, kɩmɩzaa mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ helim mbʋ pɩmʋʋ miŋ yɔ pɩlɩ kɩ-taa.
text_en: According to reports, an apartment on Macbeth Street exploded due to a gas leak.

text: Pɩ-cɔlɔ tʋ nɔɔyʋ kaaya tʋmɩyɛ nɖɩ ɖɩpɛdɩɣ helim mbʋ ɖɩ-ñʋʋdʋ nɔɔyʋ nɛ eheyi se helim ɖiɣni lɩʋ nɛ ɛlɛ kaawɛ nɛ ewoki peeɖe.
text_en: An official with the gas company was reporting to the scene after a neighbor called about a gas leak.

text: Tʋmɩyɛ ñʋʋdʋ ɛnʋ ɛtalaa lɛ, ɖaŋ ya kpooo.
text_en: When the official arrived, the apartment exploded.

text: Nɔɔyʋ tɩmʋ heŋ sɔsɔŋ nɩɩyɩ, ɛlɛ ɛyaa ɛzɩ kagbanzɩ kaawɛ peeɖe alɩwaatʋ ndʋ ɖaŋ yawa yɔ nɛ pɛwɛ pɔcɔŋnɩ pe­-ɖeɖe mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ pefiɣnaa.
text_en: No major injuries were reported, but at least five people on scene at the time of the explosion were treated for symptoms of shock.

text: Nɔɔyʋ taawɛɛ ɖaŋ taa.
text_en: No one was inside the apartment.

text: Alɩwaatʋ ndʋ, ɛyaa mba peheyi-wɛ se pakʋyɩ ɖenɖe kɛgbɛdɩsaɣ laba yɔ pɔñɔtɩnɩ 100 mbʋ yɔ.
text_en: At the time, nearly 100 residents were evacuated from the area.

text: Pakaɣ pɩsɩnʋʋ gɔlɩfɩ nɛ rugibii pa-naalɛ Olɛmpiiki Aleɣya taa.
text_en: Both golf and rugby are set to return to the Olympic Games.

text: Ajɛɛ sakɩyɛ Olɛmpiki tɛ kɔɔmiite tɔ caca nɛ kɩsɔzɩ hola aleɣya ana kɩ-tɛ ñʋndɩnaa kediɣzaɣ ŋga palabɩ Pɛrlɛɛ sɔnɔ yɔ, ka-taa. Palɩzɩ rugibii, kɔzɩ kɔzɩ rugibii ŋgʋ ɛyaa XV makɩ yɔ nɛ gɔlɩfɩ, hola aleɣya kagbanzɩ taa se pasʋʋ Olɛmpiki aleɣya taa.
text_en: The International Olympic Committee voted to include the sports at its executive board meeting in Berlin today. Rugby, specifically rugby union, and golf were selected over five other sports to be considered to participate in the Olympics.

text: Sikuwasɩ, karatee nɛ rolɛɛrɩ aleɣya kaañaɣ pana se asʋʋ Olɛmpiki ɖʋtʋ taa, pɩtasɩnɩ beezibɔɔlɩ nɛ sɔfɩtɩbɔɔlɩ mba paalɩzɩ-wɛ pɩnaɣ 2005 Olɛmpiki aleɣya taa yɔ.
text_en: Squash, karate and roller sports tried to get onto the Olympic program as well as baseball and softball, which were voted out of the Olympic Games in 2005.

text: Pɩkazaa se Olɛmpiki tɛ kɔɔmiite kpeekpe ɛñɩɣ nesi caca tɔʋ mbʋ pɩ-yɔɔ kediɣzaɣ ŋga palakɩ Aloma fenaɣ taa Kopɛnhaagɩ yɔ.
text_en: The vote must still be ratified by the full IOC at it's October meeting in Copenhagen.

text: Pɩtɩkɛ pa-tɩŋa paasɔɔlɩna se paɖʋ halaa pɩ-taa.
text_en: Not all were supportive of the inclusion of the women’s ranks.

text: Amir Khan weyi ɛmʋ Olɛmpiki liidiye ñɩɣyʋʋ lɩyʋʋ pɩnaɣ 2004 taa yɔ ɛyɔɔdaa se : ʺToovenim taa lɛ, mamaɣzɩɣ se pɩtɩpɔzɩ se halaa ɩla lʋbɩyɛ. Ma lɩmaɣza pɩkɛnaa.ʺ
text_en: 2004 Olympic silver medallist Amir Khan said, "Deep down I think women shouldn’t fight. That’s my opinion."

text: Paa ɛyɔɔdɩ mbʋ yɔ, ɛtɔm se ɛkaɣ tɩnʋʋ mba palʋkɩ Krandɩ Pretaañɩ yɔɔ yɔ Olɛmpiki aleɣya wena palakɩ pɩnaɣ 2012 taa Lɔndrɩ yɔ.
text_en: Despite his comments he said he will be supporting the British competitors at the 2012 Olympics being held in London.

text: Tɔm hʋʋ kaapaɣzɩ Birmingham Crown Tɔm Đɩhʋyɛ nɛ pɩsɩɩ tɩnaɣ Kɩyɛɛna fenaɣ kɩyakʋ 3 wiye
text_en: The trial took place at Birmingham Crown Court and concluded on August 3.

text: Tɔm kɛdɩyʋ weyi pakpa peeɖe yɔ, ɛkpɛzaa se pɩtɩkɛ ɛnʋ labɩna nɛ ɛyɔɔdɩ se ɛkpaɣ kpaɖaʋ se ɛkandɩyɩ ɛ-tɩ yɔɔ nɛ kokola wena ɛyaa ɛzɩ niidozo mbʋ lɔwaɣ ɛ-yɔɔ yɔ.
text_en: The presenter, who was arrested at the scene, denied the attack and claimed he used the pole to protect himself from bottles being thrown at him by up to thirty people.

text: Pakʋ Blake tɔm se ɛñɩnaɣ se ɛla nɛ pataahʋʋ tɔm siɣsiɣ.
text_en: Blake was also convicted of attempting to pervert the course of justice.

text: Tɔm hʋyʋ heyi Blake se « pɩɩkaɣ sam » se ɛlɩɩ pɩ-taa nɛ paaɖʋ-ɩ salaka.
text_en: The judge told Blake it was "almost inevitable" he was going to be sent to jail.

text: Đoŋ kɩkpɛɛdɩŋ kɛ ɖoŋ weyi paatɩɩnaɣ-ɩ yɔ nɛ ɛlakɩ tʋmɩyɛ tam kedeŋa yɔɔ yɔ.
text_en: Dark energy is a completely invisible force that is constantly acting upon the universe.

text: Papɩzaa nɛ pana se ɖoŋ ɛnɩ ɛwɛɛ pɩlɩɩnɩ ɛzɩma ɛlakɩ nɛ kedeŋa wɛɛ nɛ kawalɩɣ tam yɔ.
text_en: Its existence is known only because of its effects on the expansion of the universe.

text: Lɛɣtʋ ñɩnɩyaa nawa se fenaɣ yɔɔ fɛyɩ layɩɩɩ ɛlɛ hɔɔlɩŋ nɩɩyɩ kʋyɩ pʋŋ tɩyɛ nɛ lɛɛŋ ñɛkɛ kajalanzɩ nɛ pɩwɛ ɛzɩ pɩlɩnɩ ɛzɩma fenaɣ kaakpɩyɩsɩ ka-tɩ pazɩ pazɩ kpem yɔ.
text_en: Scientists have discovered landforms littered across the moon's surface called lobate scarps that have apparently resulted from the moon's shrinking very slowly.

text: Pana wɛtʋ ndʋ fenaɣ yɔɔ paa le, nɛ ɛzɩma fenaɣ yɔɔ pʋŋ nɛ kajalanzɩ nzɩ sɩtɩkpadɩyɩ yɔ, pɩwɩlɩɣ se fenaɣ tɛtʋ lɛɣzʋʋ mbʋ pɩ-cɔlɔ pɩlɩnaa yɔ, pitileɖi.
text_en: These scarps were found all over the moon and appear to be minimally weathered, indicating that the geologic events that created them were fairly recent.

text: Lɩmaɣzɩyɛ nɖɩ ɖɩkaɖɩɣnɩ mba pɔtɔŋ se fenaɣ tɛtʋ ɛɛlɛɣzɩɣ paa ññɩɩ yɔ, pɔ-tɔm.
text_en: This theory contradicts the claim that the moon is completely devoid of geologic activity.

text: Abalʋ ɛnʋ ɛɛɖʋ bɔmbɩnaa lɔɔɖɩyɛ nɖɩ ɖɩwɛnɩ pɔbɔla naadozo yɔ ɖɩ-taa, nɛ ɛsaa-ɖɩ nɛ ɛsʋnɩ ɛyaa samaɣ hɛkʋ taa.
text_en: The man allegedly drove a three-wheeled vehicle armed with explosives into a crowd.

text: Abalʋ weyi pamaɣzɩɣ se ɛlaba nɛ bɔmbɩ tɔ yɔ ɛmʋ heŋ nɛ pɩtɛ lɛ, pakpa-ɩ.
text_en: The man suspected of detonating the bomb was detained, after sustaining injuries from the blast.

text: Ɛjaɖɛ ñʋndɩnaa tɩsɩmtɩ ɛ-hɩɖɛ, paa mbʋ yɔ patɩlaa se ɛkɛ Iguuri mba taa tʋ nɔɔyʋ.
text_en: His name is still unknown to authorities, although they do know he is a member of the Uighur ethnic group.

text: Palʋlɩ Nadia Salaŋ fenaɣ kɩyakʋ 17 wiye pɩnaɣ 2007 taa alɩwaatʋ ndʋ payasɩ e-ɖoo lotu nɛ palɩzɩ-ɩ ɖɔkɔtɔ ŋgʋ kɩ-taa palʋlʋsʋʋ halaa yɔ Aleisk tɛtʋ taa, Rusii ɛjaɖɛ taa, nɛ e-yuŋ kaakɛ liivrinaa 17 nɛ onsi 1.
text_en: Nadia, born on September 17, 2007, by Cesarean section at a maternity clinic in Aleisk, Russia, weighed in at a massive 17 pounds 1 ounce.

text: E-ɖoo yɔɔdaa se : ʺPiitibi-ɖʋ yɔɔɔ yem.ʺ
text_en: "We were all simply in shock," the mother stated.

text: Pɔpɔzɩ-ɩ se suwe ɛ-caa yɔɔdaa lɛ, ecosi se : ʺƐtaapɩzɩɣ se ɛyɔɔdɩ natʋyʋ - ɛsɩŋ peeɖe yem nɛ epiɖiɣ ɛsa.ʺ
text_en: When asked what the father said, she answered "He couldn't say a thing - he just stood there blinking."

text: Kɩkaɣ labʋ ɛzɩ lɩm yɔ. Kɩwɛ kele kele ɛzɩ lɩm wɛʋ yɔ.
text_en: "It's going to behave like water. It's transparent just the way water is.

text: Ye mbʋ, ye pɩlaba se ŋsɩŋ kidiiliŋ yɔɔ kɔyɔ, ŋkaɣ pɩzʋʋ nɛ ŋna kaaŋ nɛ ahɔya wena payɩ awɛ lɩm tɛɛ yɔ.
text_en: So if you were standing by the shoreline, you would be able to see down to whatever pebbles or gunk that was on the bottom.

text: Stofan sɔzaa se : ʺNdʋ ɖɩsɩma yɔ lɛ, ɛsɔdaa wonuu kʋɖʋmʋʋ ɖeke wɛnɩ kpekpeka nɛ pɩkɩlɩ Titaanɩ, nɛ kɩ-hɩɖɛ lɛ Tɛtʋ.
text_en: As far as we know, there is only one planetary body that displays more dynamism than Titan, and its name is Earth," added Stofan.

text: Tɔm paɣzɩ Kɔlaɣ fenaɣ kɩyakʋ kajalaɣ ñɩŋgʋ wiye alɩwaatʋ ndʋ tɛtʋ taa mba hiŋ sakɩyɛ paɣzɩ peenduu Obanazawa takayɩsɩ tiyinuu tʋmɩyɛ ɖɩlaɖɛ yɔɔ se patɩmʋ Pɩnaɣ Kɩfalaɣ takayɩsɩ cikpesi nzɩ pɩkɛnɩ-wɛ sɔnzɩ se pamʋʋ paa pɩnaɣ ŋga yɔ.
text_en: The issue started on January 1st when dozens of local residents started complaining to the Obanazawa Post Office that they hadn't received their traditional and regular New Year cards.

text: Đeɖe takayɩsɩ tiyinuu tʋmɩyɛ tendi tɛtʋ taa mba nɛ tɔm susuu tʋma alɩwaatʋ ndʋ peɖiɣzinaa se abalɩbɩɣa kaamɛsɩ tʋmɩyɛ taa takayɩsɩ nzɩ yɔ sɩcɛzɩ 600, pɩkpɛndɩnɩ Pɩnaɣ Kɩfalaɣ takayɩsɩ cikpesi 429 nzɩ patɩpɩzɩ pɛcɛlɩ-sɩ sɩ-tɩnaa yɔ.
text_en: Yesterday, the post office released their apology to citizens and the media after discovering that the boy had hidden more than 600 postal documents, including 429 New Year postcards, which weren't delivered to their intended recipients.

text: Fenaɣ cɔyʋ Chandrayaan-1 weyi ɛ-taa ɛyʋ nɔɔyʋ fɛyɩ yɔ ɛtɔ ɛ-tɛ menziini ŋgʋ poluba se kitukuni fenaɣ yɔ (MIP), nɛ kʋkʋ ñɛtɛzɩ fenaɣ nɛ seya wena aakɛ kilomɛtanaa 1,5 paa kɛlɛm ŋgʋ ( miles waa 3000 paa ñɩɣyʋʋ ŋgʋ), nɛ kiwolo kɩtɔlɩ camɩyɛ fenaɣ hadɛ kiŋ kamaɣ yɔɔ camɩyɛ ɛzɩ pʋpɔzʋʋ yɔ.
text_en: The unmanned lunar orbiter Chandrayaan-1 ejected its Moon Impact Probe (MIP), which hurtled across the surface of the Moon at 1.5 kilometres per second (3000 miles per hour), and successfully crash landed near the Moon's south pole.

text: Pɩtasɩna se kɩkpɛndɩnɩ lɛɣtʋ ñɩnʋʋ tʋmɩyɛ wondu kɩcɛyɩtʋ naadozo lɛ, fenaɣ menziini ŋgʋ kɩkpaɣ ɖɔɖɔ Ɛndɩ kɩɖaʋ kɛdɛɛka kɩlɛmʋʋ, ŋgʋ pata-kʋ tɔlɩm kɩ-hɔɔlɩŋ kpeekpe yɔɔ yɔ.
text_en: Besides carrying three important scientific instruments, the lunar probe also carried the image of the Indian national flag, painted on all sides.

text: Siriporn yɔɔdɩ tɔm susuyaa nabɛyɛ ɛsɩndaa se : ʺMɛnsɛɣ mba patɩnɩ mɔ-yɔɔ yɔ, ma weyi pakʋ mɔn-tɔm yɔ.ʺ
text_en: "Thanks for those who supported a convict like me," Siriporn was quoted as saying at a press conference.

text: Nabɛyɛ ɩɩkaɣ tisuu ɛlɛ man-paa fɛyɩ.
text_en: "Some may not agree but I don't care.

text: Man-taa wɛ leleŋ se ɛyaa nabɛyɛ sɔɔlaa se paɖʋ-m nesi.
text_en: I am happy that there are people willing to support me.

text: Kpaɣnɩ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ Pakistaanɩ mʋ tɩ-yɔɔ wɛʋ Krandɩ Pretaañɩ nesi tɛɛ pɩnaɣ 1947 yɔ, Pakistaanɩ Ɛjaɖɛ Ñʋʋdʋ lɩzɩ ʺpolitiki tʋmlaɖaaʺ se pɔcɔnɩ FATA waa yɔɔ, mba pɩkazɩ pazɩ se pɛwɛɛnɩ ɖoŋ tɩŋa ageeta wena awɛ a-tɩ yɔɔ yɔ.
text_en: Since Pakistani independence from British rule in 1947, the Pakistani President has appointed "Political Agents" to govern FATA, who exercise near-complete autonomous control over the areas.

text: Tʋmlaɖaa mba, pa-tʋmɩyɛ lɛ se pɔcɔnɩ komina nɛ tɔm hʋʋ tʋma naayɛ yɔɔ  ɛzɩ Pakistaanɩ Paɣtʋ Sɔsɔtʋ Tɔm Loyaɣ 247 pɔzʋʋ yɔ.
text_en: These agents are responsible for providing government and judicial services under Article 247 of the Pakistani Constitution.

text: Agɔma ɖɩɣa cikpelaɣ nakɛyɛ ɖabɩ Maka, Malɩŋ Ɛsɔ sɛtʋ tɛtʋ kiɖeɖetu, sɔnɔ tanaŋ tɛɛ ñɩɣtʋ 10 yɔɔ peeɖe alɩwaatʋ yɔɔ.
text_en: A hostel collapsed in Mecca, the holy city of Islam at about 10 o'clock this morning local time.

text: Ɛyaa mba paakɔm se pɛyɛlɩ tɛtʋ kiɖeɖetu taa pʋcɔ nɛ tɛʋ kifemuu hajj paɣzɩ yɔ, pa-taa nabɛyɛ kaawɛ kuduyu ŋgʋ kɩ-tɛɛ.
text_en: The building housed a number of pilgrims who came to visit the holy city at the eve of hajj pilgrimage.

text: Agɔma mba paawɛ agɔma ɖɩɣa cikpelaɣ ŋga ka-taa yɔ, pa-taa sakɩyɛ kaakɛ Emiiraa Araabɩ Uunii ɛjaɖɛ taa mba.
text_en: The hostel's guests were mostly citizens of the United Arab Emirates.

text: Ɛyaa mba pasɩba yɔ patalɩ 15, nɛ pamaɣzɩɣ se pakaɣ cɛzʋʋ mbʋ.
text_en: The death toll is at least 15, a figure which is expected to rise.

text: Paasɩm Leonov ɖɔɖɔ se ɛkɛ ʺfenaɣ taa kpayʋ N° 11ʺ nɛ ɛɛwɛ Iniyɔɔ Sovietiki fenaɣ taa kpayaa kajalaɣ ñɩma taa.
text_en: Leonov, also known as "cosmonaut No. 11", was part of the Soviet Union's original team of cosmonauts.

text: Lakɩŋ fenaɣ kɩyakʋ 18 wiye pɩnaɣ 1965 taa, ɛnʋ kɛnɩ ɛyʋ kajalaɣ tʋ weyi ɛlɩ tɩɩnzɩ taa kpaʋ lɔɔɖɩyɛ taa (EVA), yaa ʺɛsɔdaa helim taa ɖɔmʺ nɛ e-ɖeke ɛlɩɩ tɩɩnzɩ taa kpaʋ lɔɔɖɩyɛ taa nɛ ɛcaɣ awayɩ nɛ pɩcɛzɩ ɛzɩ cɛcɛsɩ hiu nɛ naalɛ mbʋ yɔ.
text_en: On March 18, 1965, he performed the first manned extravehicular activity (EVA), or "spacewalk", remaining alone outside the spacecraft for just over twelve minutes.

text: Ɛmʋ ʺIniyɔɔ Sovietiki Ñʋʋ Yaɖʋʺ ŋgʋ kɩkɛ Iniyɔɔ Sovietiki samtʋ nimiye nɖɩ ɖɩkpaɖaa yɔ, ɛ-tʋmɩyɛ yɔɔ.
text_en: He received the "Hero of the Soviet Union", the Soviet Union's highest honor, for his work.

text: Pɩlabɩ pɩnzɩ hiu pʋwayɩ lɛ, ɛɖɛɛ Sovietiki mba nɔɔ Apollo-Soyuz nʋmɔʋ ɖɔm taa, nɛ pɩwɩlɩ se Tɩɩnzɩ taa wobu Seya tɛma.
text_en: Ten years later, he led the Soviet part of the Apollo–Soyuz mission symbolizing that the Space Race was over.

text: Ɛyɔɔdaa se : ʺTɔm natʋyʋ tɩtalɩ-ɖʋ nɛ tɩwɩlɩɣ se piileɖiɣ lɛ you nakʋyʋ lakɩ.ʺ
text_en: She said, "There is no intelligence to suggest that an attack is expected imminently.

text: Paa papasɩ kaɖɛ nɖɩ ɖɩpɩzɩɣ nɛ ɖɩkɔɔ yɔ ɖi-ɖoŋ nɛ pɩmaɣna yɔ, pɩtɩwɩlɩ se kaɖɛ naɖɩyɛ ɛɛtasɩɣ kɔm.ʺ
text_en: However, the reduction of the threat level to severe does not mean the overall threat has gone away."

text: Paa ñʋndɩnaa taatɩlɩ ɖeyi ɖeyi se kaɖɛ naɖɩyɛ kaɣ kɔm yɔ, FBI paɣ Maryland Transportation Authority se kɩɖɩɣ.
text_en: While authorities are unsure of the credibility of the threat, the Maryland Transportaion Authority made the closure with the urging of the FBI.

text: Lɔɔɖa sɔsɔna wena akuu kañɩŋa yɔ pakpaɣ-yɛ nɛ paɖɩɣ pɔʋ nɔnɔsɩ nɛ polisinaa 80 kaawɛ peeɖe nɛ pawɩlɩɣ lɔɔɖa sayaa se pɛkɛɛ nʋmɔʋ.
text_en: Dump trucks were used to block tube entrances and assistance of 80 police were on hand to direct motorists to detours.

text: Patɩyɔɔdɩ se nabʋyʋ lɛzɩ lɔɔɖa habɩyɛ kɩkɛzɩyɛ yɔɔ, tɛtʋ taa habɩyɛ naalɛ ñɩnɖɛ.
text_en: There were no heavy traffic delays reported on the beltway, the city's alternate route.

text: Naajeeriya kaatɛm yɔɔdʋʋ se kɩñɩnɩɣ se kɩsʋʋ ZLECA taa kpɩtaʋ kʋɖʋmʋʋ pʋcɔ nɛ kediyzaɣ sɔsɔɔ paɣzɩ.
text_en: Nigeria previously announced it planned to join the AfCFTA in the week leading up to the summit.

text: UA tadɩyɛ nɛ wondu lubu tʋma yɔɔ cɔnɩyʋ Albert Muchanga kaasusaa se Peenɛɛ kaɣ sʋʋ pɩ-taa.
text_en: AU trade and industry commissioner Albert Muchanga announced Benin was to join.

text: Tʋmɩyɛ yɔɔ cɔnɩyʋ yɔɔdaa se : ʺĐɩtɩnɩɩnɩ ɖama nɛ pɩtɛ pɩlɩɩnɩ kiɖe tɛɛ paɣtʋ nɛ pɛdʋʋ tikee yɔɔ, ɛlɛ mbʋ ɖɩwɛna yɔ pɩɖɔwa se ɖɩpaɣzɩ tadɩyɛ labʋ Hasɩɖɩyaɖɛ fenaɣ kajalaɣ kɩyakʋ wiye, pɩnaɣ 2020 taa.ʺ
text_en: The commissioner said, "We haven't yet agreed on rules of origin and tariff con[c]essions, but the framework we have is enough to start trading on July 1, 2020".

text: Tɩɩnzɩ taa wobu lɔɔɖɩyɛ sɔsɔyɛ tɩlɛɣzɩ ɖɩ-wɛtʋ paa ɖiilesi ñɩnʋʋ nakʋyʋ kiɖe tɛɛ kɔyɔ, pɩkɔɔ pɩtalɩ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ pɛtɛm lɩʋ ɛsɔdaa helim taa yɔ.
text_en: The station maintained its attitude, despite the loss of a gyroscope earlier in the space station mission, until the end of the spacewalk.

text: Chiao nɛ Sharipov pɔyɔɔdaa se pɩkɛ pɛɛyɛ posuu pɩlɩɩnɩ menziiniwaa mba pɔñɔɔzʋʋ wɛtʋ yɔ.
text_en: Chiao and Sharipov reported being a safe distance from the attitude adjustment thrusters.

text: Rusii ñɩma mba paawɛ tataa yɔ patʋsɩ miŋ nɩɩyɩ nɛ tɩɩnzɩ taa wobu lɔɔɖɩyɛ tasɩ hiɣu ɖɩ-wɛtʋ maɣmaɣ.
text_en: Russian ground control activated the jets and normal attitude of the station was regained.

text: Paya tɔm ndʋ Firjinii mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ peeɖe ɛntɛrnɛɛtɩ haʋ tʋmɩyɛ AOL kaawɛɛ, nɛ nɖɩ yanɩ tɔm.
text_en: The case was prosecuted in Virginia because it is the home to the leading internet service provider AOL, the company who instigated the charges.

text: Kajalaɣ ɖeɖe lɛ pakʋʋ nɔɔyʋ tɔm pɩtɩŋnɩ paɣtʋ ndʋ palɩzɩ-tʋ pɩnaɣ 2003 taa nɛ tikiziɣ se pataatayɩ ɛyaa sakɩyɛ ɛntɛrnɛɛtɩ takayɩsɩ nzɩ patɩpɔzɩ yɔ, pʋ-tɔbʋʋ se spam waa pɛ-tɛ ɛntɛrnɛɛtɩ takayɩsɩ mʋʋ aɖakasɩ taa.
text_en: This is the first time a conviction has been gained using the legislation enacted in 2003 to curb bulk e-mail, aka spam, from unsolicited distribution into users mailboxes.

text: Jesus weyi ɛwɛnɩ pɩnzɩ 21 yɔ ewobi Manchester City taa pinde Kɔlaɣ fenaɣ pɩnaɣ 2017 taa, ɛlɩnɩ Preeziili ɛgbɛyɛ Palmeiras taa nɛ pɛhɛyɩ ɛ-yɔɔ livre sterling miliiyɔɔwaa 27.
text_en: 21-year-old Jesus joined Manchester City last year in January 2017 from Brazilian club Palmeiras for a reported fee of £27 million.

text: Kpaɣnɩ mbʋ lɛ, Preeziili tʋ ɛnʋ ɛmabɩ ɛgbɛyɛ tɛ maacɩwaa 53 nɛ ɛɖʋzɩ kpaɣlaa 24.
text_en: Since then, the Brazilian has featured in 53 matches for the club in all competitions and has scored 24 goals.

text: Dr. Lee yɔɔdaa ɖɔɖɔ se pɩha-ɩ lɩmaɣza alɩwaatʋ ndʋ ɛnɩwa se Turikii piya nasɩyɩ mʋ sumasɩ tuutu A kʋdɔŋ piye (H5N1) ɛlɛ sɩtɩtɔlɩ kʋdɔŋ yɔ.
text_en: Dr. Lee also expressed his concern about reports that children in Turkey have now become infected with the A(H5N1) avian influenza virus without becoming ill.

text: Ɛyɔɔdaa se nabɛyɛ ñɩnaa lɛ pana se pʋtɔma kʋdɔŋ lɛɣzɩɣ nɛ kɩɩtasɩɣ kʋʋ ɛyaa sakɩyɛ pʋcɔ kɩkɔɔ nɛ kɩpɩsɩ ɛjaɖɛ kpeekpe kʋdɔŋ kɩɖɛɖɛʋ.
text_en: Some studies suggest that the disease must become less lethal before it can cause a global epidemic, he noted.

text: Điseɣ sɔɔndʋ se kʋdɔndɩnaa ɩtaawolo pɩ-yɔɔ nɛ pɛɖɛzɩɣ ɛyaa sakɩyɛ kʋdɔŋ pe-evemiye tʋma labʋ taa ye paanɩɣ tuutu taŋ sakɩyɛ yɔ.
text_en: There is concern that patients may continue to infect more people by going through their daily routines if the flu symptoms remain mild.

text: Leslie Aun weyi ɛkɛ Komen Foundation nɔɔ ɖɛyʋ yɔ, ɛyɔɔdaa se ɛgbɛyɛ ɖʋ paɣtʋ kɩfatʋ natʋyʋ ndʋ tɩɩhaɣ nʋmɔʋ se paha liidiye yaa samtʋ nimiye agbaa wena peɖiɣni ñɩnʋʋ tɔm a-yɔɔ yɔ.
text_en: Leslie Aun, a spokesperson for the Komen Foundation, said the organization adopted a new rule that does not allow grants or funding to be awarded to organizations that are under legal investigation.

text: Komen paɣtʋ yɔɔ lɛ, kikizi Planned Parenthood mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ Paɣtʋ Lɩzɩyʋ Cliff Stearns ɖiɣni ñɩnʋʋ se ɛna ɛzɩma Planned Parenthood lakɩnɩ liidiye tʋmɩyɛ yɔ nɛ kiheyiɣ liidiye nɖɩ kɩwɛna yɔ.
text_en: Komen's policy disqualified Planned Parenthood due to a pending investigation on how Planned Parenthood spends and reports its money that is being conducted by Representative Cliff Stearns.

text: Stearns ɖiɣni ñɩnʋʋ se ɛna se ɛzɩ Planned Parenthood wɛɛ nɛ kɩkpakɩɣ tikee liidiye nɛ kɩlɩzɩɣnɩ hosi na, ɛnʋ weyi ɛkɛ kɔɔmiite cikpeluu ŋgʋ kifeŋiɣ nɛ kɩñɩnɩɣ wondu yɔ kɩ-ñʋʋdʋ yɔ, ŋgʋ kɩwɛ Tadɩyɛ nɛ Đoŋ Đɩɣa Kɔɔmiite tɛɛ yɔ.
text_en: Stearns is investigating whether taxes are used to fund abortions through Planned Parenthood in his role as chairman of the Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee, which is under the umbrella of the House Energy and Commerce Committee.

text: Masasusɛɛtɩ egeetiye yɔɔ cɔnɩyʋ kɩbɩnʋ Mitt Romney wabɩ Piya wiye Floriidi taa Republiki mba tɛ politiki tɛ ɛjaɖɛ ñʋʋdʋ lɩzʋʋ kajalaɣ caca tɔʋ nɛ 46%.
text_en: Former Massachusetts governor Mitt Romney won the Florida Republican Party presidential primary election on Tuesday with over 46 percent of the vote.

text: Etaazuuni Paɣtʋ Lɩzɩyaa Ñʋʋdʋ kajalaɣ ñɩnʋ Newt Gingrich kaakɛnɩ naalɛ tʋ nɛ 32%.
text_en: Former U.S. Speaker of the House Newt Gingrich came in second with 32 percent.

text: Floriidi kaakɛ egeetiye nɖɩ ɖɩ-waɖʋ mʋʋ pɩtɩŋa yɔ, nɛ kɩcɛlɩ ki-tiyiyaa nɩɩnʋwa Romney, nɛ pituyi-i nɛ ɛsɩndaa se ɛkɛ Republiki mba ɛgbɛyɛ nɔɔ ɖɛyʋ ɛjaɖɛ ñʋʋdʋ lɩzʋʋ caca tɔʋ taa.
text_en: As a winner-takes-all state, Florida awarded all fifty of its delegates to Romney, pushing him ahead as the front-runner for the Republican Party nomination.

text: Mba pɔñɔɔzɩ apɩɣya ɖɔnɛ nɖɩ yɔ pɔyɔɔdaa se ɛyaa ɛzɩ 100 000 kaalɩ Caama tɛtʋ sɔsɔtʋ ɛzɩ  tʋnɛ tɩ-taa yɔ : Pɛrlɛɛ, Kolɔɔñɩ, Hambuuri nɛ Hanovrɩ.
text_en: Organisers of the protest said about 100,000 people turned up in German cities such as Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, and Hanover.

text: Bɛrlɛɛ tɛtʋ taa, polisi maɣzɩɣ se ɛyaa mba palɩwa nɛ papʋʋyɩ yɔ patalɩ 6500.
text_en: In Berlin, police estimated 6,500 protestors.

text: Ɛyaa lɩwa nɛ papʋʋyɩ ɖɔɖɔ Paarii, Sofiya Pulgaarii ɛjaɖɛ taa, Viliniyusi Lituyaani ɛjaɖɛ taa, Valeta Malta ɛjaɖɛ taa, Taliini Ɛstoonii ɛjaɖɛ taa, Edɛŋbuuri nɛ Glasgow Ekɔɔsɩ ɛjaɖɛ taa.
text_en: Protests also took place in Paris, Sofia in Bulgaria, Vilnius in Lithuania, Valetta in Malta, Tallinn in Estonia, and Edinburgh and Glasgow in Scotland.

text: Lɔndrɩɩ tɛtʋ taa, ɛyaa ɛzɩ 200 mbʋ yɔ lɩ pa-ɖɩsɩ taa nɛ papʋyʋʋnɩ tʋma sɔsɔna wena ahaɣ ɛyaa takayɩsɩ se pɩwɩlɩ se patɩnɩ nabʋyʋ yɔ a-wayɩ.
text_en: In London, about 200 people protested outside some major copyright holders' offices.

text: Fenaɣ ŋga kɛɖɛwa yɔ ka-taa, ɛyaa sakɩyɛ lɩ habɛɛ yɔɔ nɛ papʋʋyɩ Polɔɔñɩ ɛjaɖɛ taa alɩwaatʋ ndʋ ɛjaɖɛ nɖɩ ɖɩñɩɣ nesi ACTA yɔɔ yɔ, piyeba nɛ Polɔɔñɩ komina kpaɣ lɩmaɣzɩyɛ se ɖɩɩtɩsɩɣ nɛ ɖɩɖɔ mbʋ paɖʋwa yɔ pɩ-yɔɔ pʋcɔ.
text_en: Last month, there were major protests in Poland when that country signed ACTA, which has led to the Polish government deciding not to ratify the agreement, for now.

text: Lativiya nɛ Slovakiya pa-naalɛ potuzini ɛsɩndaa lɩmaɣzɩyɛ nɖɩ paakpaɣ se pasʋʋ ACTA taa.
text_en: Latvia and Slovakia have both delayed the process of joining ACTA.

text: Animal Liberation nɛ Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) tasɩ mabʋ kubuka se pɩkɛnɩ kɩjɛyʋʋ se paɖʋ kameeraawaa mba pefeŋiɣ nɛ pakpakɩɣ videowaa yɔ Ositralii lona wena a-taa pakʋʋ kpɩna yɔ a-tɩŋa a-taa.
text_en: Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs.

text: Hadɛ Kiŋ Nuvɛɛlɩ Kaalɩ tɛ RSPCA kilimiyu sɔsɔ David O'Shannessy heyi ABC se lona wena a-taa pakʋʋ kpɩna yɔ a-yɔɔ cɔnʋʋ nɛ a-taa kilimuu kaɣ kɛʋ tʋmɩyɛ nɖɩ palakɩ ɖoŋ ɖoŋ yɔ Ositralii ɛjaɖɛ taa.
text_en: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy told the ABC that surveillance and inspections of abattoirs should be commonplace in Australia.

text: ʺKameeraawaa mba pefeŋiɣ nɛ pakpakɩɣ videowaa yɔ kaɣ yebu se ɛyaa mba palakɩnɩ tʋmɩyɛ kpɩna yɔ, peɖiɣzina se a-camɩyɛ wɛtʋ tɔm cɛyaa pɩdɩɩfɛyɩ.ʺ
text_en: "The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."

text: Tɛtʋ ñamsʋʋ aŋjaʋ ŋgʋ payaɣ se The United States Geological Survey international map yɔ, kɩtɩwɩlɩ se tɛtʋ ñamsʋʋ nabʋyʋ laba Izilandɩ ɛjaɖɛ taa kpɩtaʋ ŋgʋ kɩɖɛwa yɔ kɩ-taa.
text_en: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior.

text: Izilaadɩ ɛjaɖɛ taa tʋmɩyɛ nɖɩ ɖɩcɔŋnɩ ɛjaɖɛ wɛtʋ yɔɔ yɔ, ɖɩyɔɔdaa se patɩnɩɩ tɛtʋ ñamsʋʋ taŋ Hekla egeetiye taa ñɩɣtʋ 48 ndʋ tɩɖɛwa yɔ tɩ-taa
text_en: The Icelandic Meteorological Office also reported no earthquake activity in the Hekla area in the past 48 hours.

text: Tɛtʋ ñamsʋʋ nabʋyʋ laba pɩlɛɣzɩ tɛtʋ wɛtʋ Lakɩŋ fenaɣ 10 wiye Kaldera pʋʋ ŋgʋ kɩtɔʋ miŋ yɔ kɩ-tɛ hayo kiŋ nɛ wɩsɩ ɖɩlɩyɛ hɔɔlʋʋ taa.
text_en: The significant earthquake activity resulting in the phase change had took place on March 10 on the northeast side of the volcano's summit caldera.

text: Pana pʋʋ liu tɛɛ mɩndʋ kɩkpɛɛdɩtʋ natʋyʋ nɛ tɩtɩlɩɩnɩ tɛtɛɛ miŋ weyi pʋʋ tɔʋ yɔ tɩ-cɔlɔ.
text_en: Dark clouds unrelated to any volcanic activity were reported at the base of the mountain.

text: Mɩndʋ wɛtʋ pɩzɩɣ piyele nɛ piyiɣdi ɛyʋ nɛ ɛmaɣzɩ se pʋʋ nakʋyʋ tɔ miŋ.
text_en: The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.

text: Luno kasɩɣlɩ sanzɩ ɛzɩ mɛtanaa kuubi 120-160 alɩwaatʋ ndʋ kɩwɛɛkaa nɛ helim sɔsɔm nɛ lɩm hola tuzi-kʋ nɛ piwoni teŋgu kidiiliŋ yɔɔ kaaŋ weyi ɩsɩnzʋʋ lɩm hola yɔ ɩ-yɔɔ.
text_en: The Luno had 120–160 cubic metres of fuel aboard when it broke down and high winds and waves pushed it into the breakwater.

text: Elikɔpɩtɛɛrɩwaa yabɩ ɛyaa hiu nɛ naalɛ mba paawɛ kɩ-taa yɔ pa-ñʋʋ nɛ ɛyʋ kʋɖʋm weyi ɛmʋ heŋ yɔ, ɛ-mɔɔʋ yɔkɩna.
text_en: Helicopters rescued the twelve crewmembers and the only injury was a broken nose.

text: Mɛlɛ ŋgʋ kɩ-ɖaɣlɩkɩŋ kaakɛ mɛtanaa 100 nɛ kiwokaɣ se kɩkpaɣ huɖe nɖɩ kɩtɩɩkpakɩɣ yɔ nɛ ñʋndɩnaa seɣaɣ sɔɔndʋ kiɖe tɛɛ se kitaahuti mbʋ kɩsɩɣla yɔ pɩ-taa nabʋyʋ.
text_en: The 100-metre ship was en route to pick up its usual fertiliser cargo and initially officials feared the vessel could spill a load.

text: Paɣtʋ ñɔɔzʋʋ mbʋ pɔpɔzaa yɔ, paɣtʋ lɩzɩyaa agbaa naalɛ tɛm-pʋ kpaɣʋ nɛ palabɩnɩ tʋmɩyɛ pɩnaɣ 2011 taa.
text_en: The proposed amendment already passed both houses in 2011.

text: Palabɩ lɛɣzɩtʋ paɣtʋ lɩzɩyaa kediɣzaɣ kanɛ ka-taa alɩwaatʋ ndʋ Paɣtʋ Lɩzɩyaa Ɛgbɛyɛ Kajalaɣ ñɩnɖɛ kaacalɩ hɩzʋʋ tɔm loyaɣ naalɛ ñɩŋga, nɛ pʋwayɩ lɛ Paɣtʋ Lɩzɩyaa Ɛgbɛyɛ naalɛ ñɩnɖɛ ñakpaɣ tɔm loyaɣ ŋga kɔ-ɖɔndɩ nɛ palabɩnɩ tʋmɩyɛ Hodo wiye.
text_en: A change was made this legislative session when the second sentence was deleted first by the House of Representatives and then was passed in a similar form by the Senate Monday.

text: Tɔm loyaɣ naalɛ ñɩŋga ŋga patitisi kɔ-yɔɔ yɔ, kɔpɔzʋʋ se pataaha nʋmɔʋ nɛ ɛyaa mba paka kʋzʋʋ pilinzi yɔ pɔɖɔkɩ nesi komina ɛsɩndaa, pɩwɩlɩɣ se pʋtɔma yɔ pɩɖɛɣnɩ ɛsɩndaa lɛ pakaɣ haʋ nʋmɔʋ se pɔɖɔkɩ nesi komina ɛsɩndaa.
text_en: The failure of the second sentence, which proposes to ban same-sex civil unions, could possibly open the door for civil unions in the future.

text: Pʋwayɩ lɛ, paɣtʋ lɩzɩyaa mba pakaɣ-wɛ lɩzʋʋ pɩnaɣ 2015 yaa 2016 taa yɔ pakaɣ tasʋʋ tazʋʋ HJR-3 taa se pɩsa nɛ kiwolo pɩ-yɔɔ.
text_en: Following the process, HJR-3 will be reviewed again by the next elected legislature in either 2015 or 2016 to remain in process.

text: Vautier labɩ tʋma wena nɛ afɛyɩ ɖiyuu taa yɔ, a-taa kɛlɛ apɩɣya nɔɔ hɔkʋʋ mbʋ ɛlaba se ɛlʋbɩnɩ kañatʋ lakasɩ politiki nʋmɔʋ taa pɩnaɣ 1973 taa.
text_en: Vautier's achievements outside of directing include a hunger strike in 1973 against what he viewed as political censorship.

text: Pɛlɛɣzɩ Fransɩɩ paɣtʋ. ɛɛwɛnɩ pɩnzɩ 15 lɛ ɛpaɣzɩ ɛ-lʋbɩyɛ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ ɛsʋ mba palʋkaɣ Fransɩ yɔɔ Caama You naalɛ ñɩŋgʋ taa yɔ.
text_en: French law was changed. His activism went back to age 15 when he joined the French Resistance during World War II.

text: Ɛkpɛlɩkɩ lɔŋ pɩnaɣ 1998 takayaɣ nakɛyɛ taa.
text_en: He documented himself in a 1998 book.

text: Pɩnzɩ 1960 waa taa, ɛpɩsɩ Alizerii ŋgʋ kɩmʋ tɩ-yɔɔ wɛʋ pitileɖita yɔ se ɛwɩlɩ ɛzɩma palakɩ filimwaa yɔ.
