text_en: In the 1960s he headed back to newly-independent Algeria to teach film directing.

text: Judo aleɣya laɖʋ Japɔŋ tʋ Hitoshi Saito weyi ɛɛmʋ Olɛmpiki sika lɩyɩŋ naalɛ yɔ, ɛsɩbɩ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ ɛwɛnɩ pɩnzɩ 54 yɔ.
text_en: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.

text: Posusi se ɛ-sɩm lɩnɩ hɔyɛ taa hosaɣ kansɛɛrɩ kʋdɔŋ cɔlɔ.
text_en: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.

text: Ɛsɩbɩ Osaka Piya wiye.
text_en: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.

text: Pɩtasɩna se ɛɛkɛ waɖʋ Olɛmpiki nɛ Ɛjaɖɛ kpeekpe aleɣya santaɖaʋ taa lɛ, Saito kaakɛ Japɔŋ Judo Ɛgbɛyɛ falɩsʋʋ tɛ kɔɔmiite ñʋʋdʋ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ ɛsɩba yɔ.
text_en: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.

text: Ɛyaa ɛzɩ 100 mbʋ yɔ kaakɔm kazandʋ taa, se pɔtɔɔ halʋ nɔɔyʋ nɛ ɛ-walʋ pa-pɩnaɣ kʋɖʋmaɣ nesi ɖɔkʋʋ kazandʋ, mba pɔɖɔkɩ nesi pinde yɔ.
text_en: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.

text: Ñʋndɩnaa yɔɔdaa se paɖʋwa se palakɩ kɩyakʋ kɩtɔzʋʋ kazandʋ sɔsɔtʋ kɩyakʋ nakʋyʋ nɛ ɛsɩndaa.
text_en: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.

text: Paaɖɔkɩ nesi Texas pɩlakɩ pɩnaɣ yɔ nɛ pʋwayɩ lɛ pɔkɔɔ Buffalo se pa nɛ pa-taabalaa nɛ pɔ-hɔʋ taa mba pɔtɔɔ kazandʋ.
text_en: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.

text: Walʋ kaawɛnɩ pɩnzɩ 30, palʋlɩ-ɩ Buffalo, nɛ ɛɛwɛ ɛyaa naanza mba pakʋ malɩfanaa tɔʋ taa, ɛlɛ ɛ-halʋ ñatɩmʋ heŋ.
text_en: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.

text: Karno kɛ Aŋglɛɛ wɩlɩyʋ weyi pasɩmɩ-ɩ camɩyɛ ɛlɛ ɛ-tɔm taakɛdɩnɩ paa anɩ, nɛ ɛwɩlɩ Modern Education nɛ King’s Glory pɛ-tɛɛ nɛ ɛkʋndaɣ se ɛɛwɛnɩ sukulibiya 9000 alɩwaatʋ ndʋ ɛwɩlaɣ siŋŋ yɔ.
text_en: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

text: Ɛ-takayɩsɩ taa lɛ, ɛlakaɣnɩ tɔm pee wena lʋlɩyaa nabɛyɛ maɣzaɣ se akɛ kaañamtʋ tɔm yɔ, nɛ pɩwɛ ɛzɩ ɛlabɩnɩ tʋmɩyɛ tʋtʋ sukuli ɖaŋ taa.
text_en: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

text: Modern Education kpa-ɩ se ɛlɩzɩ takayɩsɩ sɔsɔsɩ nɛ ɛlabɩnɩ publicité waa lɔɔɖa taa ɛlɛ ɛtɩ pɔzɩ nʋmɔʋ nɛ ɛcɛtɩ se ɛkɛ Aŋglɛɛ wɩlɩyʋ sɔsɔ.
text_en: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

text: Paatɛmɩ-ɩ kpaʋ ɖɔɖɔ se ɛmɩlɩ nɔɔyʋ tʋmɩyɛ, ɛlɛ patɩyaa-ɩ tɔm.
text_en: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

text: E-sukulibɩɣa kɩbɩnaɣ nakɛyɛ yɔɔdaa se ‘ɛyɔɔdaɣ kʋnʋŋ cɛkʋʋ sukuli ɖaŋ taa, ɛwɩlɩɣ ɖanɩyɛ lɛɣtʋ ɛ-takayɩsɩ taa, nɛ ɛɛwɛ ɛzɩ sukubibiya taabalʋ yem yɔ.’
text_en: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

text: Pɩnzɩ niidozo nzɩ sɩɖɛwa sɩ-taa, Siini kaakɛ kɔministiwaa ɛjaɖɛ, paa mbʋ pañaɣ pana nɛ pɛwɛɛnɩ tadɩyɛ tɔsʋʋ lɛɣtʋ.
text_en: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text: Palabɩ kajalaɣ tɔsʋʋ lɛɣzɩtʋ Deng Xiaoping nɔɔ ɖɛʋ alɩwaatʋ taa.
text_en: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text: Kpaɣnɩ mbʋ lɛ, Siini tɔsʋʋ paɣlaa nɛ pɩtalɩ tam 90.
text_en: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

text: Pinde, Siini ɖɛ Caama yɔɔ kajalaɣ ɖeɖe lɔɔɖa pɛdʋʋ ajɛɛ lɛɛna taa, nɛ kɩɖɛɛ Etaazuuni yɔɔ nɛ kɩpɩsɩ lone nɖɩ ɖɩ-taa pakɩlɩɣ lɔɔɖa pɛdʋʋ yɔ.
text_en: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: Pɩnzɩ nɛɛlɛ taa lɛ, Siini tɛ PIB kaɣ kpaɖʋʋ Etaazuuni ñɩŋgʋ.
text_en: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: Tropiiki Tɛʋ sɔsɔʋ Danielle kaakɛ tɛʋ sɔsɔʋ ŋgʋ paha-kʋ hɩɖɛ pɩnaɣ 2010 Atɩlantiiki helim tɛʋ sɔsɔʋ alɩwaatʋ taa, nɛ kɩlɩnɩ Atɩlantiiki Teŋgu wɩsɩ ɖɩlɩyɛ taa kiŋ.
text_en: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: Tɛʋ sɔsɔʋ kaaposini Miami, Floriidi taa ɛzɩ miles waa 3000, nɛ ki-helim seɣaɣ ɛzɩ 40 mph (kilomɛtanaa 64 paa ñɩɣyʋʋ ŋgʋ.)
text_en: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: Lɛɣtʋ ñɩnɩyaa mba pɛwɛ Helim Tɛʋ Sɔsɔʋ Tʋmɩyɛ Đɩlaɖɛ yɔ pɔyɔɔdaa se Danielle kaɣ kpaʋ ɖoŋ nɛ pɩɩtalɩɣ Cɩla wiye lɛ, kɩpɩsɩ helim tɛʋ sɔsɔʋ.
text_en: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Ɛzɩma tɛʋ sɔsɔʋ tɩwɩzɩtɩ tukunuu tɛtʋ yɔ pʋyɔɔ lɛ, pɩwɛ kaɖɛ se peɖiɣzini ɖoŋ kɩkaɣ wɛnʋʋ Etaazuuni yaa Karayiib yɔɔ yɔ.
text_en: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: Palʋlɩ Bobek Krowasii tɛtʋ sɔsɔtʋ Zagrɛɛbɩ taa, ɛlɛ ɛyaa sakɩyɛ kɔm nɛ patɩlɩ-ɩ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ ɛmakaɣ Partizan Belgrade taa yɔ.
text_en: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

text: Ɛsʋ pa-taa pɩnaɣ 1945 nɛ ɛcaɣ peeɖe nɛ pɩkɔɔ pɩtalɩ pɩnaɣ 1958.
text_en: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

text: Alɩwaatʋ ndʋ ɛlabɩ ɛgbɛyɛ nɖɩ ɖɩ-taa yɔ, ɛɖʋzɩ kpaɣla 403 maacɩwaa 468 mba ɛmaba yɔ pa-taa.
text_en: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

text: Nɔɔyʋ tɩma maacɩwaa sakɩyɛ yaa tɩɖʋzɩ kpaɣla sakɩyɛ nɛ pɩtalɩ Bobek, ɛgbɛyɛ nɖɩ ɖɩ-taa.
text_en: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

text: Pɩnaɣ 1995 taa lɛ, pɔtɔ caca nɛ palɩzɩ-ɩ se ɛkɛ pombo maɖʋ weyi ɛkpaɖaa yɔ Partizan wezuu caɣʋ taa.
text_en: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

text: Papaɣzɩ kazandʋ nɛ ŋgee aleɣya wɩlʋʋ wena aleɣya ɛgbɛyɛ Cirque du Soleil nɖɩ ɖɩ-hɩɖɛ sɛ ɛjaɖɛ kpeekpe yɔɔ yɔ, ɖɩlaba yɔ.
text_en: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

text: Pʋwayɩ lɛ Isitanbuuli Ɛjaɖɛ symponie hendu teyaa, sɔɔjanaa ɛgbɛyɛ naɖɩyɛ nɛ hendu teyaa Fatih Erkoç nɛ Müslüm Gürses patɩŋ ɛ-wayɩ.
text_en: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

text: Paba wayɩ lɛ, mba papaɣ nɛ pɔcɔzʋʋ pa-tɩ mba lɩnɩ aleɣya ɖɩlaɖɛ.
text_en: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

text: Turikii hendu teyu halɩñɩnʋ Sezen Aksu weyi ɛ-nɔɔ wɛ leleŋ kamaɣ fɛyɩ yɔ, ɛ nɛ Italii hendu teu abalɩñɩnʋ Alessandro Safina weyi ɛ-nɔɔ wɛ fɩɩɩ nɛ Grɛɛkɩ hendu teyu Haris Alexiou palɩɩ nɛ petee hendu.
text_en: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text: Kɛdɛzaɣ ɖeɖe lɛ, Turikii payaa ɛgbɛyɛ Fire of Anatolia lɩnaa nɛ papaa ʺTroyʺ.
text_en: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: Seya kpokpo sayʋ Peter Lenz weyi ɛwɛnɩ pɩnzɩ 13 yɔ, ɛsɩbɩ kɛgbɛdɩsaɣ nakɛyɛ taa Indianapolis Motor Speedway.
text_en: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Ɛsaɣaɣ kpokpo se kɩsaa miŋ lɛ, Lenz lɩwa nɛ ɛtɔlɩ nɛ ɛ-taabalʋ seya kpokpo sayʋ Xavier Zayat kɔɔ nɛ ɛmabɩ-ɩ.
text_en: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: Đɔkɔtɔnaa mba paawɛ seya kadaɣ taa peeɖe yɔ, pacaŋ pɔcɔnɩ e-ɖeɖe kpaagbaa nɛ pakpaɣ-ɩ powona tɛtʋ taa ɖɔkɔtɔ nakʋyʋ taa nɛ ɛsɩ peeɖe pʋwayɩ.
text_en: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Zayat tɩmʋ heŋ nɩɩyɩ kɛgbɛdɩsaɣ taa.
text_en: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Zapatero maɣzaɣ ɛjaɖɛ yɔɔ liidiye tɔm wɛ ɛzɩma lɛ, ewolo pɩ-yɔɔ nɛ ɛyɔɔdɩ se ʺliidiye ɖʋtʋ kɛ tɔsʋʋ hɔɔlʋʋ nakʋyʋ, hɔɔlʋʋ ŋgʋ kɩ-tɔm cɛyaa yɔ.
text_en: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Đɩkatɩ kaɖɛ liidiye nʋmɔʋ taa pɩlakɩ pɩnaɣ yɔ, nɛ pɩɩsa miŋ kpem fenasɩ naalɛ nzɩ sɩɖɛwa yɔ sɩ-taa, nɛ lɛɛlɛɛyɔ tʋma sɔsɔna wena acɔŋnɩ liidiye yɔɔ yɔ apaɣzɩ hiɣu sooci.ʺ
text_en: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: Kpɩtaʋ ŋgʋ kɩɖɛwa yɔ kɩ-taa, Naked News susaa se kɩsɔzʋ sakɩyɛ ajɛɛ lɛɛna kʋnʋmɩŋ weyi kɩlakɩnɩ tʋmɩyɛ yɔ, nɛ kɩsɔzɩ ɖʋtʋ kɩfatʋ naadozo.
text_en: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: Ɛjaɖɛ kpeekpe ɛgbɛyɛ nɖɩ ɖɩtɛm paɣzʋʋ labɩnʋʋ tʋmɩyɛ Aŋglɛɛ nɛ Japɔŋ kʋnʋŋ, lɛɛlɛɛyɔ ɖɩlɩzɩɣ ɖʋtʋ Ɛsɩpañɔɔlɩ, Itaalii kʋnʋŋ nɛ Kooree kunʋŋ taa, teelee yɔɔ, ɛntɛrnɛɛtɩ yɔɔ nɛ pɔrtaabɩlɩnaa yɔɔ.
text_en: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Ñʋʋ leleŋ se nabʋyʋ tɩlabɩ-m, ɛlɛ mana sɔɔndʋ lakasɩ, alɩwaatʋ ndʋ ɛyaa yɔkaɣ mondoɖebɔŋ se palɩɩ yɔ.
text_en: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Ɛyaa makaɣ mondoɖebɔŋ ñɩnɩŋ, ɛlɛ pataapɩzɩɣ se pɔyɔkɩ mondoɖebɔŋ ɛnɩ.
text_en: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: Franciszek Kowal weyi ehiɣ ñʋʋ yabʋ yɔ ɛyɔɔdaa se : ʺPɩkɛdaa lɛ, ñɩnʋʋ nakʋyʋ yɔkɩ, nɛ papaɣzɩ lɩnʋʋ mondoɖebɔʋ.ʺ
text_en: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Tɩɩnzɩ haɣ ñalɩmɩyɛ nɛ soŋaɣ mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ lɩzɩɣ ɖoŋ nɩɩyɩ aliwaatʋ ndʋ hydrogène mʋzʋʋ pee kpɛndɩɣ ɖama nɛ pɩpɩsɩ yuŋ wondu yɔ.
text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Lɛɣtʋ ñɩnɩyaa ɖiɣni labʋ tʋmɩyɛ se palɩzɩ menziini nakʋyʋ ŋgʋ kɩpɩzɩɣ nɛ kɩlɩzɩ ɖoŋ pɩtɩŋnɩ nʋmɔʋ kʋyʋmʋʋ ŋgʋ kɩ-yɔɔ.
text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Ɛlɛ pɩkɛ tʋmɩyɛ nɖɩ ɖɩcaɣ kaɖɛ kpem yɔ nɛ pɩkaɣ kpaɣʋ pɩnzɩ sakɩyɛ pʋcɔ nɛ ɖɩna menziiniwaa mba pɛkpɛndɩɣ mʋzʋʋ pee yɔ pɛwɛɛ nɛ palakɩ tʋmɩyɛ camɩyɛ.
text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Ñɩɣtʋ ɖoŋ ñɩndʋ ɛjɔʋ kaawɛ lɩm yɔɔ mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ lɩm wɛnɩ doŋ nɩɩyɩ pɩ-yɔɔ kiŋ.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Lɩm yɔɔ ɖoŋ ɛnɩ ɩlakɩ tʋmɩyɛ mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ lɩm pee wena awɛ lɩm yɔɔ yɔ ahɔŋ ɖama siŋŋ nɛ pɩkpaɖɩ ɛzɩma ɩhɔŋ helim pee wena awɛ a-ñʋʋ yɔɔ yɔ
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Lɩm pee kpɛndɩɣ nɛ ala ɛzɩ tɔnɛ nɖɩ paanaɣ lɩm yɔɔ nɛ mbʋ yebina nɛ wondu ɛzɩ ɛjɔʋ yaɣ lɩm mbʋ pɩ-yɔɔ.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Kpata ŋgʋ potuuni ɖɔmbɛɛ yɔɔ yɔ kɩwɛnɩ sɩɣa ŋga kɛwɛɛnɩ kpɛɛnzɩ naalɛ nɛ hɛkʋ taa wɛɛ kulam yɔ. Kpɛnzɩ nzɩ sɩsɩɣna se kɩñɔɔnɩ ɖɔmbɛɛ camɩyɛ paa kikpilaa kɔyɔ.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Ɛzɩma sɩɣa tɛɛ pikoti pazɩ yɔ, paa sɩɣa ekpiliɣni hɔɔlʋʋ kʋɖʋmʋʋ yaa lɛɛkʋ yɔɔ kɔyɔ, kpɛɛŋa ŋga kotukuuni ɖɔmbɛɛ yɔ, kokotuu ɖɔɖɔ.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Pɩlakɩ nɛ kpata sayʋ kɛzɩ ɛ-tɩ. Ye kpata ekpilini nɩwaŋ yɔɔ kɔyɔ, kpata sayʋ kɛzɩɣ ɛ-tɩ nɩwaŋ yɔɔ, ye kpata ekpilini nɩmɩyɛ yɔɔ, kpata sayʋ kɛzɩɣ ɛ-tɩ nɩmɩyɛ yɔɔ.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Pɩsa nɛ pɛwɛɛnɩ kiɖe tɛɛ ɖoŋ lɛ, pʋpɔzʋʋ se pelesi ɖoŋ kɩfaŋ weyi pamʋ ñalɩmɩyɛ cɔlɔ yɔ.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Palakɩ mbʋ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ palɩzɩɣ ñalɩmɩyɛ piye cikpeɖe nɖɩ payaɣ se ʺphotonʺ yɔ.
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Lɛɣtʋ ñɩnɩyaa yaɣ lakasɩ nzɩ se ʺémission stimulé de rayonnementʺ mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ ñalɩmɩyɛ ñaŋŋ seɣtiɣ atom pee, nɛ pɩla nɛ ñalɩmɩyɛ tɛ photon mɩzɩ pa-tɩ, ye mbʋ ñamɩlɩyɛ kɛ wonuu ŋgʋ kɩmɩzɩɣ kɩ-tɩ yɔ.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Kɩlɛmʋʋ ŋgʋ kɩkɔŋ yɔ, kɩwɩlɩɣ atom pee aɖiɣni mɩzɩɣ photon waa. Toovenim taa lɛ, photon waa wɛɛ ññɩɩ nɛ pɩkɩlɩ mba ɖɩnaɣ kɩlɛmʋʋ yɔɔ yɔ.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Halɩ photon waa wɛ ññɩɩ nɛ pɩkɩlɩ mba palabɩnɩ atom pee yɔ.
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Ampuuli nimaɣ lakɩ tʋmɩyɛ ñɩɣtʋ mɩnɩŋ sakɩyɛ lɛ, kañakɩ nɛ ampuuli ɛɛtasɩɣ tʋmɩyɛ labʋ.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Ye mbʋ, pɩwɛɛ se pɛlɛɣzɩ ampuuli nimaɣ ŋga. Pʋpɔzʋʋ se patɩlɩ labʋ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ paalɛɣzɩɣ ampuuli nimaɣ yɔ.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Kajalaɣ lɛ, pɩwɛɛ se peɖezi miŋ yaa pɛkpɛzɩ nimaɣ ŋga kowokini laatriki ampuuli taa yɔ.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ laatriki ɖoŋ weyi ɩwɛ ampuuli pɔʋ ñɩmɩyɛ yɔɔ yɔ ɩpɩzɩɣ nɛ ɩmabɩ-ŋ ye ŋtukuni pɔʋ taa peeɖe yaa ñɩmɩyɛ nɖɩ ɖɩwɛ ampuuli tɛɛ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ kɩwɛ pɔʋ taa peeɖe yɔ.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Ñamɩyɛ tɔm kɩlɩnɩ cɛyʋʋ ɛzɩma pɩɖɔŋ nɛ calɩm yɛlʋʋ tomnaɣ taa yɔ, mbʋ pʋyɔɔ ŋgʋ tɔʋnɩ calɩm tomnaɣ taa.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Calɩm lɩɣnɩ ñamɩyɛ taa lɛ, pɩɖɔŋ calɩm hosi kɩsɛɛmasɩ taa nɛ pɩɩpɩsɩɣ ñamɩyɛ taa lɛ, pɩɖɔŋ calɩm hosi kɩkpɛɛdɩsɩ taa. Calɩm hosi nzɩ sɩkɩlɩ ññɩɩ yɔ, sɩwɛ ɛzɩ kʋca hosi.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Pʋtɔma yɔ tricératops kela pɩzaɣ se asalɩ hatʋ nɛ halɩ pɩkpɛndɩnɩ tɩŋ pilinzi nɛ lila wena awɛ ɖoŋ pɩdɩɩfɛyɩ yɔ.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Lɛɣtʋ ñɩniyaa nabɛyɛ maɣzɩɣ se Tricératops waa tɔkaɣ tɩŋ ŋgʋ payaɣ se sikaadɩ yɔ, nɛ kɩɩtɔyɩ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ payaɣ se Crétacé yɔ tɩ-taa
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Tɩŋ ɛnɩ ɩwɛ ɛzɩ paʋ cikpeluu yɔ nɛ ɩwɛnɩ hatʋ ndʋ tɩwɛ awiya hulaɣ tɩyɛ nɛ tɩ-yɔɔ nɛ sɔɔ wena awɛ cʋŋ cʋŋ yɔ
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Tricératops pɩzaɣ se ɛtɩŋnɩ ɛ-njʋyɛ nɖɩ ɖɩwɛ ɖoŋ yɔ ɖɩ-yɔɔ nɛ ɛlɩzɩ hatʋ pʋcɔ nɛ ɛtɔɔ tɩŋ hɔɔyɛ.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Lɛɣtʋ ñɩnɩyaa lalaa ñɔyɔɔdʋʋ se tɩŋ ɛnɩ ɩwɛ sɔtʋ pɩdɩɩfɛyɩ, ye mbʋ patɩsa se dinosaure nɔɔyʋ kaatɔɔ-ɩ, paa sɔnɔ lubilubi nɛ kpɩna lɛɛna ɛzɩ kaŋgaɖɩyɛ (ɖɩlɩnɩ dinosaures waa taa) pɩzɩɣ nɛ atɔɔ tɩŋ hatʋ yaa tɩŋ pee wena awɛ sɔtʋ yɔ.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Ɛzɩma Io tataa ɖoŋ hɔŋ mɔ-yɔɔ ? Ye ŋsɩŋ Io tataa waɣɖɛ yɔɔ kɔyɔ, ño-yuŋ ɛɛtalɩɣ yuŋ weyi ŋwɛnɩ Tɛtʋ yɔɔ yɔ.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Ɛyʋ weyi e-yuŋ kɛ livre waa 200 (kilonaa 90) Tɛtʋ yɔɔ kɔyɔ, e-yuŋ kaɣ kɛʋ livre waa 36 (kilonaa 16) Io yɔɔ. Ye mbʋ, peeɖe ɖoŋ ɛɛhɔŋ sakɩyɛ ñɔ-yɔɔ.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Wɩsɩ fɛyɩnɩ tataa waɣɖɛ ɖenɖe ŋpɩzɩɣ nɛ ŋsɩŋ ɛzɩ Tɛtʋ yɔɔ yɔ. Wɩsɩ tɩŋa kɛ helim, miŋ nɛ plasma na.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Helim tɛ kikiŋ pasɩɣ pazɩ pazɩ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ ŋposuuni Wɩsɩ hɛkʋ yɔ.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Pɩ-yɔɔ hɔɔlʋʋ ŋgʋ ɖɩnaɣ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ ɖɩcɔŋnɩ Wɩsɩ yɔ payaɣ-kʋ se photosphère pʋ-tɔbʋʋ lɛ se ʺmintʋsʋʋ paɣyɛʺ.
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Pɩlabɩ ɛzɩ pɩnzɩ kudokiŋ naadozo pʋwayɩ lɛ, pɩnaɣ 1610 taa, tɩɩnzɩ yɔɔ lɛɣtʋ ñɩnɩyʋ weyi ɛkɛ Itaalii tʋ Galileo Galilei ɛsɔdaa cɔnʋʋ ɛsɛñɩnɩŋ yɔɔ nɛ ɛna se Venus wɛnɩ wɛtʋ ndɩ ndɩ ɛzɩ fenaɣ yɔ.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Wɛtʋ ndɩ ndɩ ndʋ tɩlakɩ mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ Venus (yaa Fenaɣ) hɔɔlʋʋ ŋgʋ kɩwɛnɩ Wɩsɩ yɔɔ kiŋ yɔ ki-. yeke ñalɩmɩyɛ naɣ Venus wɛtʋ ndɩ ndɩ tɩwɩlɩɣ se tɔm Copernicus yɔɔdaa se lona wena awɛ tɛtʋ tɩyɛ yɔ acɔʋ Wɩsɩ nɛ ataŋ yɔ, tɩkɛ toovenim
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Ɛlɛ, pɩlabɩ pɩnzɩ cabɩ pʋwayɩ lɛ, 1639 taa, tɩɩnzɩ yɔɔ lɛɣtʋ ñɩnɩyʋ Krandɩ-Pretaañɩ tʋ weyi payaɣaɣ se Jeremiah Horrocks yɔ, ɛna Venus kɩkɔm nɛ kɩɖɛɣ.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Angletɛɛrɩ kaahiɣ laŋhɛzɩyɛ nɛ pileɖi alɩwaatʋ ndʋ papɩzaa nɛ pamʋ pɛ-ɛjaɖɛ hɔɔlʋʋ ŋgʋ kɩ-yɔɔ Taneemaarkɩ kaawɛnɩ ɖoŋ yɔ.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Paa mbʋ yɔ, pɩnaɣ 991 taa, Ethelred lʋbɩnɩ Fiikiŋ mba you mɛlɛnaa mba pɔɖɔwa nɛ pɩcɛzɩ pɩtɩŋa yɔ, ɛlɛ patɩɖɔɔ nɛ pɩcɛzɩ you mɛlɛnaa mba Guthrum kaawɛna pɩlakɩ pɩnzɩ mɩnʋʋ pʋcɔ nɛ pɩtalɩɣ mbʋ yɔ.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Olaf Trygvasson kaakɛnɩ you mɛlɛnaa mba pa-ñʋʋdʋ, ɛɛkɛ Nɔrvɛɛjɩ tʋ weyi ɛɛtam tamaɣ se ɛmʋʋ ɛ-ɛjaɖɛ Tanemaarkɩ mba nesi tɛɛ yɔ.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Paa paawabɩ-ɩ you taa kiɖe tɛɛ kɔyɔ, pʋwayɩ Ethelred nɛ Olaf papɩzaa nɛ panɩɩnɩ ɖama, nɛ ɛlɛ pɩsɩ Nɔɔrvɛɛjɩ se ɛñaɣ pana nɛ ɛmʋ e-kewiyaɣ, ɛlɛ pɩɖɔmnɩ-ɩ pazɩ na.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul kɛnɩ masɩ nzɩ si-yeke poluba se samaɣ ɛlabɩnɩ tʋmɩyɛ paa evemiye nɖɩ. Polubi-sɩ pɩnaɣ 1444 taa Wiyaʋ Sejong (1418-1450) kewiyitu tɔɔʋ alɩwaatʋ taa.
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Wiyaʋ Sejong kaakɛ wiyaʋ naanza tʋ Joseon Awiya Liɖe taa nɛ ɛkɛ awiya wena pakɩlaɣ ñam yɔ a-taa kʋɖʋm.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Kiɖe tɛɛ lɛ ɛya Hangeul masɩ se Hunmin Jeongeum pʋ-tɔbʋʋ lɛ se ʺmasɩ kiwiwisi nzɩ sɩmʋnaa se pawɩlɩnɩ samaɣ yɔʺ.
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Pɛkɛdɩ tɔm sakɩyɛ pɩlɩɩnɩ ɛzɩma pɩɖɔma nɛ palɩzɩ Sanskrit yɔ. Kɛdaɣ kʋɖʋmaɣ yɔɔdʋʋ Arɩyɛɛnɩ mba palɩnɩ Wɩsɩ ɖɩlɩyɛ taa nɛ powolo Ɛndɩ nɛ pɛkpɛndɩnɩ pa-kʋnʋŋ yɔ pɔ-tɔm.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sanskrit kɛ caanaʋ taa kʋnʋŋ nɛ kɩwɛ ɛzɩ Laatɛɛ kʋnʋŋ ŋgʋ pɔyɔɔdaɣ Erɔɔpɩ yɔ.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Takayaɣ kajalaɣ ñɩŋga ŋga pasɩm ɛjaɖɛ yɔɔ yɔ paama-kɛ Sanskrit taa na. Pekpeɣli Upanishads waa nɛ pɩtɛ lɛ Sanskrit paɣzɩ ɖem pɩlɩɩnɩ sɔsɔtʋ yɔɔ.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sanskrit kɛ kʋnʋŋ ŋgʋ kɩwɛ kaɖɛ nɛ kɩwɛɛ ñɩm pɩdɩɩfɛyɩ yɔ, nɛ kɩ-taa Ɛndɩ kʋnʋmɩŋ kɩfaŋ sakɩyɛ lɩnaa, ɛzɩ Erɔɔpɩ kʋnʋmɩŋ ɛzɩ Fransɩɩ nɛ Ɛsɩpañɔɔlɩ palɩɣnɩ Laatɛɛ taa yɔ.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Kiyo Fransɩ yɔɔ nɛ pɩtɛ lɛ, Caama paɣzɩ kɩ-tɩ ñɔɔzʋʋ se kɩwadɩ Krandɩ Pretaañɩ lɩm hɛkʋ taa tɛtʋ yɔɔ.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Caama ya lʋbɩyɛ nɖɩ se ʺOpération Sealionʺ. Krandɩ Pretaañɩ Sɔɔjanaa lesi hɔzɩŋ sɔsɔŋ nɛ you wondu lɛɛtʋ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ pakʋyaɣ Dunkerque se pɛɖɛɛ yɔ, ye mbʋ sɔɔjanaa kaawɛnɩ ɛjandʋ siŋŋ.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Ɛlɛ Krandɩ Pretaañɩ Wiyaʋ You Mɛlɛnaa kaawɛ ɖoŋ mbʋ nɛ pɩkpaɖɩ Caama You Mɛlɛnaa (ʺKriegsmarineʺ) nɛ papɩzaɣ se pɔyɔkɩ you mɛlɛnaa mba payɩ petiyaɣ Aŋgletɛɛrɩ hɔɔlʋʋ taa yɔ.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Paa mbʋ yɔ, Wiyaʋ You Mɛlɛnaa pazɩ yem kaawɛnɩ nʋmɔŋ weyi koyindu pɩzɩɣ ɛtɩŋna nɛ ɛwadɩ pɔ-yɔɔ yɔ ɩ-cɔlɔ, mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ mɛlɛnaa sɔdɩŋ seɣaɣ sɔɔndʋ se Caama ɛsɔdaa you lɔɔɖa ɩtaakɔɔ nɛ pɔyɔkɩ-wɛ.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Iyele nɛ ɖɩpaɣzɩ lɩzʋʋ ɖʋtʋ ndʋ Itaalii laba yɔ tɩ-taa. Kajalaɣ ɖeɖe lɛ, Itaalii kaakɛ Caama nɛ Japɔŋ ʺpe-neuʺ.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Pɔ-sɔɔjanaa nɛ po-you mɛlɛnaa kaakɩlɩnɩ ɛjandʋ, paa paalubi mɛlɛnaa kɩfama naanza alɩwaatʋ pazɩ pʋcɔ nɛ you paɣzɩɣ kɔyɔ.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Itaalii kaɖʋwa kajalaɣ ñɩŋga lɛ Afrika ajɛɛ. Pɩsa nɛ pekpi ajɛɛ ana lɛ, pzɩɩpɔzɩ-wɛ mbʋ pakpaɣnɩ pɔ-sɔɔjanaa nɛ pɛtɛzɩnɩ teŋgu yɔ, nɛ papɩzɩ pɛtɛzɩ Mediteraanee Teŋgu nɛ pawadɩ Afrika yɔɔ.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Pʋyɔɔ lɛ, paɖɩzɩ Krandɩ Pretaañɩ sɔɔjanaa pɩlɩŋ nɛ pɛ-mɛlɛnaa Ejipiti ɛjaɖɛ taa. Pɩtasɩnɩ lakasɩ nzɩ lɛ, pɩtaapɔzɩ se Itaalii kpɩzɩŋ you lɔɔɖa ɩtasɩ naɖɩyɛ labʋ.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Lɛɛlɛɛyɔ ɖɩyɔɔdɩ Japɔŋ tɔm. Japɔŋ kaakɛ lɩm hɛkʋ taa tɛtʋ ɖɔɖɔ ɛzɩ Krandɩ Pretaañɩ yɔ.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Suumaarɛɛwaa kɛ mɛlɛnaa mba palaba se pɔɖɔ lɩm tɛɛ yɔ, nɛ papɩzɩɣ pacaɣ lɩm tɛɛ alɩwaatʋ sakɩyɛ.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Palabɩnɩ suumaarɛɛwaa tʋmɩyɛ Caama You I nɛ Caama You II taa. Alɩwaatʋ ndʋ lɛ pataaɖɔŋ lɛɛ lɛɛ paa ññɩɩ nɛ pɔtɔwaɣ hɔzɩŋ lɛ pitaawoki poliŋ.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: You paɣzaa lɛ, pa-taa sakɩyɛ ɖɔŋaɣ teŋgu yɔɔ, ɛlɛ papaɣzɩ radar waa lɩzʋʋ nɛ pakpaɣ ɖoŋ lɛ, pɩɩkɛnɩ kɩjɛyʋʋ suumaarɛɛwaa se pɔɖɔ lɩm tɛɛ nɛ pataapɩzɩ nɛ pana-wɛ.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Payaɣaɣ Caama mba suumaarɛɛwaa se U-Boats. Caama mba kaawɛ niye siŋŋ pɛ-tɛ suumaarɛɛwaa saʋ nɛ pa-tʋmɩyɛ labɩnʋʋ taa.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Ɛzɩma paawɛɛ niye nɛ lɩm taa sɔjanaa hɔɔlʋʋ taa yɔ pʋyɔɔ lɛ, you tɛma lɛ, pataataɣ Caama mba liu se pɛwɛɛnɩ-wɛ sakɩyɛ.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Ɛɛɛ ! Wiyaʋ Tutankhamun weyi payaɣaɣ nabʋyʋ taa se ʺWiyaʋ Tutʺ yaa ʺAbalɩbɩɣa Wiyaʋʺ yɔ, ɛkɛ caanaʋ taa Ejipiti mba awiya taa weyi pakɩlɩ-ɩ sɩm ɖa-alɩwaatʋ tʋnɛ tɩ-taa yɔ.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Mbʋ pɩlabɩ ɖeu yɔ, pataakpaɣ-ɩ ɛzɩ ɛ-tɔm cɛyaa yɔ caanaʋ taa nɛ pataama ɛ-hɩɖɛ caanaʋ taa awiya hɩla takayɩsɩ sakɩyɛ yɔɔ
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Paa mbʋ yɔ, alɩwaatʋ ndʋ pana ɛ-pɩlaʋ pɩnaɣ 1922 taa yɔ piyeba nɛ ɛ-hɩɖɛ sɛɛ pɩdɩɩfɛyɩ. Paamɩlɩ caanaʋ taa pɩlaŋ sakɩyɛ taa wondu, ɛlɛ pɩlaʋ ŋgʋ kɩɩwɛ cɩŋgɩlɩm, patitukuni-kʋ.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Wondu ndʋ paapimni Tutankamun yɔ tɩ-taa sakɩyɛ kaawɛ camɩyɛ, tɩtɩwɛɛkɩ, pɩkpɛndɩnɩ wondu kilubitu ndʋ polubini ñɩɣlɩm ñɩɣtʋ nɛ ñɩɣlɩm pɛɛ yɔ.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Kpela wena a-taa wɛ pɔŋ yɔ a-lubu yeba nɛ Asiirii mba kɛɛkɛɛnaa wɛɛ hʋŋjaŋŋ nɛ pɩkpaɖɩ, peseɣ lɛɛ lɛɛ nɛ pɩkɩlɩ nɛ pɔñɔɔzɩ pa-tɩ nɛ pɩkpaɖɩ nɛ pɛɖɛɛ sɔɔjanaa nɛ kɛɛkɛɛnaa lalaa yɔɔ.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Ñɩma wena pɔ-tɔŋ weyi ɩwɛ patʋ pɩdɩɩfɛyɩ yɔ ɩtɔʋ yɔ, apɩzɩɣ nɛ atʋlɩ po-koyindinaa sɔɔjanaa ñɩɣtʋ tokonaa. Pɩtalɩ ɛzɩ pɩnaɣ 1000 mbʋ yɔ pʋcɔ nɛ palʋlʋʋ Krɩstʋ lɛ, Asiirii mba kɔnɩ kajalaɣ sɔɔjanaa kpaŋnaŋ caɣyaa you taa.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Sɔɔjanaa kpaŋnaŋ caɣyaa kɛ sɔɔjanaa mba pacakɩ kpaŋnaŋ yɔɔ nɛ palakɩ you yɔ. Pataalubiti kpaŋnʋ yɔɔ sabʋʋ, ye mbʋ Asiirii sɔɔjanaa kpaŋnaŋ caɣyaa cakaɣ kpaŋnaŋ yɔɔ ndaakpasɩ na nɛ palakɩ you.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Đɩsɩm Grɛɛkɩ politiki laɖaa, lɛɣtʋ ñɩnɩyaa nɛ wondu luɖaa sakɩyɛ. Pʋtɔma yɔ, pɔ-sɔnzɩ taa ɛyʋ weyi pakɩlɩ sɩm yɔ ɛnʋ lɛ Homère, keɣa maɖʋ yʋlʋm weyi ɛ-hɩɖɛ sɛwa yɔ, weyi elubi Grɛɛkɩ mba takayɩsɩ maʋ taa keɣsi sɔsɔsɩ naalɛ yɔ : keɣsi Iliyaadɩ nɛ Odisee.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Halɩ nɛ sɔnɔ, Sophocles nɛ Aristophanes pɛkɛ aleɣya tɔm mayaa mba pa-hɩla sɛwa yɔ nɛ ɛyaa maɣzɩɣ se pa-aleɣya kɛ ɛjadɛ tɔm kɩmamatʋ taa tʋma wena akɩlɩ paɣlʋʋ yɔ a-taa naayɛ.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Grɛɛkɩ tʋ lɛlʋ weyi ɛ-hɩɖɛ sɛwa yɔ lɛ akɔnta laɖʋ Pythagore, weyi pakɩlɩ-ɩ sɩm nɛ tɔm ndʋ ɛyɔɔdɩ kɩlɛmʋʋ ŋgʋ kɩwɛnɩ hɔɔlɩŋ naadozo yɔ kɩ-hɔɔlɩŋ kpɛndɩɣ yɔɔ yɔ.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Akɔntanaa wɛ ndɩ ndɩ pɩlɩɩnɩ ɛyaa mba pɔyɔɔdʋʋ Hindi kʋnʋŋ yɔ pɔ-yɔɔ. Pamaɣzɩɣ se kɩkɛ kʋnʋŋ naalɛ ñɩŋgʋ nɛ piwolo naanza ñɩŋgʋ ŋgʋ pakɩlɩɣ yɔɔdʋʋ ɛjaɖɛ yɔɔ yɔ.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Ɛyaa mba pɔyɔɔdʋʋ-kʋ yɔ pa-ñʋʋ lɛɣzɩɣ ye pakalɩ yɔɔdɩsɩ cikpesi nzɩ sɩñɔtɩnɩ ɖama yaa patɩkalɩ-sɩ yɔ.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Akɔntanaa wɩlɩɣ se ɛyaa ɛzɩ miliiyɔɔwaa 340 nɛ piwolo miliiyɔɔwaa 500 yɔɔdʋʋnɩ kʋnʋŋ ŋgʋ, nɛ ɛyaa sakɩyɛ ɛzɩ miliiyɔɔwaa 800 mbʋ yɔ pɩzɩɣ nɛ panɩɩ kʋnʋŋ ŋgʋ.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Hindi nɛ Urdu lɩ ɖama yɔɔdʋʋ taa ɛlɛ ɩwɛ ndɩ maʋ taa ; paayɔɔdʋʋnɩ ɖama paa ɖooye pa-tʋma labʋ taa lɛ, kʋnʋmɩŋ ɛnɩ ɩ-naalɛ ɩ-yɔɔdɩyaa pɩzɩɣ nɛ panɩɣ ɖama tɔm.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Pɩnzɩ mɩnɩŋ 15 waa taa mbʋ yɔ, Caama sɔnzɩ kaawɛnɩ ɖoŋ siŋŋ Ɛsɩtooni hayo kiŋ yɔɔ.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Caama fadanaa nabɛyɛ ñɩnaɣ se pala nɛ Ɛsɔ ñɔtɩnɩ tɛtʋ taa ɛyaa, nɛ pʋyɔɔ lɛ polu Ɛsɩtooni kʋnʋŋ ŋgʋ pamaɣ yɔ.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Palɩzɩ kʋnʋŋ ŋgʋ kɩ-masɩ nɛ Caama masɩ taa nɛ pɔsɔzɩ mayaɣ kʋɖʋmaɣ kanɛ "Õ/õ".
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Alɩwaatʋ wɛɛ nɛ tɩɖɛɣ lɛ, tɔm pee sakɩyɛ wena pakɩndɩ Caama taa yɔ akpɛndɩ. Ñalɩmɩyɛ kaapaɣzɩ kɔm kɛlɛ.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Sɔnzɩ taa lɛ, weyi ɛkaɣ lɛɣzʋʋ wiyaʋ lone taa yɔ, ɛtɛŋ sukuli kpaagbaa lɛ, ewoki sɔɔjatʋ taa.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Paa mbʋ yɔ, Charles wobi sukuli kɩtɛzʋʋ Trinity College, Cambridge taa, nɛ ɛkpɛlɩkɩ ɛyu yɔɔ lɛɣtʋ tɔm nɛ caanaʋ taa tɛtɛɛ wondu ñɩnʋʋ tɔm, nɛ pʋwayɩ lɛ caanaʋ taa tɔm, nɛ ɛmʋ 2 :2 (sukuli takayaɣ cikpelaɣ naalɛ ŋga.)
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles kaakɛnɩ Krandɩ Pretaañɩ Kewiyaɣ Đɩɣa taa tʋ kajalaɣ tʋ weyi ɛmʋ sukuli kɩtɛzʋʋ takayaɣ yɔ.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Erɔɔpɩ tɛ Turikii (wɩsɩ ɖɩlɩyɛ taa Thrace yaa Rumeelii Balɩkaanɩ lɩm hɛkʋ taa tɛtʋ taa) kɛ ɛjaɖɛ hɔɔlʋʋ 3%.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Turikii ɛjaɖɛ ɖaɣlɩkɩŋ cɛzɩ kilomɛtanaa 1600 (mi 1000) nɛ walanzɩ kɛ kilomɛtanaa 800, nɛ ɖɩwɛ kpatayɩ ɛzɩ pɔɔyʋʋ yɔ.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Turikii kadaɣ pɩkpɛndɩ lɩŋgamɩŋ kɛ kilomɛtanaa kɩkaɣaa 783 562 (300 948 sq mi) nɛ pɩ-taa lɛ kilomɛtanaa kɩkaɣaa 755 688 (291 773 sq mi) wɛ Azii hadɛ kiŋ wɩsɩ ɖɩlɩyɛ taa nɛ kilomɛtanaa kɩkaɣaa 23 764 (9174 sq mi) wɛɛ Erɔɔpɩ taa.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Turikii kadaɣ paɣlɩka yɔɔ lɛ, ɖɩkɛ ɛjaɖɛ kpeekpe yɔɔ ɛjaɖɛ 37 ñɩnɖɛ nɖɩ ɖɩkɩlɩ paɣlʋʋ yɔ, nɛ ɖɩ-paɣlɩka wɛ ɛzɩ pɛkpɛndɩ Fransɩ ɛjaɖɛ paɣlɩka nɛ Ruwayoomuunii paɣlɩka yɔ.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Teŋgunaa cɔ Turikii hɔɔlɩŋ naadozo nɛ pɩ-taa : Ejee Teŋgu wɩsɩ ɖɩɖʋyɛ taa, Teŋgu Kɩkpɛɛdʋʋ hayo kiŋ nɛ Mediteraanee Teŋgu hadɛ kiŋ.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Lukizɛmbuuri wezuu caɣʋ tɔm leɖaa ɛlɛ kɩmʋ tɩ-yɔɔ wɛʋ kpaɣnɩ pɩnaɣ 1839 na.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Pɛlɩzɩkɩ hɔɔlɩŋ weyi ɩwɛ sɔnɔ yɔ, ɩɩkɛ Lukizɛmbuuri hɔɔlɩŋ caanaʋ taa,ɛlɛ ɩpɩsɩ Pɛlɩzɩkɩ ñɩŋ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ lʋba se kɩwɛɛ kɩ-tɩ yɔɔ pɩnzɩ 1830 waa taa nɛ pɩtɛ yɔ.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Lukizɛmbuuri kaañaɣ pana paa ɛzɩmtaa se kɩkɛ ɛjaɖɛ nɖɩ ɖɩɩtɩnɩɣ hɔɔlʋʋ nakʋyʋ yɔɔ yɔ, ɛlɛ Caama wadɩ kɩ-yɔɔ Caama You I nɛ Caama You II taa.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Pɩnaɣ 1957 taa, Lukizɛmbuuri pɩsɩ ɛgbɛyɛ nɖɩ payaɣ sɔnɔ se Union Européenne yaa Erɔɔpɩ Nɔɔ Kʋɖʋmaɣ yɔ, ɖi-tigiɖe sɩyaa taa lɛlʋ.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyal Dzong kɛ ɖoŋ lone nɖɩ ɖɩpɩsɩ njɛyɛ nɛ Buddha Ɛsɔ sɛyaa nabɛyɛ ɖɩjaɣyɛ nɖɩ ɖɩwɛ Paro Egeetiye hayo kiŋ yɔ (Phondey Kɔfɩ taa).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Pɛkɛdaa se pɩnaɣ 1649 taa, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel ma ɖoŋ lone nɖɩ se ɛtɔzɩnɩ ɛzɩma ɛwabɩ Tibee nɛ Mɔŋgɔɔlɩ mba sɔɔjanaa yɔ.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Pɩnaɣ 1951 taa, miŋ nɩɩyɩ ñaɣaa nɛ pɩkazɩ Drukgyal Dzong wondu kiɖeɖetu natʋyʋ yeke, ɛzɩ Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal kɩlɛmʋʋ yɔ.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Miŋ ñaɣʋ wayɩ lɛ, pɔñɔɔzɩ ɖoŋ lone nɛ pakandɩyɩ ɖɩ-yɔɔ, ɖɩkɛ Bhutan lone nɖɩ ɖɩkɩlɩɣ ɖɩhɔm ɛyaa ɖi-keɖeɣa yɔɔ yɔ.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Pɩnzɩ mɩnɩŋ 18 taa Kambooji kaawɛ kɩ-cɔlɔ mba ɖoŋ tɩnaa naalɛ hɛkʋ taa, Tayɩlandɩ nɛ Vɩyɛtɩnam.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Tayɩlandɩ mba wadɩ Kambooji yɔɔ tam sakɩyɛ pɩnzɩ mɩnɩŋ 18 taa nɛ pɩnaɣ 1772 taa lɛ, pɔyɔkɩ Pɩnɔm Pɛn.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Pɩnzɩ mɩnɩŋ 18 kɛdɛzaɣ pɩnzɩ taa, Vɩyɛtɩnam mba ɖɔɖɔ kaawadɩ Kambooji yɔɔ.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Venezuyela mba mɩnʋʋ yɔɔ lɛ, hiu nɛ lutozo fɛyɩnɩ tʋmɩyɛ, nɛ mba pɛwɛnɩ tʋma yɔ pa-taa sakɩyɛ ɩɩlakɩ komina tʋmɩyɛ naɖɩyɛ.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Venezuyela mba naadozo mba palakɩ tʋmɩyɛ yɔ pɔ-yɔɔ lɛ naalɛ lakɩ lɩm ɖʋʋ tʋmɩyɛ na, nɛ ɛzɩ hɔɔlʋʋ naanza ŋgʋ mbʋ yɔ lakɩ tʋmɩyɛ tʋma wena aluki wondu yɔ a-taa nɛ hɔɔlʋʋ kagbanzɩ ñɩŋgʋ lakɩ tʋmɩyɛ haɖaʋ nʋmɔʋ taa.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Venezuyela mba tʋmɩyɛ ɖɩlaɖɛ sɔsɔɖɛ naɖɩyɛ lɛ sanzɩ tʋmɩyɛ, mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ ɛjaɖɛ pɛdɩɣ sanzɩ ŋgʋ pɔñɔɔzaa yɔ, paa ɛyaa hɔɔlʋʋ kʋɖʋmʋʋ ɖeke lakɩnɩ tʋmɩyɛ sanzɩ tʋmɩyɛ ɖɩlaɖɛ taa kɔyɔ.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Ɛjaɖɛ calɩ hiɣu tɩ-yɔɔ wɛʋ lɛ, ɛzɩma Siŋgaapuuri kaawɛ lɛɣtʋ tɩŋ kaɖɩsɩ labʋ taa yɔ, pɩsɩnaa nɛ papɩsɩ lɩm hɛkʋ taa tɛtʋ ndʋ Tɛtʋ ndʋ tɩkɛ tropiki Kaɖaɣ yɔ.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Pɩnaɣ 1981 taa, palɩzɩ kajʋka hɛɖʋʋ Vanda Miss Joaquim se kɩkɛ ɛjaɖɛ kɩɖaʋ wonuu.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Paa pɩnaɣ ŋga, Aloma fenaɣ kaatalɩɣ lɛ, kpɩna wena atɔkɩ ñɩtʋ ɛzɩ miiliyɔɔ 1,5 mbʋ yɔ kʋyʋʋ nɛ awoki hadɛ kiŋ kɛdɛɛnzɩ taa se aɖaŋ tɛŋ, alɩɣnɩ hayo kiŋ piyisi yɔɔ nɛ atɛzɩɣ Mara Pɔɔ Sɔsɔɔ.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Nɛ pʋwayɩ tɛŋ sɩŋɩɣ Đomaɣ fenaɣ ñɔtʋʋ lɛ, atasɩ pɩsʋʋ hayo kiŋ ɛlɛ atɩŋɩɣnɩ wɩsɩ ɖɩɖʋyɛ nʋmɔʋ nɛ atasɩ tɛzʋʋ Mara pɔɔ.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Serengeti egeetiye taa Serengeti Kaɖaɣ wɛɛ, Ngorongoro ɖɩzɩyɛ nɛ Masma hɔɔlʋʋ ŋgʋ kɩ-taa lakʋ taa nandʋ wɛɛ nɛ kɩwɛɛ Tanzanii yɔ nɛ Maasai Mara mba Lone nɖɩ ɖɩwɛ Keeniya yɔ, pɛwɛ pɩ-taa.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Tɔm susuu tʋma wena a nɛ lalaa pɛkpɛndɩɣ nɛ palakɩ tʋmɩyɛ yɔ a-lɩzʋʋ pɔzʋʋ lɛɣtʋ kɩfatʋ nɛ kɩbɩndʋ, nɛ pɩtasɩnɩ wondu ndʋ tɩpɩ ɖama labɩnʋʋ tʋmɩyɛ taa yɔ (storyboard, video nɛ tɔm kɩnɩnɩtʋ ñɔɔzʋʋ, tɔm kɛdʋʋ, etc.)
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Wondu ndʋ tɩkpɛndɩɣ nɛ tɩlakɩ tʋmɩyɛ nɔɔ kʋɖʋmaɣ taa yɩ ti-lubu pɔzʋʋ se ɛyʋ ɛtasɩ maɣzʋʋ tɔm susuu ndʋ ɛcaɣ lɩzʋʋ yɔ tɩ-yɔɔ nɛ ɛkpɛlɩkɩ ɛzɩma ɛla nɛ ɛ-maɣzɩm ɛtaatɩŋ nʋmɔʋ kʋɖʋmʋʋ yɔ.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Wondu ndʋ tɩkpɛndɩɣ nɛ tɩlakɩ tʋmɩyɛ nɔɔ kʋɖʋmaɣ taa yɩ ti-lubu pɔzʋʋ se tʋmɩyɛ naɖɩyɛ hɔɔlɩŋ ndɩ ndɩ ɩtamnɩ ɖama, ɛlɛ paa hɔɔlʋʋ ŋgʋ lɛ, kɩwɛɛnɩ tɔbʋʋ nɩʋ kɩ-tɩ yɔɔ.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Hɔɔlʋʋ ŋgʋ kɩ-taa ñɩnɩŋ weyi ɩlakɩ nɛ wondu paɣlʋʋ yɔ yaa zoom yɔ ɩfɛyɩ wazaɣ lɛ se ɖenɖe ikpeɣliɣ ñalɩmɩyɛ yɔ pɩfɛyɩ kɛlɛʋ nɛ pɔŋ ɛzɩma pʋpɔzʋʋ pʋcɔ nɛ papɩzɩ pekpeɣli ñalɩmɩyɛ ɖoŋ hɔɔlɩŋ ndɩ ndɩ taa yɔ ɩɖɔwa nɛ pɩkɩlɩ pɔŋ weyi ikpeɣliɣ ñalɩmɩyɛ ɖoŋ ɖoli kʋyʋm yɔ.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Kaɖɛ nɖɩ ɖɩwɛɛ nɛ ɖɩpasɩɣ pazɩ pazɩ mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ ñɩnɩŋ weyi ɩlakɩ nɛ wondu paɣlʋʋ yɔ i-luɖaa wɛɛ nɛ poluki ñɩnɩŋ weyi ɩwɛ camɩyɛ nɛ pɩkɩlɩ.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Pɩsɩnaa nɛ zoom ñɩnɩŋ lɩzɩɣ kɩlɛmɩŋ weyi i-ɖeu wɛ ɛzɩ ñɩnɩŋ weyi ɩcɔŋnɩ lone kʋɖʋmɖɩyɛ yɔ ɩ-kɩlɛmɩŋ yɔ.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Zoom ñɩnɩŋ wɛtʋ kɩdɛkɛdɩtʋ lɛɣtʋ lɛ se ɛzɩma kɩlɛmʋʋ pɔʋ kuluu yɔ (seya), ɖoŋ ɖoŋ lɛ pɩtɩwalɩ nɛ pɩɖɔɔ.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Piyeba nɛ zoom ñɩnɩŋ weyi ɩfɛyɩ liidiye yɔ, ɩ-tʋmɩyɛ labɩnʋʋ wɛɛ kaɖɛ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ ñalɩmɩyɛ tɩɖɔɔ yɔ ye patɩɖʋ miŋ ñɩlɩsʋʋ yaa flash kɔyɔ.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Kaɖɛ nɖɩ ɛyaa katɩɣ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ pañɩnɩɣ se paɖʋ filim nakʋyʋ DVD yɔɔ yɔ, nɖɩ lɛ overscan.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Palakɩ teeleewaa sakɩyɛ se papɩzɩ nɛ pɛkɛdɩnɩ ɛyaa samaɣ
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Mbʋ yebina nɛ mbʋ payɩ ŋnaɣ teelee yɔɔ yɔ pɛsɛtɩ pɩ-kpɛnzɩ yɔɔ, hayo, hadɛ nɛ hɔɔlɩŋ yɔɔ.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Palabɩ-kʋ se kɩlɛmʋʋ ɛpɩzɩ nɛ kɩmaɣnɩ teelee ñɩnʋʋ tɩŋa yɔɔ. Mbʋ payaɣ se overscan
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Pɩlabɩ pʋtɔdɩyɛ se alɩwaatʋ ndʋ ŋlakɩ DVD yɔ, pɩtʋʋ fɛyɩ se pɩkaɣ kɩ-kpɛnzɩ yɔɔ sɛtʋʋ ɖɔɖɔ, nɛ ye video tɛ tɔm kɩmamatʋ ndʋ paɖʋʋ kɩlɛmɩŋ yɔɔ yɔ tɩkɩlɩ ñɔtɩnʋʋ hadɛ kpɛŋa yɔ, paakaɣ  tɩ-tɩŋa naʋ camɩyɛ.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Erɔɔpɩ caanaʋ taa kuduyuŋ sɔsɔŋ wɛɛ nɛ ɩhaɣ ɛyaa lɩmaɣza pɩtɩkɛ sɔnɔ, pɩtɔzʋʋ ɛyaa ɛzɩma ɛyaa takaɣ ɖama nɛ poyouni laɣɖa se pana weyi ɛkɩlɩ ɖoŋ yɔ, kazandʋ sɔsɔtʋ labʋ nɛ kpaŋnaŋ caɣyaa mba paawɛ Arthur ɛgbɛyɛ taa yɔ, pɩ-yɔɔ.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Paa ɛyʋ kaasɩŋ pɩnzɩ kudoku njaa hɛkʋ taa kɔyɔ, pɩɩwɛ kɛlɛʋ se ɛtɔzɩ caanaʋ taa yoŋ kɔkɔɖɛ nɛ sɔzɩŋ yɔɔ, pɩɩwɛ ɛzɩ ɛyʋ pɩzaɣ se ɛnɩɩ kpaŋnaŋ acaa taŋ habɛɛ yɔɔ nɛ eɖiɣzini sɔɔndʋ ndʋ tɩkpaɣaɣ mba paamɛlɩ pɔŋ taa yɔ.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Ɛlɛ mbʋ ɖɩmaɣzɩɣ  yɔ pɩkɛ toovenim na ? Ɛbɛ yɔɔ kpem pama kuduyiŋ sɔsɔŋ ? Ɛzɩma palabɩ lɩmaɣza pʋcɔ nɛ pama-ɩ ?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Kirby Muxloe awiya ɖɩɣa sɔsɔɔ kɛ ɖɩɣa ɖoŋ ñɩŋga nɛ pɩkpaɖɩ awiya ɖɩɣa sɔsɔɔ toovenim taa, nɛ kɛ-wɛtʋ mʋnɩ ka-alɩwaatʋ.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Paɖʋ ko-mondoɖebɔŋ ñɩnɩŋ nɛ ko-kolonzi tikpeyiti, ye pɛtɛm pa-taa nɛ poyooni-kɛ yɔ kataapɩzɩɣ se kakaɖɩna you ŋgʋ nɛ pileɖi.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Kɩbaɣlʋ Hastings paɣzɩ-kʋ maʋ pɩnzɩ 1480 waa taa lɛ, ɛjaɖɛ kaawɛ laŋhɛzɩyɛ taa pazɩ nɛ pɩwɛɛ pakandɩyɩ pa-tɩ yɔɔ nɛ mɩlaa caɖaŋ cikpeŋ mba pɔcɔwaɣ nɛ palazɩɣ ɛyaa yɔ.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Đoŋ kɩmaŋ wɛʋ kaakɛ ɖʋtʋ ndʋ tɩ-taa Erɔɔpɩ ajɛɛ ñɩnaɣ se ala nɛ Erɔɔpɩ ajɛɛ kpeekpe wɛɛnɩ waɖɛ se atɔɔ kewiyitu a-maɣmaɣ a-tɩ yɔɔ yɔ.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Lɩmaɣzɩyɛ kaakɛnaa se Erɔɔpɩ ajɛɛ kpeekpe ñakaɣ pana se ataayele nɛ ɛjaɖɛ naɖɩyɛ kɩlɩ wɛʋ ɖoŋ, nɛ pʋyɔɔ lɛ kominawaa lɛɣzaɣ agbaa wena paɖʋwa yɔ se pɩsa nɛ po-ɖoŋ wɛɛ kɩmaŋ.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Ɛsɩpaañɩ wiyaʋ lone taa lɛɣzʋʋ You kɛnɩ kajalaɣ you ŋgʋ kɩ-taa tɔm kɩcɛyɩtʋ kaakɛnɩ ɖoŋ kɩmaŋ wɛʋ.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Pɩkɔnɩ lɛɣzɩtʋ sɔsɔtʋ mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ Erɔɔpɩ ajɛɛ ɖoŋ ñɩna ɩɩkaɣ tasʋʋ hiɣu kawanaɣ se ala Ɛsɔ sɛtʋ yoŋ. Ye mbʋ, Pɩnzɩ Niidozo You kaakɛnɩ you kɛdɛzaɣ ñɩŋgʋ ŋgʋ payawa se Ɛsɔ sɛtʋ you yɔ.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Paɖɩzɩ Arteemiisi tɛ templo ŋgʋ kɩwɛ Efɛɛzɩ yɔ Hasɩɖɩyaɖɛ fenaɣ taa kɩyakʋ 21 wiye, pɩnaɣ 356 pʋcɔ nɛ ɖa-alɩwaatʋ talɩɣ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ Herosɩtraatɩ sɔbɩ-kʋ miŋ nɛ kɩñaɣ yɔ.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Pɛkɛdaa se ɛlabɩ mbʋ mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ ɛñɩnaɣ se ɛ-hɩɖɛ ɛsɛɛ pɩtɩŋnɩ paa nʋmɔʋ ŋgʋ lɛ kɩ-yɔɔ. Pɩwɩzɩ Efɛɛzɩ mba siŋŋ nɛ posusi se paakaɣ maʋ Herosɩtraatɩ hɩɖɛ kpa takayɩsɩ taa.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Caanaʋ taa tɔm lɔŋsɩnɖʋ Strabo manɩ ɛ-hɩɖɛ pʋwayɩ, mbʋ yebina nɛ ɖɩtɩlɩ-ɖɩ sɔnɔ. Peɖezi templo ŋgʋ ɖoo kʋyʋmɛɛ wena a-taa palʋlɩ Alɛkɩsandrɩ Sɔsɔ yɔ.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alɛkɩsandrɩ kaakɛ wiyaʋ lɛ, ɛñɩnaɣ se ɛha liidiye nɛ patasɩ maʋ templo, ɛlɛ pekizi. Pʋwayɩ Alɛkɩsandrɩ sɩba nɛ pɩtɛ lɛ, patasɩ maʋ templo pɩnaɣ 323 pʋcɔ nɛ ɖa-alɩwaatʋ talɩɣ.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Ñaɣ pana nɛ ne-nesi wɛɛ yɔɔɔ yɔɔɔ camɩyɛ aliwaatʋ ndʋ ŋɖiɣni mabʋ cɩmʋʋ masɩ tɩŋa yɔɔ ɛzɩ pʋpɔzʋʋ yɔ - pɩtasɩ lɛ ñaɣ pana nɛ ñe-niwee ɩtaakɩlɩ ciɣduu ɛzɩma pɩtɩpɔzɩ yɔ.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Đɩnɛ ɛlɛ pɩɩkaɣ-ŋ nɩʋ sakɩyɛ. Tɔzɩ se pɩtɩcɛyɩ se ŋma cɩmʋʋ masɩ nɛ ɖoŋ sakɩyɛ se pɩsa nɛ sitili pɩkpaɖɩ ɛzɩ pɩwɛʋ piyaano yɔɔ yɔ.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Akɔrdeyɔɔ yɔɔ ye ŋñɩnɩɣ se pitili camɩyɛ yɔ, pɩwɛɛ se ŋñɩɣ hosiyu yɔɔ ɖoŋ nɛ pɩkpaɖɩ yaa lɛɛ lɛɛ nɛ pɩkɩlɩ.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Maamaaci yɔɔ tisuu kɛnɩ ɛzɩma ɛyʋ ñɩnɩɣ se ɛ nɛ nabʋyʋ pɛkpɛndɩ yaa ɛyʋ tɩlʋʋ se nabʋyʋ sɔsɔm wɛɛ yɔ, Ɛsɔ nɔɔyʋ, fezuu taa toovenim yaa Ɛsɔ.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Weyi etisiɣ yɔ ɛñɩnɩɣ se etukini toovenim taa, lɩmaɣza taa yaa pɩtɩŋnɩ natʋ tɔɔ ɛsɔtʋ/ɛsɔ ɛnʋ yaa ɛsɔnaa mba.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Mba pɛwɛnɩ tisuu mbʋ yɔ pañakɩ pana se pɛwɛɛnɩ wezuu caɣʋ nakʋyʋ, yaa palakɩ lakasɩ nzɩ sɩsɩɣnɩ-wɛ se pɛwɛɛnɩ pɩ-tɛ tɩlɩtʋ ndʋ yɔ.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Suya laʋ kɛni mbʋ ɛzi cɔci aŋgba ni ɛsɔ namaŋ tiŋgiya lɛla cɔŋna ɛzi mbiyɔ tilitʋ biyʋ pikɛwa yɔ. Plíini aŋgba lɛna laɣsi taa; kɔzɔ kɔzɔ aŋgba wéna awiliɣ kpaɣʋ ni kpewu ni ɛyʋ lɛlʋ sɔlʋ yɔ.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Sikh Ɛsɔ sɛtʋ lɩnɩ Ɛndɩ ɛjaɖɛ taa. Tɩlɩnɩ Pɛnjaab egeetiye taa pɩnzɩ mɩnɩŋ 15 taa, nɛ pɩkɛ Hindu mba sɔnzɩ hɔɔlʋʋ nakʋyʋ kɛzɩnɩ kɩ-tɩ hɔɔlʋʋ.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Sikh mba maɣzɩɣ se pɛ-Ɛsɔ sɛtʋ wɛ ndɩ Hindu mba Ɛsɔ sɛtʋ, paa petisiɣ se ti-lila nɛ tɩ-sɔnzɩ lɩnɩ Hindu mba Ɛsɔ sɛtʋ taa kɔyɔ.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Sikh mba yaɣ pɛ-Ɛsɔ sɛtʋ se Gurmat, Pɛnjaab kʋnʋŋ taa lɛ pʋ-tɔbʋʋ lɛ se ʺguru nʋmɔʋʺ. Guru kɛ Ɛndɩ mba Ɛsɔ sɛtʋ kpeekpe taa ɖʋtʋ ndʋ tɩ-tɔm cɛyaa yɔ, ɛlɛ Sikh Ɛsɔ sɛtʋ taa lɛ ɖʋtʋ ndʋ tɩ-tɔm paɣzɩ pɩcɛyɩ nɛ tɩpɩsɩ Sikh mba tisuu tigiɖe.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Guru Nanak (1469-1539) ɖʋnɩ Ɛsɔ sɛtʋ ndʋ pɩnzɩ mɩnɩŋ 15 taa. Guruwaa nakʋ tɩŋ ɛ-wayɩ nɛ pɛlɛɣzɩɣ ɖama lone taa.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Paa mbʋ yɔ, Pɩnaɣ 1956 Mɩsɩgʋm fenaɣ taa, pɩtakɩ lidaʋ tɔm ndʋ Krushchev kaayɔɔdaa yɔ, alɩwaatʋ ndʋ ɛjaɖɛ yɔkʋʋ paɣzɩ Polɔɔñɩ yɔ, ɖenɖe tʋmlaɖaa pɩɣyaɣ mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ tɔɔnasɩ taawɛɛ nɛ papasɩ liidiye nɖɩ pɛhɛyaɣ-wɛ ɖɩ-yɔɔ yɔ, nɛ pɩɖɛɛ pɩpɩsɩ Kɔɔministi kewiyitu tɔɔʋ yɔɔ kʋyʋʋ paa le.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Paa kɛdɛzaɣ ɖeɖe Krushchev etiyini you lɔɔɖa nɛ papɩsɩnɩ ɖiɣ ɖiɣ caɣʋ kɔyɔ, ɛlabɩ mbʋ pɔpɔzɩ tɔsʋʋ nʋmɔʋ taa yɔ pɩ-taa nabʋyʋ, nɛ etisi se Wladyslaw Gomulka weyi ɛ-hɩɖɛ sɛwa yɔ ɛpɩsɩ Minisi Kajalaɣ Ñɩnʋ kɩfalʋ.
text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Ɛndusi Kɛdɛɛŋa taa lɔŋsɩnɖɛ kaakɛ Ñɩɣyʋʋ Kɩsɛɛmʋʋ Wɛɛ taa lɔŋsɩnɖɛ hayo kiŋ wɩsɩ ɖɩɖʋyɛ Ɛndɩ ɛjaɖɛ taa, nɖɩ ɖɩkpɛndɩnɩ ɖa-alɩwaatʋ taa Pakistaanɩ ɛjaɖɛ hɔɔlʋʋ sɔsɔʋ nɛ Ɛndɩ hayo kiŋ wɩsɩ ɖɩɖʋyɛ taa ageeta naayɛ nɛ Afɩganistaanɩ hayo kiŋ wɩsɩ ɖɩlɩyɛ taa ageeta naayɛ.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Lɔŋsɩnɖɛ nɖɩ ɖɩɖɛnɩ ɛsɩndaa Ɛndusi fɛɛʋ taa ɖenɖe ɖɩ-hɩɖɛ lɩnaa yɔ.
text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Paa lɔŋsɩnɖaa nabɛyɛ ɩyɔɔdʋʋ se lɔŋsɩnɖɛ kaawɛ Sarasvati Pɔɔ fɛɛŋ weyi ɩwɩlɩ lɛɛlɛɛyɔ yɔ ɩ-taa nɛ pʋyɔɔ lɛ pʋpɔzʋʋ se payaa-ɩ se Ɛndusi-Sarasvati Lɔŋsɩnɖɛ, ɛlɛ nabɛyɛ ñayaɣ-ɖɩ se Harapaa Lɔŋsɩnɖɛ pɩlɩɩnɩ Harapaa ŋgʋ kɩkɛ ɖi-lone nɖɩ pacalɩ ɖɩ-taa tazʋʋ pɩnzɩ 1920 waa taa yɔ.
text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Ɛzɩma Roma kewiyaɣ sɔsɔɔ kaasɔɔlɩ yoŋ labʋ yɔ, pɩsɩnaa nɛ ɖɔkɔtɔnaa tʋma ɖɛɛnɩ ɛsɩndaa.
text_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Wiyaʋ sɔsɔ Augustus paɣzɩnɩ mʋʋ ɖɔkɔtɔnaa tʋmɩyɛ, nɛ halɩ ɛɖʋ Roma Đɔkɔtɔnaa Ɛgbɛyɛ kajalaɣ ñɩnɖɛ se ɖɩla tʋmɩyɛ yoŋ wayɩ.
text_en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Đɔkɔtɔnaa mba pɛkɛ yasɩyaa yɔ paasɩm ɖom kɔɔ ndɩ ndɩ, pɩkpɛndɩnɩ mɔrfɩɩnɩ ŋgʋ palɩzɩ-kʋ ñɩɣyʋʋ ŋgʋ payaɣ se paavo yɔ kɩ-taa nɛ sikopolamiini ŋgʋ kɩlɩnɩ hɛrbaanɩ pee taa yɔ.
text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Pɔkɔm nɛ papɩɩ tomnaɣ pilinzi nzɩ sɩɖazaa yɔ sɩ-sɛtʋʋ taa se paya kʋdɔndɩnaa ñʋʋ, nɛ kpɩɖɩŋ weyi pakpɩtɩɣnɩ calɩm kɩsɛɛmɩm hosi se pɩsɩnzɩ calɩm kpɛdʋʋ yɔ.
text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Pɩnzɩ mɩnɩŋ sakɩyɛ taa, Roma kewiyaɣ sɔsɔɔ yeba nɛ pehiɣ kɛzɛsɩ sakɩyɛ ɖɔkɔtɔnaa lɛɣtʋ nʋmɔʋ taa nɛ pekpeɣli mbʋ ɖɩsɩm sɔnɔ yɔ pɩ-taa sakɩyɛ.
text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Pureland tɛ origami kɛ origami ŋgʋ paɖʋ paɣtʋ se kpiyuu kʋɖʋm palakɩ kɩ-yɔɔ alɩwaatʋ kʋɖʋmtʋ taa, patɩha nʋmɔʋ se pala kpiyuu kaɖɛ ñɩmbʋ ɛzɩ kpiyuu mbʋ papɩsɩ-pʋ kiŋkiɖe yɔ, nɛ kpiyuu tɩŋa wɛ lona wena awɛ kɛlɛʋ yɔ a-taa.
text_en: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: John Smith lɩzɩnɩ-kʋ pɩnzɩ 1970 waa taa se ɛsɩnɩ kpiyiyaa mba pɛfɛyɩ niye yɔ yaa mba paaɖɔŋ camɩyɛ yɔ.
text_en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Piya tɩlɩɣ ɛzɩma ɛyaa tomnaɣ tɔlɩm wɛ ndɩ ndɩ nɛ lɩmaɣza kɩdɛkɛda wena ɛyaa wɛnɩ tomnaɣ tɔlɩm ndɩ ndɩ yɔɔ yɔ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ sɩwɛ sɩ-pɩjatʋ taa yɔ nɛ tomnaɣ tɔlɩm yɔɔ lɩmaɣza kɩdɛkɛda ana awɛnɩ ɖoŋ sɩ-lakasɩ yɔɔ.
text_en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Đɩkpaɣ ɛzɩ piya nzɩ sɩnawa se sɩwɛ samaɣ cikpelaɣ ŋga kɛwɛnɩ tomnaɣ tɔlɩm nabʋyʋ yɔ ka-taa nɛ pamaɣzɩɣ se samaɣ ŋga ka-taa ɛyaa ɩɩlakɩ tʋmɩyɛ camɩyɛ sukuli taa yɔ, alɩwaatʋ ndʋ piya nzɩ sɩtɩlɩɣ lɩmaɣza wena ɛyaa wɛnɩ si-tomnaɣ tɔlɩm samaɣ yɔɔ lɛ, sɩɩtasɩɣ tʋmɩyɛ labʋ camɩyɛ sukuli taa.
text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace kɛnɩ Etaazuuni ɛjaɖɛ taa ɛntɛrnɛɛtɩ lona wena a-hɩla kɩlɩ sɛʋ yɔ, a-taa tozo ñɩnɖɛ nɛ mba pɛwɛnɩ hɔɔlɩŋ ɖɩ-yɔɔ sɔnɔ yɔ pɛkpɛndɩ miliiyɔɔwaa 54.
text_en: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Sakɩyɛ kaawobi ɛntɛrnɛɛtɩ lona ana a-yɔɔ, kɔzɩ kɔzɩ mba paawɛ tɔm wɩlʋʋ nʋmɔʋ taa yɔ.
text_en: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Ɛntɛrnɛɛtɩ lona ana awɛnɩ wazasɩ sakɩyɛ, nɛ wazaɣ nakɛyɛ lɛ se sukuli ɖaŋ tɛ hɔɔlʋʋ lɩzʋʋ wɛ kɛlɛʋ nɛ papɩzɩɣ paɖʋ kɩ-yɔɔ blog waa, videowaa , fotonaa nɛ wondu lɛɛtʋ.
text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Papɩzɩɣ nɛ powolo hɔɔlʋʋ ŋgʋ kɩ-yɔɔ kɛlɛʋ yem pɩtɩŋnɩ ɛntɛrnɛɛtɩ adɖɛɛsɩ kʋɖʋmʋʋ yɔɔ, pʋyɔɔ lɛ pɩwɛ kɛlɛʋ se ɛyʋ ɛtɔzɩ kɩ-yɔɔ nɛ pɩwɛ kɛlɛʋ se sukulibiya nzɩ pɩwɛ-sɩ kaɖɛ se sɩma tɔm yaa sɩyaa tɔm pee sɩpɩzɩ nɛ sɩɖʋ adɖɛɛsɩ ŋgʋ.
text_en: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Papɩzɩɣ pɔñɔɔzɩ hɔɔlʋʋ ŋgʋ nɛ pɩwɛɛ kɛlɛʋ se pakalɩ kɩ-yɔɔ, nɛ ɖɔɖɔ lɛ papɩzɩɣ paɖʋ tɔlɩm sakɩyɛ yaa pazɩ ɛzɩ paa weyi ɛsɔɔlʋʋ yɔ.
text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Lɩmaɣza kam pasʋʋ kʋdɔŋ ʺkɛ fɩtɩyɩm taa kʋdɔŋ sɔsɔʋ ŋgʋ patɩlɩɣ-kʋ nɛ lakasɩ sɔsɔsɩ naadozo ɛzɩ helu helu wɛtʋ, lɩmaɣza lebu, nɛ kpekpeka wɛtʋ yaa ɖoŋ sakɩyɛ wɛnʋʋʺ.
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Kʋdɔŋ ŋgʋ kiiyeki se pataakpɛlɩkɩ tɔm, ɛlɛ pɩwɛ kaɖɛ se pɛkpɛlɩkɩ tɔm ; nɛ ʺkitukuuni piya mɩnʋʋ yɔɔ lɛ 3 yaa 5, pʋtɔma yɔ Amerika piya ɛzɩ miliiyɔɔwaa 2 mbʋ yɔ wɛnɩ-kʋʺ.
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Piya nzɩ sɩwɛnɩ lɩmaɣza kam pasʋʋ kʋdɔŋ yɔ pɩwɛ-sɩ kaɖɛ se sɩka sɩ-ñʋʋ wondu ɛzɩ sukuli taa tʋma yɔɔ, ɛlɛ sɩpɩzɩɣ sɩka ñʋʋ mbʋ sɩsɔɔlɩ labʋ yɔ pɩ-yɔɔ ɛzɩ aleɣya labʋ yaa sɩcɔnɩ sɩ-tɛ dessinss animés waa mba sɩkɩlɩ sɔɔlʋʋ yɔ yaa sɩmaɣ tɔm loyisi nzɩ sɩfɛyɩnɩ sɩŋʋʋ masɩ yɔ.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Đoŋ ɖoŋ lɛ, piya nzɩ sɩkatɩɣ tɩlasɩ sakɩyɛ, mbʋ pʋyɔɔ ʺsɩlakɩ mbʋ pɩpɩzɩɣ pɩkɔnɩ-sɩ kaɖɛ yɔ, sɩlakɩ you nɛ sɩkaɖɩɣnɩ ñʋndɩnaaʺ se pɩsa nɛ piseɣti sɩ-fɩtɩyɩm, mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ paapɩzɩɣ peseɣti sɩ-fɩtɩyɩm pɩtɩŋnɩ nʋmɔŋ weyi ɩwɛ ɖeyi ɖeyi yɩ ɩ-yɔɔ.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: Lɩmaɣza kam pasʋʋ kʋdɔŋ tukuuni taabalɩyɛ ndɩ ɖɩwɛ sɩ nɛ piya lɛɛsɩ pɛ-hɛkʋ taa yɔ, mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ piya lɛɛsɩ ɩɩnɩɣ pɩ-taa mbʋ pʋyɔɔ sɩlakɩ mbʋ yɔ yaa mbʋ pʋyɔɔ sɩyaɣ tɔm pee ɛzɩ sɩyaʋ yɔ yaa mbʋ pʋyɔɔ sɩtɩpɩɩ ɛzɩ piya lɛɛsɩ yɔ.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Waɖɛ nɖɩ ɛyʋ wɛna se ehiɣ lɔŋsɩnɖɛ nɛ ɛkpɛlɩkɩ ɖɩwɛɛ nɛ ɖɩlɛɣzɩɣ ɛzɩ ɖɩyɔɔdʋʋ nɛ pɩɖɛɛ yɔ lɛ, ɖende ɛyaa hikaɣ lɔŋsɩnɖɛ nɛ pɩtalɩɣ yɔ pɩlɛɣzɩ.
text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Nʋmɔʋ ŋgʋ kɩ-yɔɔ patɩŋɩɣna nɛ patɩlɩ tɔm natʋyʋ yɔ tɩɩwɛ ndɩ. Paatasɩɣ ñɩɣʋ nɔɔyʋ yɔɔ se ɛ-maɣmaɣ ɛtɔzɩ tɔm natʋyʋ yɔɔ, ɛlɛ paa weyi pɩɩkɛnɩ-ɩ kaɖʋwa siŋŋ se ɛpɩzɩ nɛ ɛtɔzɩ tɔm ndʋ pamawa yɔ tɩ-yɔɔ.
text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Kɔzɩ kɔzɩ lɛ, Renaissance kɔnɩ lɛɣzɩtʋ siŋŋ tɔm kpɛlɩkʋʋ nɛ lɔŋsɩnɖɛ susuu nʋmɔʋ taa.
text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Tɩgbayɩŋ weyi ɩwɛ ɛyaa tɩyɛ yɔ, ɩɩtasɩɣ labʋ ɛzɩ tɩgbayɩŋ lɛɛŋ yɔ, ɩɩtasɩɣ tɩŋnʋʋ i-nesi yɔɔ nɛ ɩɖɔŋ yaa ɩkpakɩɣ yuŋ wondu yaa ɩmaɣ tɩŋ yɔɔ.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Tɩgbayʋ sɔsɔ nesi nɛ ɛ-nɩŋgbaŋaɣ ɖaɣlɩkɩŋ wɛ kɩmaŋ, pɩwɩlɩɣ se ɛlakɩnɩ e-nesi tʋmɩyɛ nɛ ɛkpakɩɣ yuŋ wondu alɩwaatʋ ndʋ ɛɖɔŋ yɔ nɛ ɛñɩkɩɣ e-niwee ajɔɔ yɔɔ yɔ.
text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: Ɛyʋ nesi wɛ tobi nɛ pɩkpaɖɩ nɩŋgbaŋaɣ, nɛ sɩ-taa mɔɔ tʋʋzɩ camɩyɛ.
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Nesi mɔɔ wena pana tɛtɛɛ nɛ awɛnɩ pɩnzɩ miiliyɔɔwaa naalɛ nɛ piwolo naadozo mbʋ yɔ yɔ, awɩlɩɣ ɛzɩma nesi lɛɣzaa nɛ ɖiyele labʋ ɖɔnɛ tʋmɩyɛ nɛ ɖɩlakɩ wondu kpaɣʋ nɛ tɩ-ñɔɔzʋʋ tʋmɩyɛ yɔ.
text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Nabɛyɛ maɣzɩɣ se ɖoza sakɩyɛ wena ɛyaa ñakɩ pana pa-maɣmaɣ sakɩyɛ taa se poɖozi alɩwaatʋ ndʋ paaɖou siŋŋ yɔ, apɩzɩɣ nɛ anɩɩ-wɛ siŋŋ.
text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Mbʋ pɩ-cɔlɔ wɛtʋ ndʋ tɩlɩnɩ kajalaɣ ɖeɖe lɛ se ɖoza wena palakɩ ŋgʋ paaɖou siŋŋ yɔ alakɩ nɛ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ tɩwɛ REM hɔɔlɩŋ hɛkʋ taa yɔ, tɩɖaɣlɩ.
text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Ye REM waa ɩtɩɖɔɔ ɖoo taa yɔ, wɛtʋ ndʋ tɩ-taa ŋɖou siŋŋ nɛ ño-tomnaɣ hɛzɩɣ yɔ tɩɩtatsɩɣ ɖɔʋ nɛ pɩkɔnɩ-ŋ kaɖɛ.
text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Pɩnɩɣ-ŋ nɩʋ mbʋ yɔ, pɩwɛ ɖɔɖɔ ɛzɩ ye paawɛɛ pefeziɣ-ŋ paa cɛcɛsɩ nɛɛlɛ yaa niidozo nzɩ se ŋcɔnɩ teelee yɔ.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: Ɛzɩma pɩlakɩ-ŋ yɔ pɩlɩɣnɩ tam ɛzɩma ña-fɩtɩyɩm ñakɩ pana se ŋɖozi kpayɩ kpayɩ paa ɖoo wena yɔ
text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Halɩ kpaɣnɩ ɖooo kiɖe tɛɛ pɩtɩɖɔmnɩ Itaalii mba camɩyɛ Afrika Hayo Kiŋ. Itaalii sʋ you taa Mɩsɩgʋm kɩyakʋ 10 wiye pɩnaɣ 1940 nɛ pɩtɩla kpɩtaʋ lɛ, Krandɩ Pretaañɩ you lɔɔɖa kpɩzɩŋ ñɩna sayaa tindimiye 11 ñɩnɖɛ yɔ wabɩ-wɛ nɛ pamʋ pɔ-cɔlɔ Liibii lone ɖoŋ ñɩnɖɛ nɖɩ payaɣ se Fort Capuzzo yɔ.
text_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Krandɩ Pretaañɩ mba pabɩ Bardiya wɩsɩ ɖɩlɩyɛ taa nɛ pakpa Sɔdʋʋ Lastucci weyi ɛkɛ Itaalii Sɔɔjanaa Tindimiye Hiu ñɩnɖɛ ñʋʋdʋ yɔ.
text_en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Mɩsɩgʋm fenaɣ kɩyakʋ 28 wiye, Liibii ɛjaɖɛ yɔɔ cɔnɩyʋ sɔsɔ Marshal Italo Balbo weyi paa weyi ɛmaɣzaɣ se ɛkaɣ lɛɣzʋʋ Mussolini lone taa yɔ,  piyiɣdi ɛ-sɔɔjanaa maɣmaɣ nɛ pɔtɔ malɩfaa nɛ pakʋ-ɩ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ ɛ-tɛ ɛsɔdaa lɔɔɖɩyɛ tikaɣ Toobruki yɔ.
text_en: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: Ɛsι-kʋliye alιwaatʋ hola-maɣzʋ kɛ paɖayɛ hɔɔlʋ taa le ɖιnaɣ hɔlιŋ ŋtι-ŋtι, sukuli piya hɔɔlʋ pιkɔɔ pιtalι sukuli kιtɛɛzʋ taa nɛ sʋsaa hɔlʋ taa nɛ pιtɛzιna kataɣ taa lιʋ nɛ ɖama falasʋ taa.
text_en: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: Hola-maɣzʋ kɛna kaanaɣ paɖayɛ tʋmιyɛ, sιa tʋ katʋʋ ɛɖaɣʋ.
text_en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Golf kɛna aleeya wena pakpakʋ ɖaʋ nɛ pama bombo cikpelu se paɖʋ kʋʋ pɔʋ taa yɔ.
text_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Pɔŋ hiu nɛ litoozo taa pamakι ɖʋʋ ɖama yɔɔ ɖama yɔɔ kɛ aleeya anɛ aɖeɖe, mpa pamakι kʋ yɔ, papasʋna pɔʋ kajala ŋkʋ nɛ powolo pɛtɛzιna hiu nɛ litoozo ŋkʋ kɛ seya taa.
text_en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Maɖʋ wei ebombo waa kazι pazι yɔ, yaa ŋkpɛyɛ taa maɖaa tɛzʋna mabʋ se paakɛ waɖaa.
text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Pamakι bombo waa mpaa ñιtʋ yɔɔ kɛna nɛ pɔʋ ñιtʋ tɛɛ nɛ kιwɛɛ ñιι nɛ payaa kʋ se ñιtʋ lιm.
text_en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Mpʋ ɖɔɖɔ ɛsιyekpena nιmɔɖɔm yeba nɛ pιwɛɛ ɛyaa ɛzι nιmɔɖɔnɛ yem yɔ: Aleeya nιmɔɖɔnɛ.
text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Pιkɛ alιwaatʋ ŋtʋ ɛyaa kʋyʋʋ nɛ powolo lone ŋɖι ɖιwɛ ŋtι nɛ pɛtɛ kιyakιŋ kpeekpe wezu caɣʋ yɔ nɛ pɛhɛzι nɛ peleyi.
text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Teŋgu nɔɔ, tɔm cɔlʋ ɖιcaɣyɛ nɛ haɖaa cikpema taa ɖamιŋ kɛna lona wena ɛsιyekpena mba kιla sɔɔlʋ yɔ.
text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Yee ɛsιyekpena mba ewoba lone naɖιyι taa se panιι ɖιtaa tɔm nɛ ɖιtɛ sɔŋzι kɔyɔ, payaɣ pιιyaa mba se sɔŋzι ɛsιyekpena mba.
text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Ɛsɩyekpena mba pɩsʋ nɛ palɩzɩ lona ŋtɩ-ŋtɩ ɛjaɖɛ naɖɩyɩ taa yaa lone kʋyʋɖɩyɛ.
text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Anaŋsayι waa mpa pɔkɔma ɛjaɖɛ pιsʋ pañιm yɔ, pɔcɔŋgana se tʋmιyɛ taawɛ kɛlɛʋ, peyele nɛ payaa se lalaa ɛkɔɔ nɛ pasιna wɛ.
text_en: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Tiŋtima kɔŋga nɛ pɔsɔsʋ lalaa yɔɔ, Hampshire Pιlʋ kaanaɣ ŋkʋ nɛ tozo ŋkʋ tiya ɛyaa nasιlɛ kɛ kolonɛlι Yohanɛsι Stark nɛ Yakubu Reed (Papιsι general waa pιwaι) penesi tɛɛ.
text_en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Stark tɛɛ mba ɖaŋga hayʋ kiŋ kɛ koloŋga ŋka kawιlʋ tɛtʋ mιlaa kamaɣ yɔ.
text_en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Alιwaatʋ ŋtʋ lιŋgamʋ lιyɛ lι hama pɔɔ nɔɔ yɔ hayʋ mba tɛ tɛtʋ ŋtʋ teŋgʋ cɔ-tʋ kpɛɛ nɛ pιkasι pasι se pιta yɔ, kpɛdɛɛ taa lɛ, pañιnι kaaŋ cikpena nɛ pɔtɔ hoyʋ pɛtɛ kamaɣ yɔ nɛ pιsιna ɖeŋɖe lιm falʋ yɔ, teŋgʋ nɔɔ yɔ.
text_en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Gridley yaa Stark maɣza naŋgbaŋsι ɛzι mιnʋ mpʋ yɔ (mɛta waa nιιtozo) kɛ pɛɛsιŋtaa nɛ ɛpaɣ ɛñιma se nɔɔyʋ ɛtaatɔ hɔsʋ yee koyoŋdu ɛtɛcɛzι  kamaɣ ŋga ɛɖʋwa yɔ.
text_en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Amerika taɣmaɣ labʋ se paɖʋ huwe nadozo nɛ pala yoou hɔlɩŋ ndi ndi taa.
text_en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: Sɔɔja sʋsɔ, General John Cadwalder, kaasɔlaa ɛla yoʋ nɛ ɛhu Grande Bretagne tɛ sɔɔjɩnaa pɩlʋʋ ŋgʋ kɩwɛ Bordentown se pɩhewɛ ɛjaʈʋ nɛ pataa wɛ ɖoŋ.
text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: Sɔja sʋsɔ, General James Ewing, kaasɔlaa se ɛkpaɣ sɔjɩnaa 700 se pɛɖɛsɩ Trenton Ferry pɔɔ nɛ powolo pakaŋɖɩ Assunpink Creek se pokoƴɩŋtinaa sɔjɩnaa lɛlaa ɛtaa-na nɩmɔʋ nɛ palɩɩ.
text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: Sɔjɩnaa tɩkaɣ sʋsaɣ ŋga kɛwenɩ sɔjɩnaa 2400 ɖɛsɩ Trenton pɔɔ nɛ pɔɖɔɔ sɩ cɩkɔ fɛyɩ kiloomɛta naa 15 nɛ pɛtɛyɩ tɩkasɩ naalɛ, hɔlʋʋ kʋyɩmʋʋ Greene nɛ hɔɔlʋ nalɛɛ ñɩŋgʋ Sullivan se papɩsɩ palaa yoou tanaŋ cʊ.
text_en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Eyaa ese sɩ kiloomɛta hɔlaɣ kʋyɩmaɣ naanza yɔɔ, seya pɩsɩ mbʋ pɩwɛ waɣsaɣ pɩtɩɩfɛyɩ nɛ ɖoŋ kpaɣʋ pɩsɩ wazaɣ pʋƴʋ kpem.
text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Kaɣcaɣlaɣ tʋ weyɩ ɛpɩsɩɣ ese cɛcɛsɩ naalɛ yɔ, pɩpɔsʋʋ seyaa ta ɛ-wɛɛ kpekpeka nɛ tɛyɩŋ wɛtʋʋ lɛ paa alɩwatʋ ndʋ yɔɔ, pɩpɔsʋʋ paa  alɩwatʋ ndʋ yɔ, ɛpɩsɩ nɛ ɛcɛyɩ ɛtɩ.
text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Nabɛyɛ ñeseɣ ɛjaɖɛ taa yolɩm hɔlʋʋ lɛɛkʋ taa yɔ, nɛ tɔnʋʋ taa falɩsʋʋ kɔsɩkɔsɩ tomnaɣ hayɩ hɔɔlʋ taa; pɩna pɩkeŋna seya ñɔzʋʋ kɩbam.
text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Tɔnaʋ kʋmʋnaɣ tɔʋ ɖeke ɛpɩsɩɣ pɩha tomnaɣ mbʋ pʋpɔsʋʋ yɔ, ɛlɛ pɩsɩŋna tomnaɣ pɩtɩfɛyɩ seya ñɔɔzʋ hɔlʋʋ taa camɩyɛ.
text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Tomnaɣ yɔɔ cɔnaɣʋ se kɛwɛɛ kpekpeka, lɩm ñɔʋ paɣtʋ yɔɔ ɖɔm, nɛ tɔm nɩʋ pɩlɩnaa mbʋ mbʋ pɩpɔsʋʋ ɛyʋ se ɛla nɛ ɛwɛɛ alafɩyaa nɛ ɛɖɛɛ na ɛsɩndaa nɛ pɩsɔsɩɩ kpekpeka  seya hɔlʋʋ taa.
text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: Seuu hɛkʋtaa ñɩmbʋ fɛyɩ lidiyee sakɩyɛ, ɛlɛ kaatɩlɩtʋ sakɩyɛ wɛɛ pɩlɩnaa wondu ndʋ pɩpɔsʋʋ se posuu yɔ tiƴɔɔ.
text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Eyaa pɩsɩɣ pɛwɛkɩ lidiyee nɛ paya wondu naa nabɛyɛ ɛlɛ pɩtaa wondu sakɩyɛ ɛ-sɩŋwɛ paa ñɩɩ se pɛɖɛna ɛsɩŋdaa.
text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Mba peseɣ yɔ papɩsɩɣ pɔsɔɔlɩ wondu na natʋyʋ ɛlɛ wondu ndu tɩɩsɩŋnɩ-wɛ paa ñɩɩ nabʋyʋ taa.
text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: Atom wɛ ɛsɩɩ piye nɖɩ ɖɩwazaɣ fɛyɩ yɔɔdʋʋ tɩgɩɖe taa.
text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Pikee mbʋ hɔɔlasɩ yʋʋlɛɛ kpɛŋdɩ pɩtaa yɔ pɩlɩnaa Bohr yɔɔdaɣ taa hɛkʋ taa pɩyee nɖɩ lɛɛna cɔwa nɛ ata; pa;pisɩ paɣmaɣsɩna wɛ na wɩsɩ nɛ tɛtʋ, nɛ fenaɣ nɛ tɩnzɩ ŋsɩ sɩwɛ yɔ. Ezɩdaa 1.1. wɩlɩ mbʋ pɩtɔm pɔyɔtɩ cɩnɛ yɔ
text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Piye nɖɩ ɖɩwɛ-nɩ hɔɔlɩŋ naalɛ weyi payaɣ se protons nɛ neutrons waa yɔ.
text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Protons waa wɛ ɛsɩɩ latrɩkɩɩ taa maŋsɩ sɩsɩɣlɩɣ abalɩ mansɩ nɛ neutrons wa ñɛwɛ sɩ ŋsɩ sɩsɩɣlɩɣ halɩ mansɩ yɔ.
text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Pʋcɔ nɛ ŋ-cɔna kʋdɔndʋ yɔɔ lɛ, pɩpɔsʋʋ se ŋ-cɔna hɔlʋʋ taa kpɛɛɛ nɛ ŋ-tisi se cɛyɩtʋ natʋyʋ fɛyɩ pʋcɔ.
text_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Pɩpɔsʋʋ sɛ ŋcɔna ŋa kʋdɔŋtʋ wɛtʋ nɛ pɩcɔ ŋñɔtɩnɛ-ɩ nɛ ŋcɔna se cɛyɩtʋ kaɖɛ ñɩŋtʋ natʋyʋ fɛyɩ ɖɔɖɔ.
text_en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Yee ña-maɣmaɣ pʋkʋŋ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ ŋ-caɣ kʋdɔndʋ sɩnʋʋ yɔ, ŋ-wɛ ŋ-tɛsʋʋ wɛkʋʋ kɩwɛɛkʋ.
text_en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: Ɖɩcayɛ wɩlɩɣ se taa pɩsɩʋ, sɔŋdʋ, lɩmaɣsɛ labʋʋ cɛyɩtʋ naa yɔɔ wɩlɩɣ mbʋ piyeki nɛ wɩsasɩ nɛ ɛcaŋtʋ sɩye taa s,is,iŋ nɩʋ wɛ yɔ.
text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Lɩmaɣzɛɛ kɩdɛkɛdɛɛ kʋdɔŋ PA pilitaɣ paa kpɩtaʋ ŋgʋ, pɩɩtakɛ lɩmaɣzɛɛ kɔdɔŋ yaa sɔndʋʋ yɔɔ pepilitaɣ
text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Mba palakɩ tʋmaa ɖoŋɖoŋ yɔ pɔpɔsaɣ sɩnaʋ taʋmaɣ ŋga katɩ tʋʋzɩ yɔ pɩlɩna wɩzasɩ nɩʋ nɛ cɛyɩtʋ wezuu caɣʋ nɛ hoɖe tʋmiyɛ labʋ.
text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Esɩŋtaa taɣmaɣ labʋ, nɛ sɩsɩɣ kɩnaɣʋ yaa ɛsɛ.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Esɛ labʋ tɛ waɖɛ wɛ ndi ndi pɩlɩna tomnaɣ pɔsʋ mbʋ yɔ pʋƴɔɔ.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Matʋ ndi ndi haɣ waɖɛ ndi ndi ɖɔɖɔ, pɩwɛna toyunduu ndi ndi nɛ cayɩ cayɩ naʋ; ɖɔɖɔ lɛ, pɩpɔsʋʋ nɩmaŋ ndi ndi tɩŋʋʋ pɩlɩna ɛsɩna ɛyʋ lakɩ tʋmɩyɛ se pɩwɛ waɣzaɣ yɔ.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Saɣmaɣ kena wezuu kpɩna nɛ wondu kpɛŋɖʋʋ alɩwaatʋ natʋyʋ tɛtʋ hɔlʋʋ nakʋyʋ yɔɔ.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Alɩwaatʋ ndʋ saɣmaɣ nakɛyɛ taa ɛyaa nɩɣzɩna ɖama yɔ pɩlɩna cacasɩ nasɩyɩɩ yɔɔ yɔ, paɣhaɣ wɛ yɩɖɛ nɖɩ ɖɩwɩlɩ se palɩna ɖee kʋɖʋm.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Alɩwaatʋ ndʋ saɣmaɣ taa cacasɩ wɛ ndi ndi yɔ, pɩwɩlɩ se patɩna ɖee kʋɖʋm.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Kɛɛmasɩ saɣmaɣ ɖɔŋ nɛ sɩ-ɖʋʋ yalaa alɩwaatʋ ndi ndi taa.
text_en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Alɩwaatʋ ndʋ sɩyɛlɩɣ yɔ, kɛɛmasɩ saɣmaɣ ɖɔŋ ɖoo taa nɛ sɩkpɛɣlɩ nɛ sɩsɩŋɩɩ evemiye taa.
text_en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: Sɩ-paasɩ ɖɔŋɖɛ alɩwaatʋ ŋdʋ tɔɔnaɣ ŋga kakasaa yɔ, kapasaa. Alɩwaatʋ ndʋ tɩtaa lɛ sɩɖʋ ɖaŋtʋ nɛ sɩ-lɛɛsɩ paa evemiye nɖɩ.
text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Paa ɖɔŋɖɛ ŋdɩ ɖɩtaa lɛ, ɖɩlakɩ ɛsɩ avema 17.
text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Epe paɣyaɣ cell? Tɔm piyee lɩna Latin kʋnʋŋ "cella", kɩtɔbʋʋ lɛ "nʋmʋʋ cɩkpelu", nɛ pɩlɩna pɔɔyʋ cɩkpelu kpakpaa ñɩɩ wɛʋ cɔnaʋ.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Pɔƴʋʋ kɛna paa wezu wonu ŋgʋ kɩ-wezu caɣʋ, nɛ paa mbʋ pɩwɛna wezu yɔ, pɩwɛɛna pɔyʋ kʋɖʋmʋʋ  yaa naalɛ.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Pɔyɩŋ wezu waɣzaɣ pɩtɩfɛyɩ alɩwaatʋ ndʋ pɔyɔtʋʋ wezu tɔm yɔ pʋyɔ yɔɔ paɣyaɣ wɛ se nʋmɩŋ kɩmamaŋ wezu.
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Holaa wɛtʋ ɖɔkʋʋ-na wezu caʋ se tomnaɣ ɛ-wɛɛ alafia pɩlɩnaa tɔm tomnaɣ kpekpe nɛ pɩyele se calɩm ɛ-ɖɔŋ camɩyɛ nɛ cɛyɩtʋ ɛtaawɛ.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Tɔm ŋdʋ hola tiyɩɣ na yɔ tɩ pɩsɩɣ tɩtɩŋ tomnaɣ taa nɛ pɩsɩna tomnaɣ se kalʋna cɛyɩtʋ naa mba papɩsɩɣ pɔkɔɔ pɩwayɩ yɔɔ.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Tɛʋ sʋsɔʋ cɛsɩ hɔɔlʋʋ cɩkpeluu ye paɣmaɣsɩ na tɛŋ lɛlɩŋ ɛlɛ ɛpɩsɩɣ ɛyɔkɩ pɩtɩnɛ payɩ kʋ-nʋmɔʋ taa
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Tɛʋ sʋsɔʋ kpɛzɩɣ tɔŋ kɩ-nʋmɔʋ taa; kpataa naa, nɛ kʋkʋsʋʋ lɔrɛ ɛsɔtaa. Tɛŋ sʋsɔŋ naalɛ leɖɩɩ ɛsɩ ñɩtʋ naadozo.
text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Tɛʋ sʋsɔʋ ñazɩ ñazʋʋ helim se ɛsɩ kɩlomɛta wa 480 paa ñɩyʋʋ ngʋ kɩyaɣ, mɛta wa 133 paa cɛcɛyaɣ cɩkpeɣlaɣ nga kaɣyaɣ; nɛ meta waa 300 paa ñɩyʋʋ ngʋ kɩyaɣ).
text_en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Eyaa kaapasɩ lubu nɛ palakɩnaa ñɩnɩŋ tʋmɩyɛ ɖoo pɩnsɩ ɛgbaŋ ɛgbaŋ.
text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Elɛ kaɣjaɣlaɣ ñɩnɩŋ weyɩ pɔcɔŋna se pana polɩŋ waa mba pala ba yɔ ansaayɩ na tɛ pala tʋ pɩnsɩ 1500 ɛtɛŋɖɛ.
text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Pɛkpɛŋdɩ ñɩnɩŋ weyɩ pɔcɔŋna se pana polɩŋ wa nɩnɩŋ weyɩ pɔcɔŋ na se panan polɩŋ naalɛ se ɛyɔ ɛpɩsɩna ɛñɔtɩna mbʋ ɛcɔŋna yɔ ɛtɩ nɛ pɩsɩ pɩpaɣlɩ.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Hɩluu nɛ lɛʋ kɔŋ ɛyaa cɔlɔ wɛɣʋ tam ɛlɛ eyaa taɣmaɣ labʋ paa weyɩ ehɩɣ eɖeɖe yekɩna se ɛyaa ɛpɩsɩ nɛ pawa lɛʋ alɩwaatʋ natʋyʋ;.
text_en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Taɣmaɣ kɩbaŋga labʋ yɔɔ lɛ, eyaa sakɩyɛ kaɣ naʋ se pe-wezuu caɣʋ taa lɛ, mbʋ pɩwɛ kɛsɛɣ lɛ se kpɛŋtʋʋ nɛ taɣmaɣ labʋ.
text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Ɛyaa sakɩyɛ ɖozuu evemiye nɖɩ ɛyaa kaɣ kpaʋ kɛ fenaɣ taa nɛ pɔ-cɔɔ ajɛya kɩfana taa yɔ ɖɩ-yɔɔ, nabɛyɛ pɔɔzʋʋ padɩ se ɛzɩɩ ɛbɛ wɛ peeɖe, lalaa ñamaɣzɩɣ se hama wondu nɛ weziŋ ndɩ ndɩ lɛɛŋ pɩzɩɣ pɩ-wɛɛ fenaɣ yaa tɩŋga nakɛyɛ taa.
text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Ɛlɛ, yee pɩ-wɛɛ se pɩ-kaɣ labʋʋ mbʋʋ yɔ, pɩ-kaɣ leɖiɣ siŋŋ nɛ pʋcɔ pɩ-la. Tɩɩnzɩ pazɩ sɩ-mɩzɩ sakɩyɛ pɩ-yele nɛ kilometanaa ɛgbɔŋ nɛ ɛgbɔŋ yasɩ tɩɩnzɩ nzɩ sɩ-nɔtɩnɩ ɖama yɔ sɩ-hɛkɩŋ taa.
text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Pʋ-tɔmaa yɔ, wiɖii mɩ-sɛyɩnaa sɛyɩnaa kaɣ sɩŋgʋʋ ɛjɛɖɛ ndɩ nɛ ɖɛ-tɛtʋ ɛjaɖɛ naɖɩyɛ nʋʋ taa nɛ pa-maɣzɩɣ pa-caanaʋ taa mba yɔɔ.
text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?
